muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿الم﴾: The scholars hold several views on the disconnected letters (al-aḥruf al-muqaṭṭaʿa), among them:
1. That they belong to the ambiguous (mutashābih) whose knowledge Allah the Exalted has kept to Himself, so it is not permissible to parse them, because the meaning intended by them is not known to us.
2. That they are names of the surahs that open with them; their position then admits three possibilities:
 - «الرفع» (the nominative), as the khabar (predicate) of an implied mubtadaʾ (subject), the implied form being "this is الم", "this is ص" …; or as a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is what follows it.
 - «النصب» (the accusative), by implying a suitable verb, such as "recite" (اقرأْ), or "read out" (اتلُ), or "mention" (اذكر).
 - «الجرّ» (the genitive), by implying the particle of oath.
3. That they are names of the letters of the alphabet, the purpose of which is to draw attention, or to inform them that this Quran is composed of the same kind [of material] from which they compose their own speech, yet they were incapable of producing its like. They have been cited singly, without construction and without a governing word (ʿāmil), so they necessarily take sukūn, like the names of numbers when they occur without a governing word or conjunction, so you say: "one, two, three …"; they then have no grammatical position. And Allah knows best.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿ذلك﴾: a demonstrative in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance, and the kāf is for address.
﴿الكتاب﴾: the khabar (predicate) of «ذلك», and the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), a clause with no grammatical position; or a badal (substitute) from the demonstrative.
﴿لا ريب فيه﴾: «لا» is the lā of generic negation, and «ريب» is its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the noun of «لا»; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الكتاب», or a second khabar of «ذلك».
﴿هدى﴾: a second or third khabar of «ذلك».
﴿للمتقين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «هدى», because it is a maṣdar (verbal noun); or a naʿt (adjective) of «هدى».

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿الذين﴾: a relative noun in the position of a genitive (majrūr), a naʿt (adjective) of «المتقين».
﴿يؤمنون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw is an attached pronoun in the position of a nominative, fāʿil (agent); the verbal clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿بالغيب﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يؤمنون».
﴿ويقيمون﴾: the clause is conjoined to the clause «يؤمنون», falling within the scope of the ṣila.
﴿الصلاة﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ومما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «مما» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «ينفقون».
﴿رزقناهم﴾: a past verb, fāʿil, and mafʿūl bihi. The clause «رزقناهم» is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of «ما»; the resumptive pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, i.e.: "We provided them with it" (رزقناهم إياه).
﴿ينفقون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, conjoined to «يقيمون», also falling within the scope of the ṣila.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿والذين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the relative noun is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first relative noun.
﴿يؤمنون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is a clause with no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿بما﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يؤمنون».
﴿أنزل﴾: a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a pronoun latent (mustatir) in it, its implied form being "it" (هو), referring back to «ما», i.e. the Quran; the clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun.
﴿إليك﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «أنزل».
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «ما» is conjoined to «بما أنزل إليك»; the clause «أنزل» is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun.
﴿من قبلك﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), or attached to «أنزل».
﴿وبالآخرة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يوقنون».
﴿هم﴾: a detached pronoun in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿يوقنون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative; the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿أولئك﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on kasra, in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject); the kāf is for address.
﴿على هدى﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of «أولئك».
﴿من ربهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «هدى»; the clause «أولئك على هدى من ربهم» is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿وأولئك هم﴾: «أولئك» is a mubtadaʾ, and «هم» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position.
﴿المفلحون﴾: the khabar of «أولئك»; it has also been said: «هم» is a mubtadaʾ and «المفلحون» its khabar, and the nominal clause is the khabar of «أولئك».

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿إن الذين﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and «الذين» is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), the noun of «إن».
﴿كفروا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿سواء﴾: a fronted khabar (predicate), or the khabar of «إن».
﴿عليهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «سواء».
﴿أأنذرتهم﴾: the hamza of interrogation in the sense of equalisation (taswiya); it and the verb after it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), or the fāʿil of «سواء», which is treated like the maṣdars; the clause is the khabar of «إن».
﴿أم﴾: a connected (muttaṣila) conjunction.
﴿لم تنذرهم﴾: «لم» is a particle of negation, conversion [of the imperfect to past meaning], and jussive; «تنذرهم» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لم»; the fāʿil is a pronoun necessarily latent (mustatir) in it, its implied form being "you" (أنت); the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to the clause «أأنذرتهم».
﴿لا﴾: negative.
﴿يؤمنون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil. The clause «لا يؤمنون» is in the position of a nominative as a second khabar, or explicative (tafsīriyya), a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿ختم﴾: a past verb.
﴿الله﴾: fāʿil (agent).
﴿على قلوبهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ختم».
﴿وعلى سمعهم﴾: conjoined to what precedes it.
﴿وعلى أبصارهم﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿غشاوة﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause «على أبصارهم غشاوة» is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿ولهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted [word]. [Translator's note: the source says only «متعلقان بمحذوف», "attached to an omitted [word]"; by parallel with the preceding line, the omitted word is the fronted khabar.]
﴿عذاب﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ.
﴿عظيم﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of «عذاب»; the clause is conjoined to the preceding clause.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿ومن الناس﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿من﴾: a relative noun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); or an indefinite noun qualified [by what follows] (nakira mawṣūfa) in the position of a nominative, a postponed mubtadaʾ, as though it were said: "and among the people are people".
﴿يقول﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative; its fāʿil (agent) is a pronoun latent (mustatir) in it, its implied form being "he" (هو); the verbal clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of «مَن» if it is a relative noun, and [it is] a naʿt (adjective) of it if it is an indefinite qualified noun.
﴿آمنا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿بالله﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, and the Name of Majesty «الله» is a genitive noun, the sign of the genitive being the kasra; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «آمنا».
﴿وباليوم﴾: conjoined to «بالله».
﴿الآخر﴾: a naʿt of «اليوم». The clause «من الناس...» is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «ما» is the Ḥijāzī negative that operates like «ليس».
﴿هم﴾: a detached pronoun in the position of a nominative, the noun of «ما».
﴿بمؤمنين﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, a connective (ṣila) for emphasis; «مؤمنين» is genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ in form and accusative (manṣūb) in position as the khabar of «ما»; the nominal clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:152-152.t:
﴿فاذكروني﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an omitted condition), i.e.: if you wish to be guided to the highway of what is right, then remember Me; «اذكروني» is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya), and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿أذكركم﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), because it is the response to the command (jawāb al-ṭalab); the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "I" (أنا), and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿واشكروا﴾: conjoined to «اذكروني».
﴿لي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اشكروا».
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «لا» is prohibitive (nāhiya).
﴿تكفرون﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by «لا», the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, the nūn is for protection, and the yāʾ — omitted to suit the verse-endings (fawāṣil) — is the mafʿūl bihi, the kasra being an indication of it.

muyesser-irab:153-153.t:
﴿يا أيها﴾: «يا» is a vocative particle, and «أي» is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of the accusative; «ها» is for drawing attention (tanbīh).
﴿الذين﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of «أي».
﴿آمنوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿استعينوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil.
﴿بالصبر﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «استعينوا».
﴿والصلاة﴾: conjoined to «الصبر».
﴿إن الله﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism).
﴿مع الصابرين﴾: «مع» is an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to an omitted khabar (predicate), and «الصابرين» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause of «إن» and what falls within its scope is a nominal clause with no grammatical position, because it is causal (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:154-154.t:
﴿ولا تقولوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction joining to what preceded, «لا» is prohibitive (nāhiya), and «تقولوا» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لا».
﴿لمن﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تقولوا».
﴿يقتل﴾: the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿في سبيل الله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يقتل».
﴿أموات﴾: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: "they are dead" (هم أموات); the nominal clause is the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿بل﴾: a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction.
﴿أحياء﴾: the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined to the clause «هم أموات».
﴿ولكن﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «لكن» is lightened from the heavy form (mukhaffafa min al-thaqīla), for rectification (istidrāk).
﴿لا﴾: negating (nāfiya).
﴿تشعرون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, because it is one of the five verbs; the clause is in the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:155-155.t:
﴿ولنبلونكم﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); the lām occurs in the response to an implied oath; «نبلون» is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the fāʿil (agent) is necessarily latent (mustatir), its implied form being "We" (نحن), and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿بشيء﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نبلونكم».
﴿من الخوف﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of «شيء»; the clause «نبلونكم» has no grammatical position, because it is the response to an omitted oath for which the lām prepared the way.
﴿والجوع﴾: conjoined to «الخوف».
﴿ونقص﴾: also conjoined.
﴿من الأموال﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «نقص», because it is the maṣdar (verbal noun) of «نقص»; or to an omitted adjective of «نقص», because it is indefinite.
﴿والأنفس والثمرات﴾: both conjoined to «الأموال»; the clause of the oath and its response is resumptive, with no grammatical position. And the clause «ولنبلونكم...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وبشر﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «بشر» is an imperative verb; its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "you" (أنت).
﴿الصابرين﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause «بشر» is conjoined to «ولنبلونكم».

muyesser-irab:156-156.t:
﴿الذين﴾: a relative noun, an adjective (ṣifa) of «الصابرين».
﴿إذا﴾: an adverb (ẓarf) for future time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its response, namely «قالوا».
﴿أصابتهم﴾: the clause is in the position of the genitive by being the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) [of «إذا»].
﴿مصيبة﴾: fāʿil (agent).
﴿قالوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition (jawāb sharṭ ghayr jāzim).
﴿إنا﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and «نا» is its noun (ism).
﴿لله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of «إنّ». The clause «إنا لله» is in the position of the accusative as the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿وإنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «إنا» is a mubtadaʾ (subject). [Translator's note: the source says "mubtadaʾ" here, yet below calls «راجعون» the khabar of «إن»; the expected analysis is that «نا» is the noun of «إن», as in «إنا لله».]
﴿إليه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «راجعون».
﴿راجعون﴾: the khabar of «إن». The clause «وإنا إليه راجعون» is conjoined to the clause «إنا لله». The whole conditional clause «إذا أصابتهم مصيبة قالوا...» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:157-157.t:
﴿أولئك﴾: the demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿عليهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿صلوات﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is the khabar of the demonstrative.
﴿من ربهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of «صلوات».
﴿ورحمة﴾: conjoined to «صلوات»; the demonstrative clause and what follows it is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وأولئك﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «أولئك» is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿هم﴾: a second mubtadaʾ, or a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position.
﴿المهتدون﴾: the khabar of «هم», or the khabar of «أولئك»; [in the first case] the clause is the khabar of «أولئك».

muyesser-irab:158-158.t:
﴿إن الصفا﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and «الصفا» is its noun (ism).
﴿والمروة﴾: conjoined to «الصفا».
﴿من شعائر الله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of «إن»; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position.
﴿فمن﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and «من» is a jussive conditional noun (ism sharṭ jāzim), mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿حج البيت﴾: «حج» is a past verb in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), referring back to «من», and «البيت» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿أو اعتمر﴾: «أو» is a conjunction, and «اعتمر» is a past verb conjoined to «حج».
﴿فلا جناح﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), because it is a nominal clause; «لا» is the lā of generic negation, and «جناح» is its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa.
﴿عليه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of «لا».
﴿أن يطوف﴾: the maṣdariyya «أن» and what falls within its scope are interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) in the accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e.: "in that he goes round" (في أن يطوف).
﴿بهما﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يطوف». The clause «فلا جناح عليه» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, and the clause of the protasis and its apodosis is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of «من». The clause «فمن حج البيت...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ومن تطوع﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «من» is a jussive conditional noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; «تطوع» is a past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis, and its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "he" (هو).
﴿خيرا﴾: standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an adjective of the maṣdar, i.e.: "volunteers a good volunteering" (يتطوع تطوعًا خيرًا); or accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e.: "with good" (بخير); or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the implied definite maṣdar.
﴿فإن الله﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis; «إن» is an abrogating particle, and the Name of Majesty is its noun.
﴿شاكر عليم﴾: two khabars of «إن»; the clause «فإن الله» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of «من».

muyesser-irab:159-159.t:
﴿إن الذين﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and «الذين» is its noun (ism).
﴿يكتمون﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the verbal clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the clause of «إن» and what falls within its scope is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ما﴾: the object (mafʿūl) of «يكتمون».
﴿أنزلنا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the resumptive pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, i.e.: "We sent it down" (أنزلناه); the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative noun.
﴿من البينات﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: in the state of being clarifying, bearing witness to the truths.
﴿والهدى﴾: conjoined to «البينات».
﴿من بعد﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يكتمون».
﴿ما بيناه﴾: «ما» is maṣdariyya, and «بيناه» is a verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl (object). The interpreted maṣdar is genitive (majrūr) by being muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), i.e.: "after Our making it clear" (من بعد تبيانه).
﴿للناس﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «بيناه».
﴿في الكتاب﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are also attached to «بيناه», or attached to an omitted ḥāl from the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e.: "being in the Book" (كائنًا في الكتاب).
﴿أولئك﴾: the demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿يلعنهم﴾: an imperfect verb, and the hāʾ is its object.
﴿الله﴾: its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of the demonstrative.
﴿ويلعنهم اللاعنون﴾: conjoined to the preceding clause; the nominal demonstrative clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of «إن».

muyesser-irab:160-160.t:
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of exception.
﴿الذين﴾: excepted from the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e. the hāʾ in «يلعنهم».
﴿تابوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين».
﴿وأصلحوا وبينوا﴾: conjoined to «تابوا».
﴿فأولئك﴾: the fāʾ is linking (rābiṭa), because the relative noun has a scent of the condition; the demonstrative is mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿أتوب﴾: an imperfect verb; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "I" (أنا); the clause «أتوب» is the khabar (predicate) of the demonstrative, and the demonstrative clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿عليهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أتوب».
﴿وأنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «أنا» is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿التواب الرحيم﴾: two khabars of «أنا»; the clause is conjoined.

muyesser-irab:78-78.t:
﴿ومنهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿أميون﴾: a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿لا﴾: negative.
﴿يعلمون﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿الكتاب﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause لا يعلمون is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أميون﴾.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of exception.
﴿أماني﴾: excepted by إلا, and it is a discontinuous exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ), because "wishful fancies" (الأماني) do not fall under what "the Book" denotes.
﴿وإن﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and إن is negative.
﴿هم﴾: mubtadaʾ.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), because of the preceding negation.
﴿يظنون﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar of هم.

muyesser-irab:79-79.t:
﴿فويل﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and ويل is a mubtadaʾ (subject); it is permissible to begin with it [though indefinite] because it carries the sense of imprecation and intimidation.
﴿للذين﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are the khabar (predicate) of ويل.
﴿يكتبون﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿الكتاب﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause ﴿ويل للذين..﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿ثم يقولون﴾: conjoined to يكتبون.
﴿هذا﴾: mubtadaʾ.
﴿من عند الله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are the khabar; the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿ليشتروا﴾: the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and يشتروا is an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an أن that is optionally implied after the lām of causation; أن and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive, and the preposition with its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) يقولون; the wāw is the fāʿil.
﴿به﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يشتروا.
﴿ثمنا﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿قليلا﴾: naʿt (adjective).
﴿فويل﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and ويل is a mubtadaʾ; it is repeated for emphasis.
﴿لهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are the khabar of ويل.
﴿مما﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ويل.
﴿كتبت أيديهم﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of ما. The clause ﴿ويل لهم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وويل لهم مما﴾: conjoined to what preceded.
﴿يكسبون﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:80-80.t:
﴿وقالوا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; قالوا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿لن﴾: a particle of negation, of the accusative, and of the future.
﴿تمسنا﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by لن, and نا is an attached pronoun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿النار﴾: fāʿil; the verbal clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿أياما﴾: accusative as an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), attached to (mutaʿalliq) تمسنا.
﴿معدودة﴾: naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أيامًا﴾. The clause ﴿قالوا لن تمسنا...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿قل﴾: an imperative verb; its fāʿil is a pronoun necessarily latent (mustatir) in it, its implied form being: أنت; the clause ﴿قل...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿أتخذتم﴾: the clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying.
﴿عند الله﴾: an adverb attached to اتخذتم.
﴿عهدا﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فلن﴾: the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa ("disclosing") fāʾ, because it discloses an implied condition; the implied form is: إن اتخذتم عند الله عهدًا فلن (if you have taken a covenant with Allah, then He will not…).
﴿يخلف﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative by لن.
﴿الله﴾: fāʿil.
﴿عهده﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿أم﴾: a conjunction counterbalancing the interrogative, so it is connective (muttaṣila); it has also been said: it is disconnective (munqaṭiʿa) in the sense of بل plus the hamza, the implied form being: بل أتقولون ... (nay, do you say…), and it is a rhetorical interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī).
﴿تقولون﴾: conjoined to what precedes it.
﴿على الله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تقولون.
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, the object of تقولون.
﴿لا﴾: negative.
﴿تعلمون﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.

muyesser-irab:81-81.t:
﴿بلى﴾: a particle of response, cancelling the negation in their saying: ﴿لن تمسنا النار إلا أياما معدودة﴾.
﴿من﴾: a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive (jāzim); mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿كسب﴾: a past verb in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: هو.
﴿سيئة﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وأحاطت﴾: conjoined to كسب.
﴿به﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أحاطت.
﴿خطيئته﴾: the fāʿil of أحاطت.
﴿فأولئك﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿أصحاب النار﴾: its khabar (predicate).
﴿هم﴾: mubtadaʾ.
﴿فيها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿خالدون﴾.
﴿خالدون﴾: the khabar of ﴿هم﴾; the nominal clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis of the jussive condition.

muyesser-irab:82-82.t:
﴿والذين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and الذين is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿آمنوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿وعملوا الصالحات﴾: conjoined to آمنوا.
﴿أولئك﴾: also a mubtadaʾ.
﴿أصحاب الجنة﴾: the khabar (predicate) of أولئك; the nominal clause is the khabar of الذين.
﴿هم﴾: mubtadaʾ.
﴿فيها﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خالدون﴾.
﴿خالدون﴾: the khabar of هم; the nominal clause is a second khabar of the relative noun.

muyesser-irab:83-83.t:
﴿وإذ﴾: the wāw: a conjunction; and إذ: a noun of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative, conjoined to ﴿نعمتي﴾ in the saying of Allah the Exalted: ﴿اذكروا نعمتي﴾.
﴿أخذنا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the verbal clause is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct).
﴿ميثاق﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿بني﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), and the sign of its genitive is the yāʾ, because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural.
﴿إسرائيل﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the sign of its genitive is the fatḥa in place of the kasra, because it is a foreign proper name.
﴿لا﴾: negative.
﴿تعبدون﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿الله﴾: the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿لا تعبدون إلا الله﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya), with no grammatical position, and the statement has the meaning of a prohibition. Or the clause is the object of an omitted ﴿قلنا﴾ (We said) conjoined to أخذنا, i.e.: We took and We said.
﴿وبالوالدين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction [conjoining] to the position of the omitted أن in لا تعبدون إلا الله, so that the meaning of the speech was: "And when We took the covenant of the Children of Israel that you worship none but Allah, and do good to parents." وبالوالدين: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb of the maṣdar, i.e.: وأحسنوا بالوالدين (and do good to parents).
﴿إحسانا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb.
﴿وذي القربى واليتامى والمساكين﴾: conjoined to الوالدين.
﴿وقولوا﴾: conjoined, on the assumption of something omitted, i.e.: وقلنا قولوا (and We said: speak).
﴿للناس﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to قولوا.
﴿حسنا﴾: standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq, accusative (manṣūb) with the fatḥa, because it is the adjective of the maṣdar, i.e.: قولا حسنا (a good speech).
﴿وأقيموا﴾: also conjoined to what preceded.
﴿الصلاة﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وآتوا الزكاة﴾: conjoined to أقيموا الصلاة.
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction conjoining to something omitted, i.e.: فقبلتم الميثاق (so you accepted the covenant).
﴿توليتم﴾: a verb and its fāʿil.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of exception, because the speech is complete and affirmative.
﴿قليلا﴾: excepted by إلا.
﴿منكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿قليلًا﴾.
﴿وأنتم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and أنتم is a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿معرضون﴾: khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:84-84.t:
﴿وإذ أخذنا﴾: the wāw: a conjunction; and إذ: a noun of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative, conjoined to ﴿نعمتي﴾ in the saying of Allah the Exalted: ﴿اذكروا نعمتي﴾; the clause ﴿أخذنا﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct).
﴿ميثاقكم﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿لا تسفكون دماءكم﴾: a statement whose meaning is prohibition; لا is negative, تسفكون is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), دماءكم is mafʿūl bihi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿ولا تخرجون أنفسكم من دياركم﴾: conjoined to what preceded.
﴿ثم أقررتم﴾: ثم is a conjunction, and أقررتم is a verb and its fāʿil.
﴿وأنتم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and أنتم is a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿تشهدون﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative, the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the verbal clause تشهدون is the khabar (predicate) of أنتم. The nominal clause وأنتم تشهدون is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause.

muyesser-irab:85-85.t:
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction denoting delay (tarākhī).
﴿أنتم﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿هؤلاء﴾: a demonstrative in the position of the accusative as an expression of censure (dhamm) by an omitted verb, its implied form being: أذم (I censure); it has also been said: in the position of the accusative as one addressed in the vocative (munādā) from which the vocative particle has been omitted.
﴿تقتلون﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause تقتلون is the khabar (predicate) of أنتم.
﴿أنفسكم﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). It has also been said: the demonstrative is the khabar, and the clause تقتلون is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وتخرجون﴾: conjoined to تقتلون.
﴿فريقا﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿منكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿فريقًا﴾.
﴿من دياركم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تخرجون.
﴿تظاهرون﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the fāʿil of ﴿تخرجون﴾, which is the wāw of the plural.
﴿عليهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تظاهرون.
﴿بالإثم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl from the fāʿil of ﴿تظاهرون﴾, i.e.: متلبسين بالإثم (engaged in sin).
﴿والعدوان﴾: conjoined to الإثم.
﴿وإن﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and إن is conditional.
﴿يأتوكم﴾: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the letter nūn [Translator's note: so in the source («حرف النون»); the sign of the jussive here is the omission of the nūn (حذف النون), so «حرف» is presumably a slip for «حذف».], the wāw is the fāʿil, and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi.
﴿أسارى﴾: ḥāl.
﴿تفادوهم﴾: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), jussive. The clause ﴿إن يأتوكم...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿وهو﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and هو is a mubtadaʾ; it is what is called the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn).
﴿محرم﴾: a fronted khabar.
﴿عليكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to محرم.
﴿إخراجهم﴾: a delayed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the pronoun of the matter. Or: محرم is the khabar of هو, and إخراجهم is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of محرم, because it is a passive participle.
﴿أفتؤمنون ببعض الكتاب وتكفرون ببعض﴾: the hamza is for the rhetorical interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī), and the fāʾ is a conjunction, or resumptive, the clause after it then being resumptive with no grammatical position; تؤمنون is a verb and the wāw is the fāʿil; ببعض is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تؤمنون; الكتاب is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct); the clause تكفرون is conjoined to تؤمنون; and ببعض is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تكفرون.
﴿فما﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and ما is negative.
﴿جزاء﴾: mubtadaʾ.
﴿من﴾: a relative noun in the position of the genitive by annexation.
﴿يفعل﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: هو; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿ذلك﴾: the demonstrative is mafʿūl bihi.
﴿منكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e.: حال كونه منكم (being from among you).
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿خزي﴾: the khabar of جزاء, because it is an emptied exception (istithnāʾ mufarragh).
﴿في الحياة﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are a naʿt of خزي.
﴿الدنيا﴾: naʿt of الحياة. The clause ﴿ما جزاء...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ويوم القيامة﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the adverb is attached to يردون.
﴿يردون﴾: the verbal clause has no grammatical position, because it is resumptive.
﴿إلى أشد العذاب﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يردون.
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and ما is the Ḥijāzī negative ما, which operates like ليس.
﴿الله﴾: the Name of Majesty, the noun (ism) of ما, in the nominative.
﴿بغافل﴾: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition, and غافل is the khabar of ما, genitive (majrūr) in form by the bāʾ and accusative in position.
﴿عما﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تعملون.
﴿تعملون﴾: the verbal clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿وما الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:86-86.t:
﴿أولئك﴾: the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿الذين﴾: a relative noun, khabar (predicate).
﴿اشتروا﴾: the verbal clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿الحياة﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿الدنيا﴾: naʿt (adjective) of الحياة.
﴿بالآخرة﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) اشتروا.
﴿فلا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and لا is negative.
﴿يخفف﴾: an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); the clause is a second khabar of the demonstrative.
﴿عنهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يخفف.
﴿العذاب﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿ولا هم ينصرون﴾: the wāw conjoins to what preceded, لا is negative, هم is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause ينصرون is the khabar.

muyesser-irab:87-87.t:
﴿ولقد﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, the lām is [the lām of] the response to an omitted oath, and قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq).
﴿آتينا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿موسى﴾: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿الكتاب﴾: second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وقفينا﴾: conjoined to آتينا.
﴿من بعده﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿بالرسل﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to قفينا.
﴿وآتينا﴾: conjoined to what preceded.
﴿عيسى﴾: first mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ابن﴾: badal (substitute) or naʿt (adjective).
﴿مريم﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct).
﴿البينات﴾: second mafʿūl bihi; the sign of its accusative is the kasra, because it is a sound feminine plural.
﴿وأيدناه﴾: conjoined to what preceded.
﴿بروح القدس﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أيدناه.
﴿أفكلما جاءكم﴾: ﴿أفكلما﴾: the hamza is for the rhetorical interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī), the fāʾ is a conjunction conjoining to what precedes it, and ﴿كلَّ﴾ stands in for an adverb of time, attached to ﴿استكبرتم﴾ and containing the sense of condition; ﴿ما﴾ is temporal-maṣdarī, and the clause ﴿جاءكم﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the particle-relative ﴿ما﴾; ﴿ما﴾ together with what it governs is interpreted as a maṣdar in the genitive by annexation, the implied form being: أفَكُلَّ مجيءِ رسول (is it then every coming of a messenger…), and this is on the omission of a muḍāf, i.e.: أفَكُلَّ وقتِ مجيءِ رسول (is it then at every time of a messenger's coming…). Or ﴿ما﴾ is an indefinite noun qualified [by what follows], in the sense of ﴿وقت﴾ (time), with the referring pronoun omitted, the implied form being: أفَكُلَّ وقتٍ جاءكم فيه رسول (is it then every time a messenger came to you in it), so that the clause ﴿جاءكم﴾ is in the position of the genitive as a naʿt of ﴿ما﴾. ﴿جاءكم﴾ is a past verb, the kāf is mafʿūl bihi, and the mīm is the sign of the plural.
﴿رسول﴾: the fāʿil of جاء; the clause is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it.
﴿بما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, and ما is a relative noun, genitive (majrūr) in position by the bāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to جاءكم.
﴿لا﴾: negative.
﴿تهوى﴾: an imperfect verb.
﴿أنفسكم﴾: fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of ما.
﴿استكبرتم﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿ففريقا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and فريقًا is a fronted mafʿūl bihi.
﴿كذبتم﴾: a verb.
﴿وفريقا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and فريقًا is a fronted object of تقتلون.
﴿تقتلون﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿يخادعون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the verbal clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun latent in «يقول», i.e.: "deceiving Allah and those who believe" (مخادعين الله والذين آمنوا).
﴿الله﴾: the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «يخادعون».
﴿والذين﴾: conjoined to the Name of Majesty.
﴿آمنوا﴾: the verbal clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «ما» is negative.
﴿يخدعون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿أنفسهم﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by annexation (iḍāfa).
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction or resumptive, and «ما» is negative.
﴿يشعرون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative; the clause «ما يشعرون» is conjoined to the clause «ما يخدعون», or resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿في قلوبهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are a fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿مرض﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿فزادهم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «زاد» is a past verb, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to that to which the khabar is attached.
﴿الله﴾: fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿مرضا﴾: a second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ولهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition and its genitive noun are a fronted khabar.
﴿عذاب﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ.
﴿أليم﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of «عذاب».
﴿بما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition of causation, and «ما» is a relative noun in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ, or maṣdariyya (infinitival).
﴿كانوا﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb [of kāna and its sisters], and the wāw of the plural is its noun; the clause «كانوا» is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, the implied form being: "because of that which they used to deny" (بالذي كانوا يكذبون). On «ما» being maṣdariyya, the clause «كانوا» is a clause with no grammatical position, and the interpreted maṣdar from «ما» and the verb is genitive by the bāʾ, the implied form being: "because of their being deniers" (بسبب كونهم كذبون) [Translator's note: the source reads «كذبون», presumably a slip for «يكذبون»].
﴿يكذبون﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of «كانوا».

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿وإذا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause «إذا قيل لهم...» is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; or the wāw is a conjunction, and the clause after it is conjoined to the clause «يكذبون», so it is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), conjoined to the khabar (predicate) of «كان». «إذا» is an adverb for future time, making its protasis (sharṭ) genitive [by annexation] and made accusative by its apodosis (jawāb).
﴿قيل﴾: a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl), namely the clause «لا تفسدوا في الأرض»; the clause «قيل» is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the annexation of the adverb to it.
﴿لهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قيل».
﴿لا﴾: the prohibitive lā that makes [the verb] jussive.
﴿تفسدوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لا», the sign of its jussive being the omission of the nūn, because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿في الأرض﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «تفسدوا»; the clause «لا تفسدوا في الأرض» is in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), nāʾib fāʿil of the verb «قيل».
﴿قالوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the verbal clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿إنما﴾: [«إنّ» with] the restraining «ما» (kāffa wa-makfūfa).
﴿نحن﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿مصلحون﴾: the khabar of «نحن», nominative, the sign of its nominative being the wāw, because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is in the position of an accusative as the object of speech.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿ألا﴾: a particle of alerting (tanbīh) with which speech is opened.
﴿إنهم﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun.
﴿هم﴾: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position, or a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿المفسدون﴾: its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), the khabar of «إن».
﴿ولكن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «لكن» is lightened from the heavy [form «لكنّ»], for rectification (istidrāk).
﴿لا﴾: negative.
﴿يشعرون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined to what precedes.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿وإذا قيل﴾: the wāw is resumptive, or the wāw is a conjunction; «إذا» is an adverb for future time, making its protasis (sharṭ) genitive [by annexation] and made accusative by its apodosis (jawāb). «قيل»: a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); the clause is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the annexation of the adverb to it.
﴿لهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قيل».
﴿آمنوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿كما﴾: the kāf is a noun in the sense of «مثل» ("like"), indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being: "believe with a belief like the belief of the people" (آمنوا إيمانًا مثل إيمان الناس); and «ما» is maṣdariyya (infinitival).
﴿آمن الناس﴾: «آمن» is a past verb, and «الناس» is the fāʿil; the clause «آمن الناس» is the ṣila of the maṣdariyya «ما», a clause with no grammatical position; the interpreted maṣdar from the maṣdariyya «ما» and the verb «آمن» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿قالوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; «إذا» is attached to «قالوا»; the clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿أنؤمن﴾: the hamza is for the interrogation of disapproval (istifhām inkārī), and «نؤمن» is an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is a pronoun necessarily latent (mustatir) in it, its implied form being "we" (نحن).
﴿كما﴾: the kāf is a noun in the sense of «مثل», indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of an accusative, a naʿt of an omitted maṣdar, the implied form being: "shall we believe with a belief like the belief of the fools?" (أنؤمن إيمانًا مثل إيمان السفهاء؟); and «ما» is maṣdariyya.
﴿آمن السفهاء﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause «آمن السفهاء» is the ṣila of the maṣdariyya «ما», a clause with no grammatical position; the interpreted maṣdar from the maṣdariyya «ما» and the verb «آمن» is muḍāf ilayhi. The clause «وإذا قيل لهم آمنوا...» is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position, or conjoined.
﴿ألا﴾: a particle of alerting (tanbīh) with which speech is opened.
﴿إنهم﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun.
﴿هم﴾: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position; or a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿السفهاء﴾: its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of «إن».
﴿ولكن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «لكن» is lightened from the heavy [form «لكنّ»], for rectification (istidrāk).
﴿لا﴾: negative.
﴿يعلمون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿وإذا﴾: conjoined to what precedes; «إذا» is an adverb for future time, making its protasis (sharṭ) genitive [by annexation] and made accusative by its apodosis (jawāb).
﴿لقوا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma because of its attachment to the wāw of the plural; the ḍamma was felt heavy on the yāʾ, so it was transferred to the qāf, and the yāʾ was omitted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the annexation of the adverb to it.
﴿الذين﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿آمنوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿قالوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿آمنا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿وإذا﴾: conjoined to the preceding «وإذا».
﴿خلوا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif that was omitted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of a genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it.
﴿إلى شياطينهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خلوا».
﴿قالوا﴾: a past verb; the clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
﴿إنا﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and «نا» is an attached pronoun in the position of an accusative, its noun.
﴿معكم﴾: «مع» is an adverb of place attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of «إن», and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause «إنا معكم» is in the position of an accusative as the object of speech.
﴿إنما﴾: [«إنّ» with] the restraining «ما» (kāffa wa-makfūfa).
﴿نحن﴾: a detached pronoun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿مستهزئون﴾: the khabar of «نحن», nominative, the sign of its nominative being the wāw, because it is a sound masculine plural. The clause «إنما نحن مستهزئون» is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position, occurring in answer to an implied question, as though their devils said to them when they said «إنا معكم»: «If that is true, then why do you go along with the believers?» So they answered by saying: «إنما نحن مستهزئون». Or the clause is a badal (substitute) from «إنا معكم», a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl). [Translator's note: the bracketing of the quoted question and answer is garbled in the source; it is rendered here by sense.]

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿الله﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿يستهزئ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is a pronoun optionally latent (mustatir) in it, referring back to the Name of Majesty; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate).
﴿بهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يستهزئ».
﴿ويمدهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «يمدهم» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), conjoined to «يستهزئ»; the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "he" (هو); the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿في طغيانهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يمدهم».
﴿يعمهون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative; the wāw is the fāʿil; the verbal clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «يمدهم».

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿أولئك﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on kasra, in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿الذين﴾: the khabar (predicate) of «أولئك».
﴿اشتروا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif that was omitted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿الضلالة﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿بالهدى﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اشتروا»; the clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿فما﴾: the fāʾ is a particle of conjunction with immediate sequence (taʿqīb), and «ما» is negative.
﴿ربحت﴾: a past verb; the tāʾ is the quiescent tāʾ of the feminine.
﴿تجارتهم﴾: the fāʿil of «ربحت».
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «ما» is negative.
﴿كانوا﴾: «كان» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb [of kāna and its sisters], and the wāw is its noun.
﴿مهتدين﴾: its khabar, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ, because it is a sound masculine plural.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿مثلهم﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿كمثل﴾: the kāf is a noun in the sense of «مثل» ("like"), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; and «مَثَل» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿الذي﴾: a relative noun in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by annexation.
﴿استوقد﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on fatḥa; the fāʿil (agent) is a pronoun optionally latent (mustatir) in it, its implied form being "he" (هو); the clause «استوقد» is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿نارا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «مثلهم» is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿فلما﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «لما» is an adverb in the sense of "when" (حين) containing the meaning of condition; it has also been said: it is a particle of "necessity for necessity" (ḥarf wujūb li-wujūb); and it has been said: [it is] connective (rābiṭa).
﴿أضاءت﴾: a past verb; the tāʾ is the quiescent tāʾ of the feminine; the fāʿil is a pronoun optionally latent in it, its implied form being "it/she" (هي).
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), mafʿūl bihi.
﴿حوله﴾: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila of «ما»; the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. Or «أضاء» is an intransitive verb and «ما» is a connective (ṣila) [i.e. redundant], i.e.: "it lit up around him" (أضاءت حوله).
﴿ذهب الله﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿بنورهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «ذهب».
﴿وتركهم﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is optionally latent in it; the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi.
﴿في ظلمات﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are in the place of the second object of «تركهم».
﴿لا﴾: negative.
﴿يبصرون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the place of an accusative as a corroborative ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿صم﴾: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "they are deaf" (هم صم); the clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿بكم﴾: a second khabar.
﴿عمي﴾: a third khabar.
﴿فهم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «هم» is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿لا يرجعون﴾: «لا» is negative, and «يرجعون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar of «هم».

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿أو﴾: a conjunction.
﴿كصيب﴾: the kāf is a noun in the sense of «مثل» ("like"), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), conjoined to the kāf in «كمَثَل الذي استوقد...»; and «صيب» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). A muḍāf must be implied, i.e. "like the people of a rainstorm" (كأصحاب صيب), and it is to this muḍāf that the pronoun in His words «يجعلون» refers.
﴿من السماء﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «صيب».
﴿فيه﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿ظلمات﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿ورعد وبرق﴾: two words conjoined to «ظلمات».
﴿يجعلون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿أصابعهم﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿في آذانهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are in the place of the second object of «يجعلون».
﴿من الصواعق﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يجعلون»; «من» is causal.
﴿حذر الموت﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).
﴿والله﴾: the wāw is parenthetical, and the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿محيط﴾: khabar.
﴿بالكافرين﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «محيط»; the clause is parenthetical, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿يكاد﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); it is one of the verbs of approximation (afʿāl al-muqāraba); the clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿البرق﴾: the noun of «يكاد», nominative.
﴿يخطف﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative; its fāʿil (agent) is optionally latent (mustatir) in it, its implied form being "it" (هو), referring back to «البرق»; the clause «يخطف» is the khabar (predicate) of «يكاد».
﴿أبصارهم﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by annexation.
﴿كلما أضاء﴾: «كلما»: «كلَّ» stands in for an adverb of time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مشوا», containing the meaning of condition; «ما» is temporal maṣdariyya; the clause «أضاء» is a clause with no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the particle-relative «ما»; «ما» together with what it governs, «أضاء», is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), genitive by annexation, the implied form being: "every lighting" (كلَّ إضاءة), and this involves the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "every time of lighting" (كلَّ وقتِ إضاءةٍ). Or «ما» is an indefinite noun qualified [by what follows] (nakira mawṣūfa) in the sense of «وقت» ("time"), the resumptive pronoun (ʿāʾid) being omitted, the implied form being: "every time in which it lit up for them" (كلَّ وقتٍ أضاء لهم فيه); the clause «أضاء» is then in the position of a genitive, a naʿt (adjective) of «ما».
﴿لهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «أضاء».
﴿مشوا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif that was omitted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause «مشوا فيه» is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿فيه﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «مشوا».
﴿وإذا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «إذا» is an adverb for future time, making its protasis (sharṭ) genitive [by annexation] and made accusative by its apodosis (jawāb).
﴿أظلم عليهم﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on fatḥa; the fāʿil is optionally latent in it, its implied form being "it" (هو), referring back to «البرق»; the clause is in the position of a genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; «عليهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «أظلم».
﴿قاموا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
﴿ولو﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and «لو» is conditional.
﴿شاء الله﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the object of willing is omitted.
﴿لذهب﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis of «لو», and «ذهب» is a verb indeclinable on fatḥa, its fāʿil optionally latent in it, its implied form being "he" (هو).
﴿بسمعهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «ذهب».
﴿وأبصارهم﴾: conjoined to «بسمعهم». The clause «لو شاء الله لذهب بسمعهم وأبصارهم» is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿إن﴾: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh).
﴿الله﴾: its noun, accusative (manṣūb).
﴿على كل﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «قدير».
﴿شيء﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿قدير﴾: the khabar of «إن». The clause «لذهب» is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; and the clause «إن الله...» is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:271-271.t:
﴿إن تبدوا الصدقات فنعما هي﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. إن is a conditional particle that puts the verb in the jussive (majzūm); تبدوا is a jussive imperfect verb, because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the sign of its jussive is the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); الصدقات is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). فنعمّا: the fāʾ is connective, because the apodosis is a rigid (non-inflecting) verb; نعم is a rigid past verb for expressing praise, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ما is an absolute indefinite meaning "a thing", in the position of the accusative as a tamyīz (specification). ﴿هي﴾: a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar (predicate) is the clause نعمّا, because it is the one specified for praise. The clause ﴿نعمّا هي﴾ is a nominal clause in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).
﴿وإن تخفوها وتؤتوها الفقراء﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is conditional; تخفوها is a jussive imperfect verb, because it is the protasis, and the sign of its jussive is the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and ﴿ها﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi; تؤتوها الفقراء is conjoined to it; ﴿ها﴾ is the first mafʿūl bihi, and الفقراء is the second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فهو خير لكم﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis; هو is a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ; خير is the khabar; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) خير; and the nominal clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis.
﴿ويكفر عنكم من سيئاتكم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; يكفر is a nominative imperfect verb, and the clause is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "and Allah expiates for you"; عنكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يكفر; من سيئاتكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of an omitted direct object, i.e. "something of your misdeeds". The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿والله بما تعملون خبير﴾: the wāw is resumptive; الله is the mubtadaʾ, and خبير is its khabar; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to خبير; the clause تعملون has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾; and the clause ﴿والله بما تعملون خبير﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:272-272.t:
﴿ليس عليك هداهم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. ليس is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; عليك is its fronted khabar (predicate), and هداهم is its postponed noun; it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) annexed to its object.
﴿ولكن الله يهدي من يشاء﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لكن is an abrogating particle (of the sisters of inna); the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause يهدي is its khabar; من is a relative noun, the object of يهدي; the clause يشاء has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; and the clause ﴿ولكن الله يهدي ...﴾ is conjoined to the resumptive clause before it, with no grammatical position.
﴿وما تنفقوا من خير فلأنفسكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction joining it to what precedes; ما is a conditional (noun) that puts the verb in the jussive, in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of تنفقوا; تنفقوا is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); من خير is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); the fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); لأنفسكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), the implied form being "then it is for yourselves"; and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis.
﴿وما تنفقون إلا ابتغاء وجه الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is negative; تنفقون is a nominative imperfect verb, the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); إلا is a particle of restriction; ابتغاء is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), the exception being from the most general of causes; and وجه الله is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وما تنفقوا من خير﴾: the wāw is a conjunction joining it to what precedes; ما is a conditional (noun) that puts the verb in the jussive, in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi of تنفقوا; تنفقوا is the protasis; and من خير is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl.
﴿يوف إليكم﴾: the apodosis, in the jussive, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he/it"; إليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يوف.
﴿وأنتم لا تظلمون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; أنتم is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause لا تظلمون is the khabar of أنتم; the nominal clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl. It has also been said: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:273-273.t:
﴿للفقراء الذين أحصروا في سبيل الله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "your charities are for the poor"; الذين is a naʿt (adjective) of الفقراء; the clause أحصروا في سبيل الله has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أحصروا.
﴿لا يستطيعون ضربا في الأرض﴾: the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause ﴿للفقراء...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; لا is negative; يستطيعون is an imperfect verb, the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ضربًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and في الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ضربًا﴾.
﴿يحسبهم الجاهل أغنياء من التعفف﴾: the clause is a second ḥāl of الفقراء; يحسبهم is an imperfect verb; the hāʾ is the first object of يحسب; الجاهل is the fāʿil; أغنياء is the second mafʿūl bihi; and من التعفف is a preposition and its genitive noun in the position of the accusative as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).
﴿تعرفهم بسيماهم﴾: the clause is a third ḥāl of الفقراء, and بسيماهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تعرفهم.
﴿لا يسألون الناس﴾: the clause is a fourth ḥāl; لا is negative; يسألون is a nominative imperfect verb; the wāw is the fāʿil; and الناس is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿إلحافًا﴾: a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e. "they importune importunately", the implied clause being a ḥāl of the fāʿil of ﴿يسألون﴾; or ﴿إلحافًا﴾ is an interpreted maṣdar in the position of the ḥāl, i.e. "they do not ask while being importunate"; or ﴿إلحافًا﴾ is a mafʿūl min ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "they do not ask for the sake of importuning".
﴿وما تنفقوا من خير﴾: the wāw is a conjunction joining it to what precedes; ما is a conditional (noun) that puts the verb in the jussive (majzūm), in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi of تنفقوا; تنفقوا is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); and من خير is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl.
﴿فإن الله به عليم﴾: the fāʾ is connective; إن is an abrogating particle (of the sisters of inna); the Name of Majesty is its noun, and عليم is its khabar; the clause is nominal, in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); and به is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the khabar ﴿عليم﴾.

muyesser-irab:274-274.t:
﴿الذين ينفقون أموالهم بالليل والنهار سرا وعلانية﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position. الذين is a mubtadaʾ (subject); ينفقون is an imperfect verb, and the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); أموالهم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بالليل is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ينفقون; النهار is conjoined to الليل; and سرًّا and علانية are two maṣdars (verbal nouns) in the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial), or by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ).
﴿فلهم أجرهم عند ربهم﴾: the fāʾ is connective, indicating that what precedes it is the cause of what follows it, and because the relative noun carries a hint of condition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); أجرهم is a postponed mubtadaʾ; عند is an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl, and ربهم is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause is the khabar of the relative noun ﴿الذين﴾.
﴿ولا خوف﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is negative; خوف is a mubtadaʾ — it is permissible to begin with it although it is indefinite because the negation precedes it.
﴿عليهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ.
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿لا﴾ is negative.
﴿هم﴾: an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ.
﴿يحزنون﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; and the clause ﴿يحزنون﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ﴿هم﴾.

muyesser-irab:161-161.t:
﴿إن الذين﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and «الذين» is its noun (ism).
﴿كفروا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿وماتوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the clause «ماتوا» is conjoined to the clause «كفروا».
﴿وهم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «هم» is a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿كفار﴾: the khabar (predicate) of «هم»; the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿أولئك﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the kasra, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ.
﴿عليهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar.
﴿لعنة الله﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ.
﴿والملائكة والناس﴾: conjoined to the Name of Majesty; the nominal clause is the khabar of «أولئك», the clause «أولئك» and what falls within its scope is the khabar of «إن», and the clause of «إن» and what falls within its scope is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿أجمعين﴾: tawkīd (emphasis).

muyesser-irab:162-162.t:
﴿خالدين﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «عليهم».
﴿فيها﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خالدين»; the pronoun refers back to the Fire, which is left unmentioned (uḍmirat) to frighten and to convey its terror, or to the curse.
﴿لا يخفف﴾: «لا» is negating (nāfiya), and «يخفف» is an imperfect verb, passive (built for that whose agent is not named).
﴿عنهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يخفف».
﴿العذاب﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the verbal clause is in the position of the accusative as a second ḥāl of «الذين كفروا», [or] from the pronoun concealed in «خالدين», in which case it is an overlapping ḥāl (ḥāl mutadākhila).
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «لا» is negating.
﴿هم﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿ينظرون﴾: an imperfect verb, passive, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of «هم», and the nominal clause is conjoined to the clause «لا يخفف».

muyesser-irab:163-163.t:
﴿وإلهكم﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; «إلهكم» is a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿إله﴾: khabar (predicate).
﴿واحد﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of «إله».
﴿لا﴾: the lā of generic negation.
﴿إله﴾: its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa in the position of the accusative.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿هو﴾: a badal (substitute) from the position of «لا» and its noun, because their position is nominative as a mubtadaʾ; or a badal from the pronoun concealed in the omitted khabar.
﴿الرحمن الرحيم﴾: two khabars of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "He" (هو).

muyesser-irab:164-164.t:
﴿إن﴾: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh).
﴿في خلق السماوات والأرض﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of «إن».
﴿واختلاف الليل والنهار﴾: conjoined to «خلق السماوات».
﴿والفلك﴾: also conjoined.
﴿التي﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of «الفلك».
﴿تجري في البحر﴾: the verbal clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿بما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, and «ما» is a relative noun in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿ينفع الناس﴾: a verbal clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of «ما»; or «ما» is maṣdariyya, and it together with the verb «ينفع» is interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) in the genitive by the bāʾ, i.e.: "it runs by means of what benefits people" (تجري بأسباب نفع الناس).
﴿وما﴾: conjoined to the first «ما».
﴿أنزل الله﴾: the clause is the ṣila of «ما», with no grammatical position.
﴿من السماء﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «أنزل».
﴿من ماء﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are a badal (substitute) from His words «من السماء», a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl); there is no objection here regarding two identical particles being attached to a single governor, for what is forbidden in that is that the two be identical together without conjunction or substitution.
﴿فأحيا﴾: conjoined to «فأنزل». [Translator's note: so in the source; the Quranic word is «أنزل», without the fāʾ.]
﴿به﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «أحيا».
﴿الأرض﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿بعد موتها﴾: the adverb (ẓarf) is attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿وبث﴾: conjoined to «أنزل» or «أحيا».
﴿فيها﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿من كل دابة﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «بث».
﴿وتصريف الرياح﴾: conjoined to «خلق».
﴿والسحاب﴾: also conjoined.
﴿المسخر﴾: an adjective of «السحاب».
﴿بين السماء والأرض﴾: the adverb is attached to «المسخر», because it is a passive participle.
﴿لآيات﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and «آيات» is the postponed noun of «إن».
﴿لقوم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective of «آيات».
﴿يعقلون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the verbal clause is an adjective of «قوم». The verse is a resumptive clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:165-165.t:
﴿ومن الناس﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿من﴾: a relative noun in the position of the nominative as a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), or an indefinite described noun (nakira mawṣūfa) in the position of the nominative as a postponed mubtadaʾ.
﴿يتخذ﴾: the verbal clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, or [it is] an adjective (ṣifa) of «من»; the fāʿil (agent) of «يتخذ» is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو), referring back to the wording of «من».
﴿من دون الله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يتخذ».
﴿أندادا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿يحبونهم﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), with its fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the verbal clause is an adjective of «أندادًا», or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun concealed in «يتخذ».
﴿كحب الله﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being: "they love them with a love like the love of Allah" (يحبونهم حبًّا مثل حب الله); «حب» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and it is a maṣdar annexed to its object, which is the Name of Majesty, and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi. The clause «ومن الناس...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿والذين﴾: the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; or the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). The relative noun is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿آمنوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿أشد﴾: the khabar of the relative noun.
﴿حبا﴾: tamyīz (specification).
﴿لله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «حبًّا».
﴿ولو﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and «لو» is a non-jussive conditional particle.
﴿يرى﴾: an imperfect verb.
﴿الذين﴾: fāʿil.
﴿ظلموا﴾: the verbal clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿إذ﴾: an adverb (ẓarf) meaning "when" (حين), attached to «يرى».
﴿يرون﴾: the verbal clause is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; the wāw is the fāʿil.
﴿العذاب﴾: first mafʿūl bihi; the second object is omitted, its implied form being "descending upon them at the time they see it" (نازلًا بهم وقت رؤيتهم).
﴿أن القوة﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and «القوة» is its noun (ism). [Translator's note: the source writes «إن» here; the particle in the verse is «أنّ».]
﴿لله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar; «إن» and what follows it take the place of the two objects of «يرى».
﴿جميعا﴾: ḥāl. The clause «ولو يرى الذين...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وأن الله شديد العذاب﴾: conjoined to what preceded; the apodosis (jawāb) of «لو» is omitted, i.e.: "you would have seen a wonder, and there would have been from them such remorse and anguish as defies description."

muyesser-irab:166-166.t:
﴿إذ﴾: an adverb (ẓarf), a badal (substitute) from the earlier «إذ» in His words, Exalted is He: «إذ يرون».
﴿تبرأ الذين﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause «تبرأ» is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it.
﴿اتبعوا﴾: a past verb, passive (built for that whose agent is not named), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿من الذين اتبعوا﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تبرأ»; «اتبعوا» is a past verb in the active voice, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of «الذين», with no grammatical position.
﴿ورأوا﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) or a conjunction, and «رأوا» is a verb and its fāʿil.
﴿العذاب﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) with «قد» implied, i.e.: they disowned them while seeing the punishment; or it is conjoined to the clause «تبرأ».
﴿وتقطعت بهم الأسباب﴾: conjoined to what preceded.

muyesser-irab:167-167.t:
﴿وقال﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «قال» is a past verb.
﴿الذين﴾: fāʿil (agent).
﴿اتبعوا﴾: the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; «اتبعوا» is a past verb, passive (built for that whose agent is not named), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). [Translator's note: so in the source; in this verse «الذين اتَّبَعوا» are the followers, so the verb is in the active voice with the wāw as fāʿil, as the source itself parsed «من الذين اتبعوا» in the previous verse.]
﴿لو﴾: a non-jussive conditional particle containing the sense of wishing (tamannī).
﴿أن لنا كرة﴾: «أن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); «لنا» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted fronted khabar (predicate), and «كرة» is its postponed noun (ism); «أن» and what falls within its scope is the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿فنتبرأ﴾: the fāʾ is causal (sababiyya); «نتبرأ» is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an «أن» concealed after the causal fāʾ preceded by the wish contained in «لو»; its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "we" (نحن); «أن» and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e.: "if a return for us were established, and [thus] our disowning of them."
﴿منهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «نتبرأ».
﴿كما تبرءوا﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being: "so that we disown them with a disowning like their disowning"; «ما» is maṣdariyya, «تبرءوا» is a past verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; the clause «تبرءوا» is the ṣila of the maṣdariyya «ما», with no grammatical position, and the interpreted maṣdar formed from the maṣdariyya «ما» and the verb «تبرءوا» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿منا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «تبرءوا».
﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar placed before its governor, i.e.: "with a showing like that Allah shows them"; «ذلك»: «ذا» is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address.
﴿يريهم﴾: an imperfect verb; the seeing here may be visual, in which case it takes two objects, the first being the pronoun and the second «أعمالهم»; or it may be mental (qalbiyya) — and this is perhaps preferable — in which case it takes three objects.
﴿الله﴾: fāʿil.
