﴿أعمالهم﴾: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿حسرات﴾: third mafʿūl bihi, or a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿عليهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of «حسرات».
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «ما» is the negating Ḥijāzī «ما», which acts like «ليس».
﴿هم﴾: the noun of the Ḥijāzī «ما».
﴿بخارجين﴾: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; «خارجين» is the khabar of the Ḥijāzī «ما», accusative in position and genitive in form by the bāʾ.
﴿من النار﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «خارجين».

muyesser-irab:168-168.t:
﴿يا أيها الناس﴾: «يا» is a vocative particle for one at middle distance; «أي» is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of the accusative; «ها» is for drawing attention (tanbīh), and «الناس» is an adjective (ṣifa) of «أي».
﴿كلوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿مما﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «كلوا».
﴿في الأرض﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted [verb that is the] ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the relative clause has no grammatical position.
﴿حلالا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «كلوا», or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ما».
﴿طيبا﴾: an adjective.
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «لا» is prohibitive (nāhiya).
﴿تتبعوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لا», and the wāw is the fāʿil.
﴿خطوات﴾: mafʿūl bihi, the sign of its accusative being the kasra, because it is a sound feminine plural.
﴿الشيطان﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿إنه﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun (ism).
﴿لكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl, because it was originally an adjective of «عدو».
﴿عدو﴾: the nominative khabar (predicate) of «إن».
﴿مبين﴾: an adjective of «عدو»; the vocative clause and what follows it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The clause «إنه» and what follows it has no grammatical position, because it gives the reason for the prohibition of following the footsteps of Satan in that.

muyesser-irab:169-169.t:
﴿إنما﴾: a restraining [particle] and a restrained [one] (kāffa wa-makfūfa), rendered inoperative.
﴿يأمركم﴾: a verb, its latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) referring back to Satan, and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿بالسوء﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يأمركم»; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿والفحشاء﴾: conjoined to His words «بالسوء».
﴿وأن تقولوا﴾: the maṣdar formed from «أن» and what falls within its scope (interpreted maṣdar) is also conjoined to «السوء».
﴿على الله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «تقولوا».
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, the object of «تقولوا».
﴿لا﴾: negating (nāfiya).
﴿تعلمون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of «ما».

muyesser-irab:170-170.t:
﴿وإذا﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and «إذا» is an adverb (ẓarf) for future time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قالوا».
﴿قيل﴾: a past verb, passive (built for that whose agent is not named).
﴿لهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «قيل».
﴿اتبعوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the verbal clause is in the position of the nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and it is the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿أنزل الله﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of «ما».
﴿قالوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition (jawāb sharṭ ghayr jāzim).
﴿بل﴾: a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction.
﴿نتبع﴾: an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil is "we" (نحن); the clause is conjoined to an implied clause, i.e.: "we do not follow what Allah has sent down; rather, we follow."
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ألفينا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun.
﴿عليه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun in the place of the accusative as the second object of «ألفينا».
﴿آباءنا﴾: the first object of «ألفينا».
﴿أولو﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī), the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). «لو» is conditional.
﴿كان آباؤهم﴾: «كان» is a deficient (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, and «آباؤهم» is its noun (ism).
﴿لا﴾: negating (nāfiya).
﴿يعقلون﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the negated clause is the khabar (predicate) of «كان», and the clause «كان» has no grammatical position, because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) clause, the apodosis being omitted because it is understood. It has been said: «لو» is not conditional; rather, it is meant to generalise over all circumstances.
﴿شيئا﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb).
﴿ولا يهتدون﴾: the clause is conjoined to the clause «لا يعقلون».

muyesser-irab:88-88.t:
﴿وقالوا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and قالوا is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿قلوبنا﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿نا﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct).
﴿غلف﴾: the khabar (predicate) of قلوبنا; the nominal clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). The clause ﴿قالوا قلوبنا...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿بل﴾: a particle of conjunction and of digression (iḍrāb).
﴿لعنهم الله﴾: a past verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil.
﴿بكفرهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) لعنهم, i.e.: because of their disbelief.
﴿فقليلا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and ﴿قليلا﴾ stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is the adjective of the omitted maṣdar, i.e.: تؤمنون إيمانا قليلا (you believe with little belief) [Translator's note: so in the source, with تؤمنون in the second person, whereas the verse has ﴿يؤمنون﴾].
﴿ما﴾: connective (ṣila), to emphasize the paucity.
﴿يؤمنون﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿قليلا ما يؤمنون﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:89-89.t:
﴿ولما﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and لما is adverbial (ẓarfiyya) in the sense of حين (when), or it is a particle of mere linkage; it contains the sense of condition.
﴿جاءهم﴾: a verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿كتاب﴾: fāʿil (agent).
﴿من عند الله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of كتاب; the clause is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it if we parse لما as adverbial, or has no grammatical position if it is linking; the apodosis (jawāb) of لما is omitted, its implied form being: كذبوا (they denied) or the like.
﴿مصدق﴾: also a naʿt of كتاب.
﴿لما﴾: the lām is a preposition, and ما is a relative noun in the position of the genitive by the lām; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to مصدق.
﴿معهم﴾: an adverb of place attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾; the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. The clause ﴿لما جاءهم كتاب ...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وكانوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and what is conjoined to is the omitted apodosis; كان is a past, defective, abrogating (nāsikh) verb, and the wāw is its noun (ism).
﴿من قبل﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿يستفتحون﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the verbal clause is in the position of the accusative as the khabar (predicate) of كانوا.
﴿على الذين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يستفتحون.
﴿كفروا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun.
﴿فلما﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and لما is temporal (ḥīniyya) or linking.
﴿جاءهم﴾: a verb and its mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, fāʿil.
﴿عرفوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿كفروا به﴾: a verbal clause with no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of لما.
﴿فلعنة﴾: the fāʾ is for causation (taʿlīl), and لعنة is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause has no grammatical position, because it is in the status of a resumptive clause.
﴿الله﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct).
﴿على الكافرين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar of لعنة.

muyesser-irab:90-90.t:
﴿بئسما﴾: بئس: a past verb for the expression of censure (inshāʾ al-dhamm), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); and ﴿ما﴾: an indefinite noun qualified [by what follows], in the sense of شيء (a thing), in the position of the accusative as tamyīz (specification).
﴿اشتروا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause ﴿اشتروا﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ما﴾.
﴿به﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) اشتروا.
﴿أنفسهم﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿أن يكفروا﴾: أن together with what falls within its scope is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) which is a mubtadaʾ (subject), because it is the one specified for censure (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm), and the clause of بئس is the fronted khabar (predicate). Or the interpreted maṣdar is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ.
﴿بما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, and ما is a relative noun in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يكفروا.
﴿أنزل الله﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿بغيا﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); it is the reason for اشتروا, or the reason for يكفروا.
﴿أن ينزل الله﴾: أن and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar, accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e.: بغوا لإنزال الله (they transgressed because of Allah's sending down).
﴿من فضله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ينزل.
﴿على من يشاء﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun also attached to ينزل; يشاء is a verb whose fāʿil is latent.
﴿من عباده﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) that clarifies (mubayyina) لمن يشاء.
﴿فباءوا بغضب﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, باءوا is a verb and its fāʿil, and ﴿بغضب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl from the fāʿil of باءوا, which is the wāw of the plural, i.e.: باءوا ملتبسين بغضب (they returned laden with wrath).
﴿على غضب﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt of غضب, i.e.: بغضب كائن على غضب (with wrath that is upon wrath).
﴿وللكافرين﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and للكافرين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar.
﴿عذاب﴾: a delayed mubtadaʾ.
﴿مهين﴾: naʿt of عذاب; the clause ﴿وللكافرين...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:91-91.t:
﴿وإذا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and إذا is an adverb of future time, putting its condition in the genitive [by annexation] and accusative by its apodosis (jawāb).
﴿قيل﴾: a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), or the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿لهم﴾; the clause قيل is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it.
﴿لهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) قيل.
﴿آمنوا﴾: an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause آمنوا is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying.
﴿بما أنزل الله﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, and ما is a relative noun in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ; the clause ﴿أنزل الله﴾ has no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿إذا قيل لهم آمنوا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿قالوا﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
﴿نؤمن﴾: the clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying.
﴿بما أنزل﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to نؤمن.
﴿علينا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنزل.
﴿ويكفرون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).
﴿بما﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يكفرون.
﴿وراءه﴾: an adverb attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿وهو الحق﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, هو is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and الحق its khabar (predicate); the clause of mubtadaʾ and khabar is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿مصدقا﴾: an emphatic ḥāl (ḥāl muʾakkida), because the Quran's confirming is a permanent attribute that does not shift.
﴿لما﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿مصدقًا﴾.
﴿معهم﴾: an adverb of place attached to the omitted ṣila of ﴿ما﴾; the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿قل﴾: an imperative verb.
﴿فلم﴾: the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa ("disclosing") fāʾ, because it discloses an implied condition, i.e.: إن كانت دعواكم صحيحة فلم تقتلون (if your claim is true, then why do you kill…); the lām is a preposition, and ما is an interrogative noun in the position of the genitive by the lām, i.e.: for what thing? The alif of ما was dropped to distinguish it from the declarative ما; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تقتلون.
﴿تقتلون﴾: an imperfect verb.
﴿أنبياء الله﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿من قبل﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿إن كنتم مؤمنين﴾: إن is conditional, and كان is a defective past verb in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the tāʾ is its noun (ism), and the clause تقتلون is its khabar [Translator's note: so in the source; the khabar of كنتم here is ﴿مؤمنين﴾, and «the clause تقتلون» appears to be a slip]; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted because what precedes indicates it, i.e.: فلم تقتلون؟ (then why do you kill?).

muyesser-irab:92-92.t:
﴿ولقد﴾: the wāw is resumptive, the lām is [the lām of] the response to an omitted oath, and قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq).
﴿جاءكم موسى﴾: a verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent).
﴿بالبينات﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) جاءكم. The clause ﴿لقد جاءكم موسى بالبينات﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿ثم اتخذتم العجل﴾: ثم is a conjunction for sequence with delay, اتخذتم is a verb and its fāʿil, and العجل is mafʿūl bihi.
﴿من بعده﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وأنتم ظالمون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), أنتم is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and ظالمون its khabar (predicate); the clause is accusative as a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:93-93.t:
﴿وإذ﴾: the wāw: a conjunction; and إذ: a noun of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative, conjoined to ﴿نعمتي﴾ in the saying of Allah the Exalted: ﴿اذكروا نعمتي﴾.
﴿أخذنا ميثاقكم﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent), and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct).
﴿ورفعنا﴾: conjoined to أخذنا, or circumstantial (ḥāliyya).
﴿فوقكم﴾: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) رفعنا.
﴿الطور﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿خذوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the omission of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the object of an omitted saying, and the clause of saying is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: قائلين لكم (saying to you).
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi.
﴿آتيناكم﴾: a verb, its fāʿil, and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿بقوة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿واسمعوا﴾: conjoined to what preceded.
﴿قالوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿سمعنا وعصينا﴾: the two clauses are the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿وأشربوا﴾: the wāw is circumstantial or a conjunction, and أشربوا is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿في قلوبهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أشربوا.
﴿العجل﴾: second mafʿūl bihi, on the assumption of a muḍāf, i.e.: حب العجل (the love of the calf).
﴿بكفرهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أشربوا; the bāʾ is causal, i.e.: because of their disbelief.
﴿قل﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿بئسما﴾: بئس: a past verb for the expression of censure (inshāʾ al-dhamm), indeclinable on the fatḥa, and its fāʿil is latent; the clause of verb and fāʿil is in the position of the nominative as the fronted khabar (predicate) of an omitted delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), which is the one specified for censure (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm); and ﴿ما﴾: an indefinite noun qualified [by what follows], in the sense of شيء (a thing), in the position of the accusative as tamyīz (specification).
﴿يأمركم﴾: an imperfect verb, a latent fāʿil, and mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿يأمركم﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ما﴾.
﴿به﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يأمركم.
﴿إيمانكم﴾: fāʿil, and the pronoun is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿بئسما﴾ is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying.
﴿إن كنتم مؤمنين﴾: a condition and its verb; the apodosis (jawāb) is omitted, its implied form being: فلم فعلتم ذلك (then why did you do that); كان is a past, defective, abrogating (nāsikh) verb, the tāʾ is its noun (ism), and مؤمنين is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:94-94.t:
﴿قل﴾: an imperative verb; its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being: أنت; the clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿إن﴾: conditional, making two verbs jussive.
﴿كانت﴾: a defective past verb in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).
﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of كان.
﴿الدار﴾: its delayed noun (ism).
﴿الآخرة﴾: naʿt (adjective) of الدار.
﴿عند الله﴾: an adverb of place attached to خالصة.
﴿خالصة﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial) from الدار.
﴿من دون الناس﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl that emphasizes the [first] ḥāl.
﴿فتمنوا﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) because the speech is a request; تمنوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis.
﴿الموت﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿إن﴾: a jussive conditional particle.
﴿كنتم﴾: a defective past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun.
﴿صادقين﴾: its khabar; كنتم is in the position of the jussive as the protasis, and the apodosis is omitted, i.e.: فتمنوا الموت (then wish for death).

muyesser-irab:95-95.t:
﴿ولن﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and لن is a particle of negation, of the accusative, and of the future.
﴿يتمنوه﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by لن, the sign of its accusative being the omission of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿أبدا﴾: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) يتمنوه.
﴿بما﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are also attached to يتمنوه.
﴿قدمت أيديهم﴾: a verbal clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما; the referring pronoun is omitted, i.e.: قدمته أيديهم (what their hands sent forth).
﴿والله عليم﴾: the wāw is resumptive, الله is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and عليم is the khabar (predicate).
﴿بالظالمين﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to عليم; the clause ﴿والله عليم...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:96-96.t:
﴿ولتجدنهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, the lām is the response to an omitted oath, and تجدنهم is an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; its fāʿil (agent) is a pronoun necessarily latent (mustatir) in it, its implied form being: أنت; and the hāʾ is its first mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿أحرص الناس﴾: its second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿على حياة﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أحرص.
﴿ومن الذين أشركوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the conjunction here is construed according to the meaning; the implied form is: أحرص من الذين أشركوا (more eager than those who associate partners).
﴿يود أحدهم﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial), or resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿لو يعمر﴾: لو is maṣdarī and non-governing; it and the verb after it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e.: يود التعمير (he wishes long life); يعمر is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is optionally latent in it, its implied form being: هو.
﴿ألف سنة﴾: an adverb of time attached to يعمر.
﴿وما هو﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), ما is the Ḥijāzī negative ما, which operates like ليس, and هو is the noun (ism) of ما.
﴿بمزحزحه﴾: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition, and مزحزحه is genitive (majrūr) in form and accusative in position, as the khabar (predicate) of ما.
﴿من العذاب﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to محزحزحه [Translator's note: so spelled in the source; read مزحزحه].
﴿أن يعمر﴾: أن together with what falls within its scope is interpreted as a maṣdar that is the fāʿil of مزحزحه, because it is an active participle. The pronoun in His saying ﴿وما هو﴾ refers back to أحدهم; it has also been said: it refers to the maṣdar indicated by يعمر, i.e.: وما التعمير بمزحزحه (and long life will not remove him), and His saying ﴿أن يعمر﴾ is a badal (substitute) from it.
﴿والله بصير بما يعملون﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position, or the wāw is relative (mawṣūla), or maṣdarī [Translator's note: so in the source; presumably «ما» (in ﴿بما﴾) is meant: ما is a relative noun or maṣdarī, not the wāw].

muyesser-irab:97-97.t:
﴿قل﴾: an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is: أنت.
﴿من﴾: a jussive conditional noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause قل is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿كان﴾: a defective past verb in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); its noun (ism) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun referring to مَن.
﴿عدوا﴾: its khabar (predicate).
﴿لجبريل﴾: the lām is a preposition, and جبريل is a noun in the genitive by the lām, the sign of its genitive being the fatḥa in place of the kasra, because it is a foreign proper name; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿عدوًّا﴾.
﴿فإنه﴾: the fāʾ conjoins to the omitted apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), serving as its justification; the implied form is: فليمت غيظًا (then let him die of rage), or: فلا موجب لعداوته (then there is no cause for his enmity); إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and the hāʾ is its noun.
﴿نزله﴾: a verb, a latent fāʿil, and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the pronoun refers to the Quran, and the clause نزله is the khabar of كان [Translator's note: so in the source; the clause نزله is the khabar of إنّ (in ﴿فإنه﴾), not of كان].
﴿على قلبك﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to نزله.
﴿بإذن الله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿مصدقا﴾: a second ḥāl.
﴿لما﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿مصدقًا﴾.
﴿بين يديه﴾: the adverb is attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿وهدى وبشرى﴾: both conjoined to ﴿مصدقًا﴾.
﴿للمؤمنين﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to بشرى, or to an omitted naʿt; the khabar of من is the protasis and the omitted apodosis.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿يا أيها﴾: «يا» is a vocative particle, and «أي» is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb).
﴿الناس﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of «أي».
﴿اعبدوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the omission of the nūn, because its imperfect is one of the five verbs; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿ربكم﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the kāf is an attached pronoun in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by annexation.
﴿الذي﴾: a relative noun, a naʿt of «ربكم».
﴿خلقكم﴾: a past verb; the kāf is the object, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو).
﴿والذين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «الذين» is a relative noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the kāf, i.e.: "and He created those who" (وخلق الذين).
﴿من قبلكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿لعلكم﴾: «لعل» is a particle of hope (tarajjī) and of the accusative, and the kāf is its noun.
﴿تتقون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the wāw is the fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of «لعل». The clause «لعلكم تتقون» is a clause with no grammatical position, because its place relative to what precedes it is that of the consequence relative to the condition; or it is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), i.e.: "in the state of your hoping for piety and aspiring to it".

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿الذي﴾: a relative noun in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), a second naʿt (adjective) of «ربكم».
﴿جعل﴾: a past verb; the fāʿil (agent) is a pronoun latent (mustatir) in it, its implied form being "he" (هو); the verbal clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿لكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally a naʿt of «فراشًا» and was then brought forward.
﴿الأرض﴾: the first object of «جعل», if it is from «الجعل» in the sense of transformation (taghyīr).
﴿فراشا﴾: the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). If «جعل» is in the sense of creation, then «فراشًا» is parsed as an interpreted (muʾawwala) ḥāl.
﴿والسماء﴾: conjoined to His word «الأرض».
﴿بناء﴾: conjoined to «فراشًا».
﴿وأنزل﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «أنزل» is conjoined to His word «جعل».
﴿من السماء﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «أنزل».
﴿ماء﴾: the object of «أنزل».
﴿فأخرج﴾: conjoined to «أنزل».
﴿به﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «أخرج».
﴿من الثمرات﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, because it was originally a naʿt and was brought forward.
﴿رزقا﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second naʿt of «رزقًا».
﴿فلا﴾: the fāʾ is causal, or it is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa ("the disclosing fāʾ"), because it discloses an implied condition, i.e.: «If what has been mentioned is the case, then do not make…». «لا» is prohibitive.
﴿تجعلوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لا», the sign of its jussive being the omission of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil. The clause «لا تجعلوا» is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied non-jussive condition. The implied conditional clause and its apodosis together have no grammatical position, because they are resumptive.
﴿لله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted [word] in the place of the second object of «تجعلوا».
﴿أندادا﴾: the first object of «تجعلوا».
﴿وأنتم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «أنتم» is a detached pronoun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿تعلمون﴾: an imperfect verb, the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the verbal clause is in the position of a nominative, the khabar (predicate) of «أنتم», and the nominal clause is in the place of an accusative as a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿وإن﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and «إن» is conditional, making two verbs jussive.
﴿كنتم﴾: «كان» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb [of kāna and its sisters], and the tāʾ is its noun; the defective verb is in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).
﴿في ريب﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of «كنتم».
﴿مما﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «ريب»; «ما» is a relative noun.
﴿نزلنا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn; «نا» is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), fāʿil (agent); the verbal clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿على عبدنا﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «نزلنا»; the resumptive pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, i.e. "We sent it down" (نزلناه).
﴿فأتوا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), because the clause is a request (ṭalabiyya), which is not fit to be a condition; «ائتوا» is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the omission of the nūn, because its imperfect is one of the five verbs; the wāw is an attached pronoun in the position of a nominative, fāʿil; the clause is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis.
﴿بسورة﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «ائتوا».
﴿من مثله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun whose attachment depends on what the pronoun refers to: either it refers to the Quran, in which case they are attached to an omitted naʿt of «سورة»; or it refers to «عبدنا», in which case they are attached to His word «فائتوا».
﴿وادعوا﴾: conjoined to His word «فأتوا»; the wāw is the fāʿil.
﴿شهداءكم﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «ادعوا»; the kāf is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by annexation.
﴿من دون الله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «ادعوا», or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from His word «شهداءكم», the implied form being: "apart from Allah the Exalted" or "other than Allah". The clause «إن كنتم...» is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿إن﴾: conditional.
﴿كنتم﴾: «كان» is a defective past verb in the position of a jussive as the protasis, and the tāʾ is its noun.
﴿صادقين﴾: its khabar; and the apodosis [is omitted], i.e.: "then do that" (فافعلوا ذلك).

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿فإن﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and «إن» is conditional.
﴿لم﴾: a particle of negation, conversion [of the imperfect to past meaning], and jussive.
﴿تفعلوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لم», the sign of its jussive being the omission of the nūn. The clause «إن لم تفعلوا» is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿ولن﴾: the wāw is parenthetical, and «لن» is a particle of negation, of the accusative, and of the future.
﴿تفعلوا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by «لن», the sign of its accusative being the omission of the nūn; the clause «ولن تفعلوا» is parenthetical, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿فاتقوا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «اتقوا» is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿النار﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿التي﴾: a relative noun in the position of an accusative, a naʿt (adjective) of «النار».
﴿وقودها﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); «ها» is an attached pronoun in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by annexation.
﴿الناس﴾: khabar (predicate).
﴿والحجارة﴾: conjoined to «الناس»; the nominal clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿أعدت﴾: a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a pronoun optionally latent (mustatir) in it, its implied form being "it/she" (هي).
﴿للكافرين﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أعدت»; the verbal clause is in the position of an accusative, a permanent (lāzima) ḥāl (circumstantial) from «النار».

muyesser-irab:275-275.t:
﴿الذين يأكلون الربا﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. الذين is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause يأكلون الربا has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿لا يقومون إلا كما يقوم الذي يتخبطه الشيطان من المس﴾: ﴿لا﴾ is negative; ﴿يقومون﴾ is a nominative imperfect verb, the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿لا يقومون﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of الذين; ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of restriction. ﴿كما﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مِثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being "they do not stand except with a standing like the standing of the one whom Satan has struck"; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdarī; ﴿يقوم﴾ is an imperfect verb; ﴿الذي﴾ is a relative noun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar formed from maṣdarī ﴿ما﴾ and the verb ﴿يقوم﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿يقوم﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the particle-relative ﴿ما﴾; the clause ﴿يتخبطه الشيطان﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun; and ﴿من المس﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) يقومون, i.e. "they do not stand, on account of the touch, except as the epileptic stands", or attached to يقوم, i.e. "as the epileptic stands up from his madness". It has also been said: يتخبطه is for emphasis.
﴿ذلك بأنهم قالوا﴾: the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ, the reference being to the punishment that befalls them; the bāʾ is a preposition; أن is an abrogating particle (of the sisters of inna), and the hāʾ is its noun; the clause قالوا [is its khabar], and أن with its noun and its khabar is to be interpreted as a maṣdar in the genitive by the bāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar of ﴿ذلك﴾, i.e. "because of their saying"; the demonstrative clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; and قالوا is a past verb indeclinable on the ḍamma, the wāw being the fāʿil. [Translator's note: the Arabic is elliptical here: «وجملة قالوا، وأن واسمها خبرها في تأويل مصدر…»; it is rendered according to its evident sense.]
﴿إنما البيع مثل الربا﴾: إنما is (inna) restrained by mā (kāffa wa-makfūfa) and inoperative; البيع is a mubtadaʾ; مثل is the khabar of البيع; الربا is muḍāf ilayhi, the sign of its genitive being the implied (muqaddar) kasra; and the clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿وأحل الله البيع وحرم الربا﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, with قد implied after it; أحل is a past verb; the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil; البيع is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); حرم الربا is conjoined; and the clause after the wāw is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فمن جاءه موعظة من ربه﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; من is a conditional noun that puts the verb in the jussive (majzūm), a mubtadaʾ; جاءه is a verb and its object, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); موعظة is the fāʿil; and من ربه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of موعظة.
﴿فانتهى﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; انتهى is conjoined to جاءه, and its fāʿil is "he".
﴿فله ما سلف﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar; ما is a relative noun, a postponed mubtadaʾ; and the clause سلف is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿فمن جاءه موعظة...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وأمره إلى الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, or circumstantial; أمره is a mubtadaʾ; إلى الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar; the clause فله ما سلف is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis; and the protasis together with its apodosis is the khabar of من.
﴿ومن عاد فأولئك أصحاب النار﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; من is a conditional noun that puts the verb in the jussive, a mubtadaʾ; عاد is a past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis; the fāʾ is connective; the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ, and أصحاب النار is the khabar; the clause joined to the fāʾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis; and the protasis together with its apodosis is the khabar of من.
﴿هم فيها خالدون﴾: هم is a mubtadaʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿خالدون﴾; خالدون is the khabar of ﴿هم﴾; and the nominal clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:276-276.t:
﴿يمحق الله الربا﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; يمحق is an imperfect verb; the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil (agent), and الربا is its object.
﴿ويربي الصدقات﴾: conjoined to يمحق الله الربا.
﴿والله لا يحب كل كفار أثيم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; الله is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause لا يحب is the khabar (predicate); كل is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); كفار is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and أثيم is a naʿt (adjective) of كفار. The clause ﴿والله لا يحب...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:277-277.t:
﴿إن الذين آمنوا﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. إن is an abrogating particle (of the sisters of inna); الذين is its noun; and the clause آمنوا has no [grammatical] position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. [Translator's note: the source reads «لا محل» without «من الإعراب».]
﴿وعملوا الصالحات وأقاموا الصلاة وآتوا الزكاة﴾: the three clauses are conjoined to the ṣila and fall within its scope.
﴿لهم أجرهم عند ربهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); أجرهم is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the adverb is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and the nominal clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of إن.
﴿ولا خوف﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is negative; خوف is a mubtadaʾ — it is permissible to begin with it although it is indefinite because the negation precedes it.
﴿عليهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ.
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿لا﴾ is negative.
﴿هم﴾: an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ.
﴿يحزنون﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent); and the clause ﴿يحزنون﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ﴿هم﴾.

muyesser-irab:278-278.t:
﴿يا أيها﴾: يا is a vocative particle; أي is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative; and ها is for drawing attention.
﴿الذين﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾.
﴿آمنوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿اتقوا الله﴾: an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وذروا ما بقي من الربا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ذروا is an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; ما is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause بقي has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) بقي, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of بقي.
﴿إن كنتم مؤمنين﴾: إن is conditional; كنتم is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the tāʾ is its noun, and مؤمنين is its khabar (predicate); the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. "then leave [it]"; and the clause ﴿إن كنتم مؤمنين﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:279-279.t:
﴿فإن لم تفعلوا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إن is conditional; لم is a particle of negation, of conversion (to the past) and of the jussive; تفعلوا is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by لم, and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).
﴿فأذنوا بحرب من الله ورسوله﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); ائذنوا is an imperative verb; بحرب is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ائذنوا; من الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of حرب; رسوله is conjoined to the Name of Majesty; and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. The clause ﴿فإن لم تفعلوا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. [Translator's note: the source parses the verb in the form «ائذنوا», i.e. without the fāʾ, from the reading ﴿فَأْذَنُوا﴾.]
﴿وإن تبتم فلكم رءوس أموالكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is conditional; تبتم is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), in the position of the jussive as the protasis; the fāʾ connects the apodosis; لكم is attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); رءوس أموالكم is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis.
﴿لا تظلمون ولا تظلمون﴾: the clause لا تَظلمون is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), and it is in the active voice; the clause لا تُظلمون is conjoined to it, and it is in the passive voice.

muyesser-irab:280-280.t:
﴿وإن كان ذو عسرة﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إن is conditional; كان is a complete (tāmm) past verb meaning "occurred, came to be"; ذو is its fāʿil (agent), the sign of its nominative being the wāw, because it is one of the five nouns; and عسرة is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿فنظرة إلى ميسرة﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); نظرة is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "then the ruling is a deferment"; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) نظرة, or to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of it; and the clause joined to the fāʾ is in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis. The clause ﴿وإن كان ذو...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وأن تصدقوا خير لكم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from أن and what falls within its scope is a nominative mubtadaʾ; خير is the khabar; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿خير﴾, because it is an elative (ism tafḍīl) not formed according to rule; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن كنتم تعلمون﴾: إن is conditional; كنتم is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; the tāʾ is its noun; the clause تعلمون is in the position of the nominative as its khabar; the apodosis is omitted; and the conditional clause ﴿إن كنتم تعلمون...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:220-220.t:
﴿في الدنيا والآخرة﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) تتفكرون or to يبين.
﴿ويسألونك عن اليتامى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; يسألونك is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يسألونك.
﴿قل﴾: an imperative verb with a latent (mustatir) agent; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إصلاح﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject); what permits beginning with it [as an indefinite] is its being qualified by the preposition and its genitive noun.
﴿لهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are a naʿt (adjective) of إصلاح.
﴿خير﴾: khabar (predicate) of إصلاح; the nominal clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿وإن﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and إن is conditional.
﴿تخالطوهم﴾: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the sign of its being jussive (majzūm) is the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فإخوانكم﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); إخوانكم is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "then they are your brothers" (فهم إخوانكم); the nominal clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. Something omitted must be implied, i.e. "then that is permitted to you" (فلكم ذلك), and then He gave the reason for it with His saying: "for they are your brothers" (فهم إخوانكم). The clause ﴿وإن تخالطوهم فإخوانكم﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿والله﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the wāw is mubtadaʾ. [Translator's note: so in the source; what is evidently meant is that the Name of Majesty (لفظ الجلالة) الله is the mubtadaʾ.]
﴿يعلم﴾: the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the fāʿil of يعلم is a latent pronoun referring to Allah the Exalted.
﴿المفسد﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿من المصلح﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يعلم, because it implies the meaning of "distinguishes" (يميز). The clause ﴿والله يعلم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولو﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and لو is conditional.
﴿شاء الله﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the object of the willing is omitted, its implied form being "your hardship" (إعناتكم).
﴿لأعنتكم﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis of لو; أعنتكم is a verb, a latent agent and a mafʿūl bihi. The clause لأعنتكم has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. The clause ﴿ولو شاء الله﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن الله﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism).
﴿عزيز حكيم﴾: the khabar of إن; the clause has no grammatical position, because it serves as a giving of the reason (taʿlīl).

muyesser-irab:221-221.t:
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and لا is prohibitive (nāhiya). [Translator's note: the source misspells استئنافية as «اسئتنافية».]
﴿تنكحوا﴾: an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by لا; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿المشركات﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); the sign of its being accusative is the kasra, because it is a sound feminine plural.
﴿حتى يؤمن﴾: حتى is a particle of limit and a preposition; يؤمن is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural, and it is in the position of accusative by an implied أن after حتى; the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil. The implied أن and the verb after it are to be interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) made genitive by ﴿حتى﴾, and the preposition ﴿حتى﴾ with the interpreted maṣdar is attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تنكحوا﴾. The clause ﴿ولا تنكحوا المشركات﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولأمة﴾: the wāw is resumptive, the lām is of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ), and أمة is mubtadaʾ (subject); beginning with an indefinite is permissible because it is qualified.
﴿مؤمنة﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of أمة.
﴿خير﴾: khabar (predicate).
﴿من مشركة﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to خير.
﴿ولو﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (lil-ḥāl), and لو is conditional.
﴿أعجبتكم﴾: a past verb; its agent is latent, its implied form being "she" (هي), referring to the polytheist woman; the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi. The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the context, the implied form being: "even if she pleases you, do not marry her" (ولو أعجبتكم فلا تنكحوها), or: "even if she pleases you, the believing woman is better than her" (ولو أعجبتكم فالمؤمنة خير منها). The clause ﴿لو أعجبتكم﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial). The clause ﴿ولأمة مؤمنة خير...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is prohibitive.
﴿تنكحوا﴾: an imperfect verb made jussive by لا; the wāw is the fāʿil.
﴿المشركين﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿حتى يؤمنوا﴾: حتى is a particle of limit and a preposition; يؤمنوا is an imperfect verb made accusative by an implied أن after حتى; the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the imperfect verb after it are to be interpreted as a maṣdar made genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿تنكحوا﴾.
﴿ولعبد﴾: the wāw is resumptive, the lām is of inception, and عبد is mubtadaʾ; beginning with an indefinite is permissible because it is qualified.
﴿مؤمن﴾: a naʿt of عبد.
﴿خير﴾: khabar.
﴿من مشرك﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to خير.
﴿ولو﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, and لو is conditional.
﴿أعجبكم﴾: a past verb; its agent is latent, its implied form being "he" (هو), referring to the polytheist man; the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi. The apodosis is omitted because it is known, the implied form being: "even if he pleases you, do not marry [your women to] him" (ولو أعجبكم فلا تنكحوه), or: "even if he pleases you, the believer is better than him" (ولو أعجبكم فالمؤمن خير منه). The clause ﴿ولو أعجبكم﴾ is a ḥāl. The clause ﴿ولعبد مؤمن...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿أولئك﴾: the demonstrative is mubtadaʾ.
﴿يدعون إلى النار﴾: the clause is the khabar of the demonstrative. The clause ﴿أولئك يدعون إلى النار﴾ is resumptive in the explanatory sense (istiʾnāf bayānī), giving the reason for the prohibition of marrying polytheist women and of giving [women] in marriage to polytheist men, so it has no grammatical position.
﴿والله يدعو إلى الجنة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿الله﴾ is mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿يدعو﴾ is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; ﴿إلى الجنة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يدعو﴾; the nominal clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause ﴿أولئك يدعون إلى النار﴾.
﴿والمغفرة﴾: conjoined to الجنة.
﴿بإذنه﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿ويبين آياته﴾: conjoined to يدعو; آياته is mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of its being accusative being the kasra in place of the fatḥa.
﴿للناس﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يبين﴾.
﴿لعلهم﴾: لعل is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and the hāʾ is its noun (ism).
﴿يتذكرون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the sign of its being nominative is the retention of the nūn; the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar of لعل, and the clause of hope is a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:222-222.t:
﴿ويسألونك عن المحيض﴾: speech conjoined to the preceding rulings; ﴿عن المحيض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) يسألونك.
﴿قل﴾: an imperative verb; its agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿هو﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿أذى﴾: khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of accusative.
﴿فاعتزلوا﴾: the fāʾ is of consequence (lil-tafrīʿ); اعتزلوا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent). The clause ﴿اعتزلوا﴾ is in the position of accusative, being conjoined to the object of the speech; or the fāʾ is in the apodosis of an implied condition, the implied form being: "if that is so, then keep away" (إذا كان كذلك فاعتزلوا), so that the clause ﴿اعتزلوا﴾ is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position.
﴿النساء﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿في المحيض﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "being in the state of menstruation" (متلبسات بالمحيض).
﴿فإذا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; إذا is an adverb for future time, governing its condition in the genitive and made accusative by its apodosis.
﴿تطهرن﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural; the nūn is an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as the fāʿil; the clause تطهرن is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).
﴿فأتوهن﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis of إذا; أتوهن is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
﴿من حيث﴾: من is a preposition; حيث is an adverb of place, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of genitive by من; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أتوهن.
﴿أمركم الله﴾: a past verb, a mafʿūl bihi and a fāʿil; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation.
﴿إن الله﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism).
﴿يحب﴾: an imperfect verb; its agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "He" (هو), referring to Allah the Exalted; the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إن.
﴿التوابين﴾: mafʿūl bihi. The clause of إن and what follows it gives the reason (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.
﴿ويحب المتطهرين﴾: conjoined to the clause يحب التوابين.

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿وبشر﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; it conjoins the clause of the reward of the believers to the clause of the punishment of the disbelievers; the fāʿil (agent) of «بشر» is a pronoun necessarily latent (mustatir) in it, its implied form being "you" (أنت).
﴿الذين﴾: a relative noun in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿آمنوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿وعملوا﴾: conjoined to «آمنوا», falling within the scope of the ṣila; the wāw is the fāʿil.
﴿الصالحات﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the kasra in place of the fatḥa, because it is a sound feminine plural.
﴿أن﴾: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); it, together with what it governs, is in the place of an accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ).
﴿لهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of «أن».
﴿جنات﴾: the postponed noun of «أن», accusative, the sign of its accusative being the kasra in place of the fatḥa, because it is a sound feminine plural.
﴿تجري﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, its appearance prevented by heaviness.
﴿من تحتها﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «تجري».
﴿الأنهار﴾: fāʿil, nominative. The clause «تجري من تحتها الأنهار» is in the position of an accusative, a naʿt (adjective) of «جنات».
﴿كلما رزقوا﴾: «كلما»: «كلَّ» stands in for an adverb of time containing the meaning of condition, attached to «قالوا»; «ما» is temporal maṣdariyya; the clause «رزقوا» is a clause with no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the particle-relative «ما»; the maṣdariyya «ما» together with what it governs is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), genitive (majrūr) by annexation, the implied form being: "every provision" (كلَّ رزقٍ), and this involves the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "every time of provision" (كلَّ وقتِ رزقٍ). Or «ما» is an indefinite noun qualified [by what follows] (nakira mawṣūfa) in the sense of «وقت» ("time"), the resumptive pronoun (ʿāʾid) being omitted, the implied form being: "every time in which they are provided" (كلَّ وقتٍ رزقوا فيه); the clause «رزقوا» is then in the position of a genitive, a naʿt of «ما». «رزقوا»: a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw of the plural is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿منها﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «رزقوا».
﴿من ثمرة﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from His word «منها».
﴿رزقا﴾: the second mafʿūl bihi of «رزقوا»; the first object is the nāʾib fāʿil, which is the wāw.
﴿قالوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿هذا﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿الذي﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of a nominative, khabar; the nominal clause is in the position of an accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿رزقنا﴾: a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); «نا» is an attached pronoun in the position of a nominative, nāʾib fāʿil; the clause «رزقنا» is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun; the resumptive pronoun is omitted, i.e. "we were provided with it" (رزقناه).
﴿من قبل﴾: «من» is a preposition for the beginning of extent (ibtidāʾ al-ghāya); and it has been said: [«قبل» is] an adverb, indeclinable on ḍamma because it is cut off from annexation in wording but not in meaning, in the position of a genitive by «من»; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «رزقنا» or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). The clause «كلما رزقوا...» is a second naʿt of «جنات», or circumstantial (ḥāliyya), or resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿وأتوا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and «أتوا» is a past verb, indeclinable on the passive (mabnī ʿalā al-majhūl) [Translator's note: the source reads «مبني على المجهول», presumably for «مبني للمجهول», "built for the passive"]; the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil.
﴿به﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «أتوا».
﴿متشابها﴾: ḥāl, i.e.: "resembling the fruit they were accustomed to in this world"; the clause «أتوا به متشابها» is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿ولهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «لهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar.
﴿فيها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿أزواج﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ.
﴿مطهرة﴾: a naʿt of «أزواج».
﴿وهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «هم» is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿فيها﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «خالدون».
﴿خالدون﴾: the khabar of «هم».

muyesser-irab:223-223.t:
﴿نساؤكم﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿حرث﴾: khabar (predicate).
﴿لكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are a naʿt (adjective) of حرث.
﴿فأتوا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; أتوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿حرثكم﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The two clauses, the nominal and the verbal, are resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿أنى شئتم﴾: mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) ائتوا; the clause شئتم is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). The clause ﴿فأتوا حرثكم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وقدموا لأنفسكم﴾: conjoined to what precedes.
﴿واتقوا الله﴾: also conjoined.
﴿واعلموا أنكم ملاقوه﴾: another conjoined [clause]; أن and what falls within its scope stand in place of the two objects of اعلموا; ملاقوه is the khabar of أن, and the sign of its being nominative (marfūʿ) is the wāw, because it is a sound masculine plural.
﴿وبشر المؤمنين﴾: another [clause] conjoined to what precedes.

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿إن﴾: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh).
﴿الله﴾: the noun of «إن», accusative (manṣūb).
﴿لا﴾: negative.
﴿يستحيي﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); its fāʿil (agent) is optionally latent (mustatir) in it, its implied form being "he" (هو), referring back to Allah; the verbal clause is in the position of a nominative, the khabar (predicate) of «إن».
﴿أن﴾: a maṣdar particle and [particle] of the accusative; «يضرب»: an imperfect verb, accusative by an optionally implied «أن» [Translator's note: so in the source, «منصوب بأن مضمرة جوازًا»; here «أن» is in fact overt in the text]; «أن» and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), or in the position of an accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ).
﴿مثلا﴾: mafʿūl bihi of «يضرب».
﴿ما﴾: [«ما»] of vagueness (ibhāmiyya), which, when joined to an indefinite noun, makes it vaguer and adds to its generality and comprehensiveness; [it is] in the position of an accusative, a naʿt (adjective) of «مثلا».
﴿بعوضة﴾: a badal (substitute) from «مثلًا».
﴿فما﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «ما» is a relative noun in the position of an accusative, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «بعوضة».
﴿فوقها﴾: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿فأما﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and «أما» is a particle of condition and of detailing (tafṣīl).
﴿الذين﴾: a relative noun in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿آمنوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause «آمنوا» is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of «الذين»; the clause «أما الذين...» is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿فيعلمون﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «يعلمون» is an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause «يعلمون» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of «الذين».
﴿أنه﴾: «أن» is an abrogating particle, and the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of an accusative, its noun.
﴿الحق﴾: its khabar; «إن» and what falls within its scope stand in place of the two objects of «يعلمون» [Translator's note: the source writes «إن» here, referring to «أنّ»].
﴿من ربهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وأما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «أما» is a particle of condition and of detailing.
﴿الذين﴾: a relative noun in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ.
﴿كفروا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun.
﴿فيقولون﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis; «يقولون» is an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of the relative noun.
﴿ماذا﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of an accusative, a fronted mafʿūl bihi of «أراد»; or «ما» is an interrogative noun and «ذا» a relative noun in the position of a nominative, the khabar of «ما»; the clause is in the position of an accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿أراد﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa.
﴿الله﴾: the fāʿil of «أراد».
﴿بهذا﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «أراد».
﴿مثلا﴾: a corroborative tamyīz (specification), or a ḥāl from the demonstrative, i.e. "being given as an example" (ممثلًا به), or from the fāʿil, i.e. "giving an example" (ممثلًا).
﴿يضل﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative; its fāʿil is optionally latent in it, its implied form being "he" (هو); the verbal clause «يضل به...» is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position, functioning as an explanation and clarification of the two clauses introduced by «أما»; and it has been said: [it is] in the position of an accusative, a naʿt of «مثلًا», the meaning being: an example by which people are divided into those who go astray and those who are guided.
﴿به﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يضل».
﴿كثيرا﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ويهدي﴾: conjoined to «يضل».
﴿به﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يهدي».
﴿كثيرا﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) or resumptive, and «ما» is negative.
﴿يضل﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the ḍamma; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun.
﴿به﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يضل».
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿الفاسقين﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause «ما يضل به إلا...» is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position, or circumstantial.

muyesser-irab:224-224.t:
﴿ولا تجعلوا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; لا is prohibitive; تجعلوا is an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by it.
﴿الله﴾: the Name of Majesty is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of تجعلوا.
﴿عرضة﴾: second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿لأيمانكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) عرضة. The clause ﴿ولا تجعلوا الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿أن تبروا﴾: the interpreted maṣdar from أن and what falls within its scope is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) or a badal (substitute).
﴿وتتقوا وتصلحوا بين الناس﴾: conjoined to أن تبروا; بين is an adverb attached to تصلحوا.
﴿والله سميع عليم﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject), and سميع عليم are its two khabars (predicates).

muyesser-irab:225-225.t:
﴿لا﴾: negative.
﴿يؤاخذكم﴾: an imperfect verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿الله﴾: its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿باللغو﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) يؤاخذكم.
﴿في أيمانكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ولكن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لكن is inoperative (muhmala), for rectification (istidrāk).
﴿يؤاخذكم﴾: an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) agent and a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿بما كسبت قلوبكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يؤاخذكم; ما is maṣdariyya or a relative noun; قلوبكم is the fāʿil.
﴿والله غفور حليم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject), and غفور حليم are its two khabars (predicates). The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:226-226.t:
﴿للذين﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿يؤلون﴾: an imperfect verb; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿من نسائهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يؤلون.
﴿تربص﴾: a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿أربعة أشهر﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the speech is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فإن فاءوا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إن is conditional; فاءوا is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).
﴿فإن الله غفور رحيم﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); إن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism), and غفور رحيم are its two khabars; the clause of إن and what follows it is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. The clause ﴿فإن فاءوا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:227-227.t:
﴿وإن عزموا الطلاق﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is conditional; عزموا is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); الطلاق is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), because عزم is made transitive with ﴿على﴾. The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being "let them carry it out" (فليوقعوه).
﴿فإن الله سميع عليم﴾: the fāʾ conjoins [this] to the omitted apodosis, serving as a giving of the reason (taʿlīl); إن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism), and سميع عليم are its two khabars (predicates).

muyesser-irab:228-228.t:
﴿والمطلقات﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and المطلقات is mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿يتربصن﴾: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural; the nūn is the fāʿil (agent); the clause يتربصن is the khabar (predicate) of المطلقات.
﴿بأنفسهن﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) يتربصن.
﴿ثلاثة قروء﴾: the accusative is as an adverb of time, the adverb being attached to يتربصن; or: ثلاثة is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of يتربصن. The clause ﴿والمطلقات يتربصن...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولا يحل لهن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is negative; يحل is an imperfect verb conjoined to يتربصن.
﴿أن يكتمن﴾: أن is a maṣdar-forming particle governing the accusative; يكتمن is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of accusative by أن; the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil; أن and what falls within its scope are to be interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) which is the fāʿil of يحل.
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi.
﴿خلق الله﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿في أرحامهن﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to خلق.
﴿إن﴾: conditional.
﴿كن﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb (one of kāna and its sisters) in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the nūn of the feminine plural is an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as the noun (ism) of كان.
﴿يؤمن﴾: the khabar of كن; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.
﴿بالله﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition; the Name of Majesty ﴿الله﴾ is a genitive noun, the sign of the genitive being the kasra; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يؤمن.
﴿واليوم الآخر﴾: conjoined to the Name of Majesty.
﴿وبعولتهن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and بعولتهن is mubtadaʾ.
﴿أحق﴾: khabar.
﴿بردهن﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أحق.
﴿في ذلك﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿إن أرادوا إصلاحا﴾: إن is a conditional particle governing the jussive; أرادوا is a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of jussive as the protasis; the apodosis is omitted, its implied form being "then their husbands have more right to take them back" (فبعولتهن أحق بردهن); the wāw is the fāʿil; إصلاحًا is mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ولهن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted, fronted khabar.
﴿مثل الذي عليهن بالمعروف﴾: مثل is a delayed mubtadaʾ; the relative noun is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿عليهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, and the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; بالمعروف is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿وللرجال﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted, fronted khabar.
﴿عليهن﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl, because it has been placed before the word it qualifies.
﴿درجة﴾: a delayed mubtadaʾ.
﴿والله عزيز حكيم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ, and عزيز حكيم are its two khabars. The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:171-171.t:
﴿ومثل﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and «مثل» is a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿الذين﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿كفروا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. A muḍāf must be implied before the relative noun, i.e.: "the likeness of the one who calls them to faith."
﴿كمثل﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مِثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate), and «مَثَل» is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿الذي﴾: a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿ينعق﴾: an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil is "he" (هو); the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun.
﴿بما﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ينعق».
﴿لا يسمع﴾: «لا» is negating (nāfiya), and «يسمع» is an imperfect verb; the verbal clause is the ṣila of «ما», with no grammatical position. The clause «ومثل الذين...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿دعاء﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ونداء﴾: conjoined to «دعاء».
﴿صم بكم عمي﴾: three khabars of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "they" (هم).
﴿فهم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «هم» is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿لا يعقلون﴾: the negated verbal clause is the khabar of «هم».

muyesser-irab:172-172.t:
﴿يا أيها﴾: «يا» is a vocative particle, and «أي» is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of the accusative; «ها» is for drawing attention (tanbīh).
﴿الذين﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of «أي».
﴿آمنوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The vocative clause and what follows it is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿كلوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil.
﴿من طيبات﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of the omitted object.
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).
﴿رزقناكم﴾: a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿واشكروا لله﴾: conjoined to «كلوا»; «لله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «اشكروا».
﴿إن﴾: a conditional particle that puts two verbs in the jussive.
﴿كنتم﴾: a deficient (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is its noun (ism).
﴿إياه﴾: a detached pronoun, the fronted object of «تعبدون».
﴿تعبدون﴾: the verbal clause is in the position of the accusative as the khabar (predicate) of «كنتم»; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) clause is omitted, what precedes indicating it, i.e.: "then give thanks" (فاشكروا).

muyesser-irab:173-173.t:
﴿إنما﴾: a restraining [particle] and a restrained [one] (kāffa wa-makfūfa).
﴿حرم﴾: a past verb; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "He" (هو), referring back to Allah the Exalted.
﴿عليكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «حرم».
﴿الميتة﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿والدم ولحم الخنزير﴾: both conjoined to «الميتة».
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «ما» is a relative noun, accusative by conjunction with what preceded.
﴿أهل﴾: a past verb, passive (built for that whose agent is not named).
﴿به﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun standing in the place of the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿لغير الله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿فمن﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and «من» is a jussive conditional noun (ism sharṭ jāzim), mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿اضطر﴾: a past verb, passive, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); its nāʾib fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "he" (هو), referring back to the one compelled.
﴿غير﴾: a ḥāl from «مَن», as if it were said: "[whoever] is compelled, neither desiring nor transgressing, then it is lawful for him."
﴿باغ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the sign of its genitive being the kasra implied on the yāʾ that was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters.
﴿ولا عاد﴾: conjoined to «غير باغ».
﴿فلا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), because it is a nominal clause, and «لا» is the lā of generic negation.
﴿إثم﴾: its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa.
﴿عليه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted khabar (predicate); the clause joined with the fāʾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of «من» according to the soundest view. The clause «فمن اضطر...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن الله﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the Name of Majesty is its noun.
﴿غفور رحيم﴾: two khabars of «إن»; the clause of «إن» and what falls within its scope has no grammatical position, because it is causal (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:174-174.t:
﴿إن الذين﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and «الذين» is its noun (ism); the clause «إن الذين...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿يكتمون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the verbal clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «يكتمون».
﴿أنزل الله﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the verbal clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of «ما».
﴿من الكتاب﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the omitted pronoun referring back to the relative noun, the implied form being: "what Allah sent down, it being from the Book."
﴿ويشترون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «يشترون» is a clause conjoined to the clause «أنزل الله». [Translator's note: so in the source; the sense requires conjunction to «يكتمون», the ṣila of «الذين».]
﴿به﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يشترون».
﴿ثمنا﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿قليلا﴾: an adjective (ṣifa).
﴿أولئك﴾: the demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿ما﴾: negating (nāfiya).
﴿يأكلون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the demonstrative.
﴿في بطونهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يأكلون», because they [the bellies] are the containers of eating.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿النار﴾: mafʿūl bihi. The clause «أولئك ما يأكلون» is the khabar of «إن».
﴿ولا يكلمهم الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to the clause «ما يأكلون».
﴿يوم القيامة﴾: the adverb (ẓarf) is attached to «يكلمهم».
﴿ولا يزكيهم﴾: the clause is conjoined to the clause «لا يكلمهم الله».
﴿ولهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar.
﴿عذاب﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ.
﴿أليم﴾: an adjective.

muyesser-irab:175-175.t:
﴿أولئك﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the kasra, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿الذين﴾: the khabar (predicate) of «أولئك».
﴿اشتروا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma implied on the alif that was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿الضلالة﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿بالهدى﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اشتروا»; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿والعذاب بالمغفرة﴾: conjoined to «الضلالة بالهدى».
﴿فما﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and «ما» is a complete indefinite (nakira tāmma) meaning "something", for wonder (taʿajjub), in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ.
﴿أصبرهم﴾: a past verb, invariable (jāmid), for expressing wonder; its fāʿil is a necessarily latent (mustatir) pronoun, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; the verbal clause is the khabar of «ما».
﴿على النار﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «أصبرهم». The clause «فما أصبرهم...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:176-176.t:
﴿ذلك﴾: the demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿بأن الله﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, and «أن» and what falls within its scope are in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are the khabar (predicate) of the demonstrative, and the bāʾ means causation (sababiyya). «أن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism).
﴿نزل الكتاب﴾: a past verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) referring back to Allah the Exalted, and «الكتاب» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is the khabar of «أن», i.e.: "that punishment is because Allah sent down the Book."
﴿بالحق﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نزل», or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وإن الذين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «إن» is an abrogating particle, and «الذين» is its noun.
﴿اختلفوا﴾: the verbal clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿في الكتاب﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «اختلفوا».
﴿لفي شقاق﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar of «إن».
﴿بعيد﴾: an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:177-177.t:
﴿ليس﴾: an invariable (jāmid), deficient (nāqiṣ) past verb.
﴿البر﴾: the fronted khabar (predicate) of «ليس».
