﴿أن تولوا﴾: «أن» is a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle, and «تولوا» is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by «أن»; the interpreted maṣdar formed from «أن» and what falls within its scope is the postponed noun (ism) of «ليس».
﴿وجوهكم﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿قبل﴾: an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تولوا».
﴿المشرق﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿والمغرب﴾: conjoined to «المشرق».
﴿ولكن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «لكن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh).
﴿البر﴾: its noun.
﴿من آمن﴾: «من» is a relative noun, the khabar of «لكن», on the assumption that a muḍāf has been omitted, i.e.: "the righteousness of whoever believes" (برّ من آمن); it has also been said: there is no omission, rather righteousness is made to be the very person who believes, for intensification (mubālagha). The clause «آمن» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «من», with no grammatical position.
﴿بالله﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, and the Name of Majesty «الله» is a genitive noun, the sign of the genitive being the kasra; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «آمن».
﴿واليوم﴾: conjoined to the Name of Majesty.
﴿الآخر﴾: an adjective (ṣifa).
﴿والملائكة والكتاب والنبيين﴾: also conjoined to the Name of Majesty.
﴿وآتى﴾: a past verb conjoined to «آمن», falling within the scope of the ṣila; its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو).
﴿المال﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿على حبه﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are in the place of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); the maṣdar (verbal noun) is annexed to its object, i.e.: "despite loving it" (مع حبه).
﴿ذوي القربى﴾: the object of «آتى», the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ, because it is treated like the sound masculine plural; «القربى» is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿واليتامى والمساكين وابن السبيل والسائلين﴾: all conjoined to «ذوي».
﴿وفي الرقاب﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are also conjoined, i.e.: "and gave wealth for freeing them from captivity, or for manumitting them."
﴿وأقام الصلاة وآتى الزكاة﴾: conjoined to «آتى المال».
﴿والموفون﴾: conjoined to «من آمن», or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: "they are those who fulfil" (هم الموفون).
﴿بعهدهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «الموفون».
﴿إذا﴾: an adverb (ẓarf) attached to «الموفون».
﴿عاهدوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the verbal clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation, because it comes after the adverb.
﴿والصابرين﴾: accusative by way of praise (ʿalā al-madḥ) by an omitted verb, its implied form being "I praise" (أمدح).
﴿في البأساء والضراء﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «الصابرين».
﴿وحين البأس﴾: an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to «الصابرين», and «البأس» is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿أولئك﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ.
﴿الذين﴾: a relative noun, khabar.
﴿صدقوا﴾: the clause made up of the verb and its fāʿil has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun.
﴿وأولئك﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya) and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; or it is a conjunction. «أولئك» is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿هم﴾: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position, or a second mubtadaʾ.
﴿المتقون﴾: the khabar of «أولئك», or of «هم»; [in the latter case] the nominal clause is the khabar of «أولئك».

muyesser-irab:178-178.t:
﴿يا أيها﴾: «يا» is a vocative particle, and «أي» is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of the accusative; «ها» is for drawing attention (tanbīh).
﴿الذين﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of «أي».
﴿آمنوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The vocative clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿كتب﴾: a past verb, passive (built for that whose agent is not named).
﴿عليكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «كتب».
﴿القصاص﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿في القتلى﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), or attached to «القصاص». The verbal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿الحر﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿بالحر﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). The clause «الحر بالحر» is explicative (tafsīriyya), with no grammatical position.
﴿والعبد بالعبد﴾: conjoined to what preceded.
﴿والأنثى بالأنثى﴾: also conjoined.
﴿فمن﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and «من» is a jussive conditional noun (ism sharṭ jāzim) in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ.
﴿عفي﴾: a past verb, passive, in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).
﴿له﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «عفي».
﴿من أخيه﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e.: "it being from his brother's blood."
﴿شيء﴾: the nāʾib fāʿil of «عفي».
﴿فاتباع﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), because it is a nominal clause; «اتباع» is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted and placed before it, i.e.: "then upon him is following" (فعليه اتباع). The clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of «من».
﴿بالمعروف﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «اتباع». The clause «فمن عفي له...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وأداء﴾: conjoined to «اتباع».
﴿إليه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «أداء».
﴿بإحسان﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿ذلك﴾: the demonstrative, mubtadaʾ.
﴿تخفيف﴾: khabar.
﴿من ربكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ورحمة﴾: conjoined to «تخفيف».
﴿فمن﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «من» is conditional, mubtadaʾ.
﴿اعتدى﴾: a past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis.
﴿بعد ذلك﴾: the adverb (ẓarf) is attached to «اعتدى».
﴿فله﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, because it is a nominal clause, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar.
﴿عذاب﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ.
﴿أليم﴾: an adjective of «عذاب»; the clause joined with the fāʾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis and its apodosis are in the position of the nominative as the khabar of «من».

muyesser-irab:179-179.t:
﴿ولكم﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿في القصاص﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿حياة﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause «ولكم في القصاص حياة» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿يا أولي الألباب﴾: the one addressed (munādā), annexed (muḍāf) and accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ, because it is treated like the sound masculine plural; «الألباب» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿لعلكم﴾: «لعل» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the kāf is its noun (ism).
﴿تتقون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of «لعل», and the clause of hope (rajāʾ) is a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:98-98.t:
﴿من﴾: a jussive conditional noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿كان﴾: a defective past verb; its noun (ism) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun referring to مَن.
﴿عدوا﴾: the khabar (predicate) of كان.
﴿لله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of عدو.
﴿وملائكته ورسله وجبريل وميكال﴾: conjoined.
﴿فإن الله عدو للكافرين﴾: the clause is conjoined to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

muyesser-irab:99-99.t:
﴿ولقد﴾: the wāw is resumptive, the lām is the response to an omitted oath, and قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq).
﴿أنزلنا إليك﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنزلنا.
﴿آيات﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the kasra, because it is a sound feminine plural.
﴿بينات﴾: naʿt (adjective). The clause ﴿لقد أنزلنا...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is negative.
﴿يكفر بها﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to it.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿الفاسقون﴾: the fāʿil of يكفر.

muyesser-irab:100-100.t:
﴿أوكلما﴾: the hamza is for the rhetorical interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī), and the wāw conjoins to something omitted, its implied form being: أكفروا بالآيات البينات وكلما عاهدوا عهدا... (did they disbelieve in the clear signs, and every time they made a covenant…); the interrogative hamza was placed before the conjunction because it has the right to the head of the sentence. ﴿كلَّ﴾ stands in for an adverb of time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نبذه﴾ and containing the sense of condition; ﴿ما﴾ is temporal-maṣdarī, and the clause ﴿عاهدوا﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the particle-relative ﴿ما﴾; ﴿ما﴾ together with what it governs is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive by annexation, the implied form being: أوَكُلَّ عهدٍ (is it then every covenant…), and this is on the omission of a muḍāf, i.e.: أوَكُلَّ وقتِ عهدٍ (is it then at every time of a covenant…). Or ﴿ما﴾ is an indefinite noun qualified [by what follows], in the sense of ﴿وقت﴾ (time), with the referring pronoun omitted, the implied form being: أوَكُلَّ وقتٍ عاهدوا فيه (is it then every time they covenanted in it), so that the clause ﴿عاهدوا﴾ is in the position of the genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ما﴾.
﴿عاهدوا﴾: a past verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿عهدا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), عاهدوا being in the sense of أعطوا (they gave), with the first object omitted, i.e.: أعطوا الله عهدًا (they gave Allah a covenant); or ﴿عهدًا﴾ stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar).
﴿نبذه﴾: a verb and a fronted mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فريق﴾: fāʿil.
﴿منهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are a naʿt of فريق.
﴿بل﴾: a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction.
﴿أكثرهم﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿لا يؤمنون﴾: لا is negative, and the clause لا يؤمنون is the khabar (predicate) of أكثرهم; the nominal clause is conjoined to the preceding clause.

muyesser-irab:101-101.t:
﴿ولما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لما is adverbial and temporal (ẓarfiyya ḥīniyya), or linking.
﴿جاءهم﴾: a verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿رسول﴾: fāʿil (agent); the clause جاءهم is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it, or has no grammatical position.
﴿من عند الله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are a naʿt (adjective) of رسول.
﴿مصدق﴾: a second naʿt.
﴿لما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) مصدق.
﴿معهم﴾: an adverb of place attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿نبذ فريق﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿من الذين﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are a naʿt of فريق.
﴿أوتوا الكتاب﴾: a past verb, its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿كتاب الله﴾: the object of نبذ.
﴿وراء ظهورهم﴾: a second object of نبذ, because it contains the sense of جعل (to make), or an adverb of place attached to an omitted [word] which is the second object.
﴿كأنهم لا يعلمون﴾: كان is a past, defective, abrogating (nāsikh) verb [Translator's note: so in the source; كأنّ here is an abrogating particle of comparison (one of the sisters of inna), not the verb كان], the hāʾ is its noun (ism), and the clause لا يعلمون is its khabar (predicate); the clause كأنهم is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:102-102.t:
﴿واتبعوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and اتبعوا is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, the object of اتبعوا.
﴿تتلو الشياطين﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿على ملك سليمان﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) تتلو; سليمان is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct), the sign of its genitive being the fatḥa, because it is a diptote (mamnūʿ min al-ṣarf) on account of being a proper name and foreign.
﴿وما كفر﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), or resumptive; ما is negative, and كفر is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa.
﴿سليمان﴾: the fāʿil of كفر; the clause ﴿ما كفر سليمان﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position, on [the view] that the wāw is resumptive.
﴿ولكن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لكن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle of rectification (istidrāk).
﴿الشياطين﴾: the noun (ism) of لكن.
﴿كفروا﴾: the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of لكن.
﴿يعلمون﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) or a second khabar.
﴿الناس﴾: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿السحر﴾: second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وما أنزل على الملكين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is a relative noun conjoined to السحر; the clause أنزل is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أنزل.
﴿ببابل﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿هاروت وماروت﴾: badal (substitute) from الملكين.
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and ما is negative.
﴿يعلمان﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, and the alif is the fāʿil.
﴿من أحد﴾: من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition, and أحد is genitive in form and accusative in position, because it is the object of يعلمان.
﴿حتى﴾: a particle of limit and of the genitive.
﴿يقولا﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an أن implied after حتى; أن and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive by حتى, and the preposition with its genitive noun is attached to يعلمان.
﴿إنما﴾: a restraining particle and the restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa).
﴿نحن﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿فتنة﴾: khabar; the nominal clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). The clause ﴿ما يعلمان...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فلا تكفر﴾: the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa ("disclosing") fāʾ, لا is prohibitive, and تكفر is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by لا, i.e.: if you wish to follow the straight path, then do not disbelieve by learning it.
﴿فيتعلمون﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive and the clause ﴿فيتعلمون منهما...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; or the fāʾ is a conjunction. يتعلمون is a verb and its fāʿil.
﴿منهما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يتعلمون.
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi.
﴿يفرقون﴾: the clause is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿به﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يفرقون.
﴿بين المرء وزوجه﴾: the adverb is also attached to يفرقون.
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, and ما is the Ḥijāzī ما, which operates like ليس.
﴿هم﴾: the noun of ما.
﴿بضارين﴾: the bāʾ is a connective (redundant) preposition, and ضارين is genitive in form and accusative in position, because it is the khabar of ما.
﴿به﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ضارين.
﴿من أحد﴾: من is a connective (redundant) preposition; أحد is genitive in form and accusative in position, because it is the object of ضارين, which is an active participle.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿بإذن الله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl from the latent (mustatir) pronoun that is the fāʿil of ضارين, or from the mafʿūl bihi, which is أحد.
﴿ويتعلمون﴾: conjoined to what preceded.
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi.
﴿يضرهم﴾: the clause is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولا ينفعهم﴾: conjoined to the ṣila.
﴿ولقد﴾: the wāw is resumptive, the lām is the response to an omitted oath, and قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq).
﴿علموا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the response to the oath.
﴿لمن﴾: the lām is the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ), and it conveys emphasis; من is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ.
﴿اشتراه﴾: the clause has no grammatical position.
﴿ما﴾: negative.
﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar.
﴿في الآخرة﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl.
﴿من﴾: a connective (redundant) preposition.
﴿خلاق﴾: a delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative in position and genitive in form by ﴿من﴾; the clause ﴿ما له في الآخرة من خلاق﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of ﴿مَن﴾, and the nominal clause ﴿لَمَن اشتراه ما له في الآخرة من خلاق﴾ is within the domain of the accusative, standing in place of the two objects of علموا, which is suspended (muʿallaq) from operating. The clause ﴿لقد علموا لمن...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولبئس﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the lām occurs in the response to an implied oath; بئس: a past verb for the expression of censure (inshāʾ al-dhamm), indeclinable on the fatḥa, and its fāʿil is latent; the one specified for censure (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, i.e.: السحر (sorcery) or الكفر (disbelief), and it is a delayed mubtadaʾ, the clause before it being the fronted khabar.
﴿ما﴾: an indefinite noun qualified [by what follows], in the sense of شيء (a thing), in the position of the accusative as tamyīz (specification).
﴿شروا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause ﴿شروا﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ما﴾.
﴿به﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to شروا.
﴿أنفسهم﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿لو﴾: conditional.
﴿كانوا﴾: كان is a past, defective, abrogating (nāsikh) verb, and the wāw is its noun.
﴿يعلمون﴾: the clause is the khabar of كان, and the apodosis (jawāb) of لو is omitted.

muyesser-irab:103-103.t:
﴿ولو﴾: the wāw is resumptive and the clause ﴿لو أنهم آمنوا﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; or the wāw is a conjunction. لو is conditional.
﴿أنهم﴾: أن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and the hāʾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun (ism) of إن [Translator's note: so in the source («اسم إن»); the particle here is أنّ].
﴿آمنوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of أن; أن with its noun and khabar is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) which is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar is omitted, i.e.: لو أن إيمانهم ثابت (if their belief were established); it has also been said: in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil of an omitted verb, i.e.: لو ثبت إيمانهم (if their belief were established).
﴿واتقوا﴾: conjoined to آمنوا.
﴿لمثوبة﴾: the lām is of inception (ibtidāʾ); it has also been said: it occurs in the apodosis (jawāb) of لو. مثوبة is a mubtadaʾ; beginning with an indefinite noun is permissible because it has been qualified.
﴿من عند الله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are a naʿt (adjective) of مثوبة.
﴿خير﴾: the khabar of مثوبة.
﴿لو﴾: conditional.
﴿كانوا﴾: كان is a past, defective, abrogating verb, and the wāw is its noun.
﴿يعلمون﴾: its khabar; the apodosis of لو is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e.: لأثيبوا (they would have been rewarded).

muyesser-irab:104-104.t:
﴿يا أيها﴾: يا is a vocative particle, and أي is a munādā (one addressed in the vocative) that is an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of the accusative; and ها is for drawing attention (tanbīh).
﴿الذين﴾: naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾.
﴿آمنوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿لا﴾: prohibitive.
﴿تقولوا﴾: an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by لا.
﴿راعنا﴾: an imperative verb; the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: أنت, and نا is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi, by way of quotation (ḥikāya).
﴿وقولوا﴾: conjoined to لا تقولوا.
﴿انظرنا﴾: an imperative verb, and نا is its object; it is intended as quotation.
﴿واسمعوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and اسمعوا is conjoined to لو [Translator's note: so in the source («معطوفة على لو»); there is no لو here, and it is presumably conjoined to قولوا]; the mafʿūl bihi is omitted, i.e.: listen to what the Messenger tells you and the matters he lays before you that lead to your success.
﴿وللكافرين﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿عذاب﴾: a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿أليم﴾: naʿt of عذاب; the clause ﴿للكافرين عذاب أليم﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:105-105.t:
﴿ما﴾: negative.
﴿يود﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿الذين كفروا﴾: the fāʿil (agent) of يود; the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿من﴾: a preposition.
﴿أهل الكتاب﴾: genitive by من; the preposition and its genitive noun are in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ولا المشركين﴾: conjoined to أهل الكتاب; لا was brought in for emphasis.
﴿أن ينزل﴾: أن together with what falls within its scope is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is the object of يود; ينزل is built for that whose agent is not named (passive).
﴿عليكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ينزل.
﴿من﴾: a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition.
﴿خير﴾: genitive in form and nominative in position, as the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿من ربكم﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of خير.
﴿والله﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and الله is a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿يختص﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: هو; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the Name of Majesty.
﴿برحمته﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يختص.
﴿من﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿يشاء﴾: the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿والله يختص...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿والله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and الله is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿ذو الفضل﴾: khabar; the sign of its nominative is the wāw, because it is one of the five nouns.
﴿العظيم﴾: naʿt of الفضل.

muyesser-irab:106-106.t:
﴿ما﴾: a jussive conditional noun in the position of the accusative as the fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ننسخ.
﴿ننسخ﴾: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm).
﴿من آية﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of the conditional noun.
﴿أو﴾: a conjunction.
﴿ننسها﴾: conjoined to ننسخ, and ﴿ها﴾ is mafʿūl bihi.
﴿نأت﴾: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), jussive, the sign of its jussive being the omission of the weak letter.
﴿بخير﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to نأت.
﴿منها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to خير, because it is an elative (ism tafḍīl).
﴿أو مثلها﴾: conjoined to بآية [Translator's note: so in the source; it is conjoined to ﴿بخير﴾].
﴿ألم﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of affirmation (istifhām taqrīrī), and لم is a particle of negation, of inversion [of the imperfect to past meaning], and of the jussive.
﴿تعلم﴾: an imperfect verb in the jussive by لم.
﴿أن الله﴾: أن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism).
﴿على كل شيء﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to قدير.
﴿قدير﴾: the khabar (predicate) of أن; أن together with what falls within its scope stands in place of the two objects of تعلم.

muyesser-irab:107-107.t:
﴿ألم تعلم﴾: a second affirmation (taqrīr).
﴿أن الله﴾: أن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism).
﴿له﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿ملك السماوات﴾: a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿والأرض﴾: conjoined to السماوات.
﴿وما لكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, ما is negative, and لكم is a fronted khabar.
﴿من دون الله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿من ولي﴾: من is a preposition, and ولي is genitive in form and nominative in position, as a delayed mubtadaʾ.
﴿ولا نصير﴾: conjoined to ولي.

muyesser-irab:281-281.t:
﴿واتقوا يوما ترجعون فيه إلى الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اتقوا is an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); يومًا is the object; ترجعون is an imperfect verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is in the position of the accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿يومًا﴾; فيه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and إلى الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ترجعون.
﴿ثم توفى كل نفس ما كسبت﴾: ثم is a conjunction denoting sequence with delay; توفى is an imperfect verb in the passive; كل نفس is the nāʾib fāʿil; ما is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause كسبت has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾.
﴿وهم لا يظلمون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; هم is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause لا يظلمون is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate); and the clause وهم لا يظلمون is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:282-282.t:
﴿يا أيها﴾: يا is a vocative particle; أي is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative; and ها is for drawing attention.
﴿الذين﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾.
﴿آمنوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and the vocative clause and what follows it are resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إذا تداينتم بدين إلى أجل مسمى فاكتبوه﴾: إذا is an adverb of future time containing the sense of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis; the clause تداينتم is in the position of the genitive by annexation; بدين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تداينتم; إلى أجل is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of دين; مسمى is a naʿt of أجل; the fāʾ connects the apodosis of إذا; اكتبوه is an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause joined to the fāʾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
﴿وليكتب بينكم كاتب بالعدل﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is the lām of command; يكتب is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by the lām; بينكم is an adverb of place attached to يكتب; كاتب is the fāʿil; and بالعدل is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to كاتب, serving as a naʿt of it.
﴿ولا يأب كاتب أن يكتب كما علمه الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; يأب is a jussive imperfect verb, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; كاتب is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from أن and what falls within its scope is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), because ﴿أبى﴾ means "to refrain". ﴿كما﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as a naʿt of an omitted maṣdar, the implied form being "to write a writing like what Allah has taught him"; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), i.e. "like that which Allah has taught him to write"; ﴿علمه﴾ is a past verb, the hāʾ being a fronted mafʿūl bihi, and ﴿الله﴾ is the fāʿil; and the clause ﴿علمه الله﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun.
﴿فليكتب﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the "eloquent" fāʾ implying an omitted condition), i.e. "if you know this ruling, then let him write"; the lām is the lām of command; يكتب is an imperfect verb in the jussive by the lām; and the fāʿil is "he".
﴿وليملل الذي عليه الحق﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; الذي is the fāʿil of يكتب; عليه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); الحق is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and the nominal clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. [Translator's note: the source says «فاعل يكتب»; in this phrase الذي is the fāʿil of يملل.]
﴿وليتق الله ربه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is the lām of command; يتق is an imperfect verb in the jussive by the lām, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he"; the Name of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi; and ربه is a badal (substitute).
﴿ولا يبخس منه شيئا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; يبخس is an imperfect verb in the jussive by لا, and the fāʿil is "he"; منه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يبخس, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was a naʿt of His saying ﴿شيئا﴾ and was placed before it. شيئًا is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فإن كان الذي عليه الحق سفيها أو ضعيفا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إن is conditional; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); الذي is the noun of كان; عليه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; الحق is a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿عليه الحق﴾ is the ṣila of الذي, with no grammatical position; سفيهًا is the khabar of كان; أو is a conjunction; and ضعيفًا is conjoined to ﴿سفيهًا﴾.
﴿أو لا يستطيع أن يمل هو﴾: أو is a conjunction; لا is negative; يستطيع is an imperfect verb; the interpreted maṣdar formed from ﴿أن﴾ and what falls within its scope is the object of يستطيع; and ﴿هو﴾ is the fāʿil [of يمل], or a tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent fāʿil.
﴿فليملل وليه بالعدل﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the lām is the lām of command; يملل is an imperfect verb in the jussive by the lām; وليه is the fāʿil; بالعدل is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "being just", or attached to His saying فليملل; and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. The clause ﴿فإن كان الذي...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿واستشهدوا شهيدين من رجالكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; استشهدوا is an imperative verb indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; شهيدين is the mafʿūl bihi; and من رجالكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt, or to His saying واستشهدوا.
﴿فإن لم يكونا رجلين﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إن is conditional; لم is a particle of negation, of conversion (to the past) and of the jussive; يكونا is an imperfect verb in the jussive by لم, and it is the protasis; the alif is its noun, and رجلين is its khabar.
﴿فرجل وامرأتان﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis; رجل is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, or a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted; امرأتان is conjoined to رجل; and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis.
﴿ممن ترضون من الشهداء﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt; the clause ترضون has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of ﴿من﴾; and من الشهداء is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿أن تضل إحداهما﴾: أن with what falls within its scope is to be interpreted as a maṣdar in the accusative as a mafʿūl min ajlihi (object of purpose); and إحداهما is the fāʿil of تضل.
﴿فتذكر إحداهما الأخرى﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; تذكر is conjoined to أن تضل; إحداهما is the fāʿil; and الأخرى is the mafʿūl bihi. The clause ﴿فإن لم يكونا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولا يأب الشهداء إذا ما دعوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; يأب is an imperfect verb in the jussive by لا, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; الشهداء is the fāʿil; إذا is a future adverb containing the sense of condition, attached to the apodosis; ما is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant); دعوا is a past verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation.
﴿ولا تسأموا أن تكتبوه صغيرا أو كبيرا إلى أجله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تسأموا is an imperfect verb in the jussive by لا, and the wāw is the fāʿil; أن with what falls within its scope is the mafʿūl bihi of تسأموا; صغيرًا is a ḥāl; the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿كبيرًا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿صغيرًا﴾; and إلى أجله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "remaining as a liability until it falls due". [Translator's note: the source says «والواو حرف عطف», but the conjunction in the ayah is أو.]
﴿ذلكم أقسط عند الله وأقوم للشهادة﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ذلكم is a mubtadaʾ, and أقسط is its khabar; عند is an adverb of place attached to أقسط, and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi; أقوم is conjoined to أقسط; and للشهادة is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أقوم.
﴿وأدنى ألا ترتابوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أدنى is conjoined to أقوم; أن with what falls within its scope is to be interpreted as a maṣdar, accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "nearer to the absence of doubt"; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أدنى.
﴿إلا أن تكون تجارة حاضرة﴾: إلا is a particle of exception; أن with what falls within its scope is a maṣdar in the accusative as the excepted (mustathnā); ﴿تكون﴾ is an imperfect verb, and its noun is latent, its implied form being "it", i.e. the trade; تجارة is the khabar; and حاضرة is a naʿt of تجارة.
﴿تديرونها بينكم﴾: the clause is a second naʿt of تجارة, and بينكم is an adverb of place attached to تديرونها.
﴿فليس عليكم جناح ألا تكتبوها﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction which joins this clause to the clause إلا أن تكون تجارة; ليس is a defective past verb; عليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; جناح is its postponed noun; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and what falls within its scope is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "in not writing it"; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt of جناح.
﴿وأشهدوا إذا تبايعتم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أشهدوا is an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; إذا is a future adverb containing the sense of condition, attached to the apodosis; the clause تبايعتم is in the position of the genitive by annexation; and the apodosis is omitted, its implied form being "then take witnesses"; or إذا is for mere adverbial time, i.e. "do the witnessing at the time of the transaction".
﴿ولا يضار﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; يضار is a jussive imperfect verb, given a fatḥa because of its lightness, since it is a doubled verb.
﴿كاتب ولا شهيد﴾: كاتب is the fāʿil, i.e. "the scribe shall not harm the owner of the right", or the nāʾib fāʿil if the verb is taken as passive; the wāw is a conjunction; لا is negative; and شهيد is conjoined to كاتب.
﴿وإن تفعلوا فإنه فسوق بكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is conditional; تفعلوا is an imperfect verb, the protasis, in the jussive, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the fāʾ connects the apodosis; إن is an abrogating particle (of the sisters of inna), the hāʾ is its noun, and فسوق is its khabar; بكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of فسوق, i.e. "attaching [to you]". The clause joined to the fāʾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis.
﴿واتقوا الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اتقوا is an imperative verb, the wāw is the fāʿil, and the Name of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ويعلمكم الله﴾: the wāw is resumptive; الله is the fāʿil of يعلمكم, and the kāf is the object of يعلمكم. The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿والله بكل شيء عليم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ; بكل شيء is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to عليم; and عليم is the khabar. The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:283-283.t:
﴿وإن كنتم على سفر﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إن is conditional; كنتم is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the tāʾ is its noun; and على سفر is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of كنتم.
﴿ولم تجدوا كاتبا﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; لم is a particle of negation, of conversion (to the past) and of the jussive; تجدوا is an imperfect verb in the jussive by لم, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); كاتبًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial); or the wāw is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to the protasis, in the position of the jussive.
﴿فرهان مقبوضة﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); رهان is a mubtadaʾ (subject) — beginning with an indefinite is permissible because it is qualified; مقبوضة is a naʿt (adjective); and the khabar is omitted, its implied form being "you take security in them"; or it is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "then what is relied upon is pledges"; and the nominal clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. The clause ﴿وإن كنتم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فإن أمن بعضكم بعضا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; إن is conditional; أمن is a past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis; بعضكم is the fāʿil; and بعضًا is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فليؤد الذي اؤتمن أمانته﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis; the lām is the lām of command; يؤد is an imperfect verb in the jussive by the lām, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the protasis; الذي is a relative noun, the fāʿil; اؤتمن is a past verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he"; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿الذي﴾, with no grammatical position; and أمانته is the mafʿūl bihi of يؤد. [Translator's note: the source says «في محل جزم فعل الشرط»; given that the fāʾ is said to connect the apodosis, the clause is evidently the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).]
﴿وليتق الله ربه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is the lām of command; يتق is an imperfect verb in the jussive by the lām, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he"; the Name of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi; and ربه is a badal (substitute).
﴿ولا تكتموا الشهادة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تكتموا is an imperfect verb in the jussive by لا, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; and الشهادة is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ومن يكتمها فإنه آثم قلبه﴾: the wāw is resumptive; من is a conditional noun that puts the verb in the jussive, a mubtadaʾ; يكتمها is the protasis, and ﴿ها﴾ is its object; the fāʾ connects the apodosis; إن is an abrogating particle (of the sisters of inna), the hāʾ is its noun, and آثم is its khabar; قلبه is the fāʿil of آثم, because it is an active participle. Or آثم is a fronted khabar and قلبه a postponed mubtadaʾ, the nominal clause being the khabar of إن. The clause joined to the fāʾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis together with its apodosis is the khabar of من. The clause ﴿ومن يكتمها...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿والله بما تعملون عليم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ; بما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to عليم; the clause تعملون has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun; and عليم is the khabar. The clause ﴿والله بما تعملون عليم﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿الذين﴾: a relative noun in the position of a genitive (majrūr), because it is a naʿt (adjective) of «الفاسقين».
﴿ينقضون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿عهد الله﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿من بعد﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ينقضون».
﴿ميثاقه﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the pronoun refers back to the name of Allah or to «العهد».
﴿ويقطعون﴾: conjoined to His word «ينقضون».
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), "nominative by it" [Translator's note: the source reads «في محل نصب مرفوع به», evidently a slip for «مفعول به», "direct object"].
﴿أمر﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa.
﴿الله﴾: the fāʿil (agent) of «أمر».
﴿به﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «أمر».
﴿أن﴾: a maṣdar particle and [particle] of the accusative.
﴿يوصل﴾: an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "it" (هو). «أن» and what falls within its scope are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), a badal (substitute) from the pronoun in «به», the meaning being: "and they sever what Allah commanded to be joined" (ويقطعون ما أمر الله بوصله); or [it is] a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), the implied form being: "out of dislike that it be joined" (كراهية أن يوصل) or "so that it not be joined" (لئلا يوصل).
﴿ويفسدون﴾: conjoined to «يقطعون».
﴿في الأرض﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يفسدون».
﴿أولئك﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable on kasra, in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿هم﴾: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position.
﴿الخاسرون﴾: the khabar (predicate) of «أولئك»; or «هم» is a mubtadaʾ and «الخاسرون» its khabar, and the nominal clause is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of «أولئك».

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿كيف﴾: an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿تكفرون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; the wāw is an attached pronoun in the position of a nominative, fāʿil (agent).
﴿بالله﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, and the Name of Majesty «الله» is a genitive noun, the sign of the genitive being the kasra; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تكفرون».
﴿وكنتم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), with «قد» implied after it; «كان» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb [of kāna and its sisters], and the tāʾ is its noun.
﴿أمواتا﴾: the khabar (predicate) of «كان», accusative; the verbal clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl.
﴿فأحياكم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «أحيا» is a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو); the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction for sequence with delay (tarākhī).
﴿يميتكم﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو), referring back to Allah.
﴿ثم يحييكم﴾: likewise conjoined.
﴿ثم﴾: likewise a conjunction.
﴿إليه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «ترجعون».
﴿ترجعون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿هو﴾: a detached pronoun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿الذي﴾: a relative noun in the position of a nominative, khabar (predicate).
﴿خلق﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa; its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو).
﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خلق».
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿في الأرض﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿جميعا﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the mafʿūl bihi «ما», or a tawkīd (emphasis) of «ما».
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction for sequence with delay (tarākhī).
﴿استوى﴾: a past verb conjoined to «خلق».
﴿إلى السماء﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «استوى».
﴿فسواهن﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «سوى» is a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو); the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi.
﴿سبع سماوات﴾: a badal (substitute) from the pronoun in «فسواهن», accusative; or a ḥāl, if «سوّى» is in the sense of mere creation; or a second object if «سوّى» is in the sense of "made into" (صيّر).
﴿وهو﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and «هو» is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿بكل شيء﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «عليم».
﴿عليم﴾: khabar, nominative; the clause «هو بكل شيء عليم» is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿وإذ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and «إذ» is a noun of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being «اذكر» ("remember"), on the assumption of a conjunction, i.e.: "so they said" (فقالوا). [Translator's note: so in the source; the last phrase appears to be misplaced.]
﴿قال﴾: a past verb.
﴿ربك﴾: fāʿil (agent).
﴿للملائكة﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قال»; the verbal clause «قال ربك...» is in the position of a genitive (majrūr), muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿إني﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the yāʾ is its noun.
﴿جاعل﴾: its khabar (predicate).
﴿في الأرض﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «جاعل» if it is in the sense of "creator" (خالق), and in the position of an accusative as a second mafʿūl bihi if it is an active participle from «الجعل» in the sense of "making into" (taṣyīr); the clause «إني جاعل» is in the position of an accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿خليفة﴾: mafʿūl bihi of «جاعل», because it is an active participle. The clause «إذ قال ربك» is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿قالوا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on ḍamma because of its attachment to the wāw of the plural; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause «قالوا...» is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is resumptive.
﴿أتجعل﴾: the hamza is for the interrogation of wonder (istifhām taʿajjubī), and «تجعل» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil necessarily latent (mustatir) in it, its implied form being "you" (أنت).
﴿فيها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «جعل» if it is in the sense of creation, or in the place of a fronted second object if it is in the sense of "making into".
﴿يفسد﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو); the clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. [Translator's note: the source gives no separate entry for the relative noun «من» preceding «يفسد».]
﴿فيها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يفسد».
﴿ويسفك﴾: an imperfect verb conjoined to «يفسد», falling within the scope of the ṣila.
﴿الدماء﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ونحن﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «نحن» is a detached pronoun in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿نسبح﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "we" (نحن); the verbal clause is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of «نحن».
﴿بحمدك﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "clothed in Your praise" (متلبسين بحمدك).
﴿ونقدس﴾: an imperfect verb conjoined to «نسبح».
﴿لك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «نقدس»; or the lām is a connective (ṣila) [i.e. redundant], and the kāf is the object of «نقدس».
﴿قال﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "he" (هو); the clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿إني﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle, and the yāʾ is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of an accusative, its noun.
﴿أعلم﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being "I" (أنا); the clause is the khabar of «إن».
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi.
﴿لا﴾: negative.
﴿تعلمون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun. The clause «إني أعلم» is in the position of an accusative as the object of speech.

muyesser-irab:284-284.t:
﴿لله ما في السماوات وما في الأرض﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); ما is a relative noun, a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); في السماوات is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted [verb forming the] ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. وما في الأرض is conjoined to ﴿ما في السماوات﴾.
﴿وإن تبدوا ما في أنفسكم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إن is conditional; تبدوا is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of its jussive (majzūm) being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ما is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); في أنفسكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ṣila of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. The clause ﴿إن تبدوا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿أو تخفوه﴾: conjoined to تبدوا, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿يحاسبكم به الله﴾: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), in the jussive; the kāf is an attached pronoun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يحاسبكم; the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; and the clause has no grammatical position.
﴿فيغفر لمن يشاء﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; يغفر is a nominative imperfect verb; لمن is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يغفر; and the clause يشاء is the ṣila of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿فيغفر لمن يشاء﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ويعذب من يشاء﴾: conjoined to what precedes.
﴿والله على كل شيء قدير﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ; على كل شيء is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to قدير; and قدير is the khabar. The clause ﴿والله على كل شيء قدير﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:285-285.t:
﴿آمن الرسول بما أنزل إليه من ربه﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position. آمن الرسول is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); بما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) آمن; the clause أنزل has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "it"; إليه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنزل; and من ربه is a preposition and its genitive noun also attached to أنزل, or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "while it is sent down from his Lord".
﴿والمؤمنون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and المؤمنون is conjoined to الرسول. It has also been said: the wāw is resumptive, and المؤمنون is a first mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿كل آمن﴾: كل is a second mubtadaʾ, and the clause آمن is its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is the khabar of the first mubtadaʾ, which is المؤمنون, and the linking element is omitted — this on the second view. On the first view, the clause ﴿كل آمن﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. Beginning with كل, though it is indefinite, is permissible because annexation is intended, i.e. "each one of them", the tanwīn being a substitute for the omitted word.
﴿بالله وملائكته وكتبه ورسله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to آمن, and what follows is conjoined to it.
﴿لا نفرق بين أحد من رسله﴾: this clause is the object of an omitted verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl), and the clause of saying is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl, i.e. "saying: we make no distinction"; لا is negative; نفرق is a nominative imperfect verb; بين is an adverb of place attached to نفرق; أحد is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and من رسله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of أحد.
﴿وقالوا سمعنا وأطعنا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; قالوا is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the two clauses سمعنا and أطعنا are the object of saying; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿غفرانك﴾: a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an implied verb, i.e. "forgive" or "we seek forgiveness", or a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "we ask"; and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿ربنا﴾: a munādā (one addressed) that is muḍāf, with the vocative particle omitted.
﴿وإليك المصير﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and what it is conjoined to is omitted and falls within the scope of the saying, i.e. "saying: from You is the beginning, and to You is the return". إليك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar, and المصير is a postponed mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:286-286.t:
﴿لا يكلف الله نفسًا إلا وسعها﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position. لا is negative; يكلف is a nominative imperfect verb; the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil (agent); نفسًا is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); إلا is a particle of restriction; and وسعها is the second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿لها ما كسبت وعليها ما اكتسبت﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. لها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); ما is a relative noun, a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause كسبت has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; and وعليها ما اكتسبت is conjoined to what precedes.
﴿ربنا لا تؤاخذنا﴾: ربنا is a munādā (one addressed) that is muḍāf; لا is the lā of request, used for supplication; تؤاخذنا is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by لا; نا is the mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "You"; the clause falls within the scope of the preceding saying; and the vocative clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن نسينا أو أخطأنا﴾: إن is conditional; نسينا is a past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and نا is the fāʿil; أو أخطأنا is conjoined to it; the apodosis is omitted, i.e. "then do not take us to task"; and the conditional clause with its apodosis is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ربنا ولا تحمل علينا إصرًا﴾: ربنا is a munādā that is muḍāf, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.
﴿كما حملته﴾: ﴿كما﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being "and do not lay upon us a burden, a laying like Your laying it upon those before us"; ما is maṣdarī; ﴿حملته﴾ is a past verb, the tāʾ being the fāʿil and the hāʾ the mafʿūl bihi; the interpreted maṣdar formed from maṣdarī ﴿ما﴾ and what follows it is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause ﴿حملته﴾ is the ṣila of maṣdarī ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿على الذين من قبلنا﴾: على الذين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to حملته; من قبلنا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ṣila of الذين, i.e. "who were of the former nations"; and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿ربنا ولا تحملنا ما لا طاقة لنا به﴾: conjoined to what precedes; ما is the second mafʿūl bihi of تحملنا; لا is the lā of generic negation; طاقة is its noun, indeclinable on the fatḥa in the position of the accusative; لنا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to طاقة; and به is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of لا.
﴿واعف عنا﴾: a verb of supplication conjoined to what precedes, and عنا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to اعف.
﴿واغفر لنا﴾: another conjunction.
﴿وارحمنا﴾: another conjunction.
﴿أنت مولانا﴾: أنت is a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ, and مولانا is the khabar; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فانصرنا على القوم الكافرين﴾: the fāʾ is causal, and the clause is causal, with no grammatical position; على القوم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to انصرنا; and الكافرين is a naʿt.

muyesser-irab:180-180.t:
﴿كتب﴾: a past verb, passive (built for that whose agent is not named).
﴿عليكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «كتب»; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إذا﴾: an adverb (ẓarf) for future time, containing the sense of condition, attached to the omitted apodosis (jawāb), i.e.: "let him make a bequest" (فليوص).
﴿حضر﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa.
﴿أحدكم﴾: a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿الموت﴾: a postponed fāʿil (agent); the verbal clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).
﴿إن﴾: a jussive conditional particle that puts two verbs in the jussive.
﴿ترك﴾: a past verb in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو).
﴿خيرا﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the omitted apodosis of «إذا», i.e.: "let him make a bequest" (فليوص).
﴿الوصية﴾: the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of «كتب».
﴿للوالدين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «الوصية».
﴿والأقربين﴾: conjoined to His words «للوالدين».
﴿بالمعروف﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: being just, not unjust.
﴿حقا﴾: a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, emphasising the content of the clause; the implied form is: "that is due, truly due" (حق ذلك حقا).
﴿على المتقين﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «حقًّا».

muyesser-irab:181-181.t:
﴿فمن﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and «من» is a jussive conditional noun (ism sharṭ jāzim) in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿بدله﴾: a past verb in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).
﴿بعدما سمعه﴾: «بعد» is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), and «ما» is maṣdariyya, interpreted together with the verb after it as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) that is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), i.e.: "after his hearing it and verifying it"; the pronoun refers back to the ruling.
﴿فإنما﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and «إنما» is a restraining [particle] and a restrained [one] (kāffa wa-makfūfa).
﴿إثمه﴾: mubtadaʾ.
﴿على الذين يبدلونه﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); the clause «يبدلونه» has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the nominal clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis and its apodosis are in the position of the nominative as the khabar of «من». The clause «فمن بدله بعدما...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن الله﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism).
﴿سميع عليم﴾: two khabars of «إن»; the clause «إن الله سميع عليم» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:182-182.t:
﴿فمن﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and «من» is a jussive conditional noun (ism sharṭ jāzim) in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿خاف﴾: a past verb in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); its fāʿil (agent) is "he" (هو), referring back to «من».
﴿من موص﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) His word «جنفًا», because it is a maṣdar (verbal noun).
﴿جنفا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿أو﴾: a conjunction.
﴿إثما﴾: conjoined to His word «جنفًا».
﴿فأصلح﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «أصلح» is a past verb conjoined to «خاف»; its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو).
﴿بينهم﴾: an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to «أصلح», i.e.: between the testator and those to whom the bequest is made.
﴿فلا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and «لا» is the lā of generic negation.
﴿إثم﴾: the noun of «لا», indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa.
﴿عليه﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of «لا»; the clause linked by the fāʾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis and its apodosis are in the position of the nominative as the khabar of «من». The clause «فمن خاف من...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن الله غفور رحيم﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and «غفور رحيم» are its two khabars; the clause gives the reason for the removal of sin, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:183-183.t:
﴿يا أيها﴾: «يا» is a vocative particle, and «أي» is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of the accusative; «ها» is for drawing attention (tanbīh).
﴿الذين﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of «أي».
﴿آمنوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿كتب﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, and it is passive (built for that whose agent is not named).
﴿عليكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «كتب».
﴿الصيام﴾: the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of «كتب».
﴿كما كتب﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being: "it was prescribed with a prescribing like its prescribing"; «ما» is maṣdariyya, and «كُتِب» is a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, and it is passive; its nāʾib fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "it" (هو); the clause «كُتِب» is the ṣila of the maṣdariyya «ما», with no grammatical position, and the interpreted maṣdar formed from the maṣdariyya «ما» and the verb «كُتِب» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿على الذين﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «كتب».
﴿من قبلكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ṣila of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. The vocative clause and what follows it is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿لعلكم تتقون﴾: the clause of hope (rajāʾ) is a ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause «تتقون» is the khabar (predicate) of «لعل».

muyesser-irab:184-184.t:
﴿أياما﴾: accusative by an omitted verb indicated by what precedes it, the implied form being: "fast days" (صوموا أيامًا); or an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb.
﴿معدودات﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of «أيام», the sign of its accusative being the kasra, because it is a sound feminine plural.
﴿فمن﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and «من» is a jussive conditional noun (ism sharṭ jāzim), mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿كان﴾: a deficient (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو).
﴿منكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿مريضا﴾: the khabar (predicate) of «كان».
﴿أو﴾: a conjunction.
﴿على سفر﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted [word] conjoined to «مريضًا», and it too is a ḥāl. [Translator's note: so in the source; «مريضًا» was just parsed as the khabar of «كان».]
﴿فعدة﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «عدة» is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e.: "then upon him is a number" (فعليه عدة); or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being: "then the ruling is a number" (فالحكم عدة). The nominal clause joined with the fāʾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of «من».
﴿من أيام﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective of «عدة».
﴿أخر﴾: an adjective of «أيام», the sign of its genitive being the fatḥa, because it is a diptote. The clause «فمن كان منكم...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وعلى الذين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar.
﴿يطيقونه﴾: an imperfect verb; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿فدية﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ.
﴿طعام مسكين﴾: a corresponding badal (badal muṭābiq, substitute) from «فدية», and «مسكين» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿فمن﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and «من» is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ.
﴿تطوع﴾: a past verb, and it is the protasis; its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "he" (هو).
﴿خيرا﴾: accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e.: "with an increase on the amount mentioned in the ransom"; or standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an adjective of the maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e.: "a good volunteering" (تطوعًا خيرًا).
﴿فهو﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, because it is a nominal clause, and «هو» is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿خير﴾: khabar.
﴿له﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «خير»; the nominal clause joined with the fāʾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of «من». The clause «فمن تطوع...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وأن تصوموا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and «أن» and what falls within its scope are interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar), mubtadaʾ.
﴿خير﴾: its khabar.
﴿لكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «خير». The clause «وأن تصوموا...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن﴾: conditional.
﴿كنتم﴾: a deficient past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis, and the tāʾ is its noun.
﴿تعلمون﴾: the verbal clause is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of «كنتم», and the apodosis is omitted. The conditional clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:185-185.t:
﴿شهر رمضان﴾: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), and «رمضان» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿الذي﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of «شهر».
﴿أنزل فيه القرآن﴾: the verbal clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; «القرآن» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿هدى﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "guiding" (هاديًا).
﴿للناس﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «هدى», or [are] an adjective of «هدى».
﴿وبينات﴾: conjoined to «هدى», so it too is a ḥāl.
﴿من الهدى﴾: an adjective of «بينات».
﴿والفرقان﴾: conjoined to «الهدى».
﴿فمن﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an omitted condition), i.e.: if you wish to know the ruling legislated concerning it; «من» is a jussive conditional noun (ism sharṭ jāzim), mubtadaʾ.
﴿شهد﴾: a past verb in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), referring back to «من».
﴿منكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿الشهر﴾: accusative as an adverb (ʿalā al-ẓarfiyya).
﴿فليصمه﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), because the clause is one of request (ṭalabiyya); the lām is the lām of command, «يصم» is an imperfect verb, jussive by the lām, and the hāʾ is the pronoun of the adverb, accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e.: "let him fast in it" (فليصم فيه); the request clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of «من».
﴿ومن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «من» is a jussive conditional noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ.
﴿كان﴾: a deficient (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis; its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو).
﴿مريضا﴾: the khabar of «كان».
﴿أو على سفر﴾: conjoined to «مريضًا».
﴿فعدة﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis; «عدة» is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e.: "then upon him is a number" (فعليه عدة); the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis.
﴿من أيام﴾: both attached to an omitted adjective of «عدة».
﴿أخر﴾: an adjective of «أيام», genitive with the fatḥa, because it is a diptote.
﴿يريد الله﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is causal (taʿlīl).
﴿بكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يريد».
﴿اليسر﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ولا يريد بكم العسر﴾: the clause is conjoined to the one before it.
﴿ولتكملوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl); «تكملوا» is an imperfect verb, accusative by the «أن» concealed after it; the concealed «أن» and the imperfect verb after it are interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) in the genitive by the lām of causation, and the lām and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted verb, i.e.: "He legislated" (شرع).
﴿العدة﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ولتكبروا﴾: conjoined to His words «لتكملوا».
﴿الله﴾: the Name of Majesty is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e.: "to Allah" (لله); or it is a mafʿūl bihi, on the basis that «تكبروا» is made to contain the sense of «تحمدوا» ("praise").
﴿على ما هداكم﴾: «ما» is maṣdariyya, interpreted together with what follows it as a maṣdar in the genitive by «على»; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «تكبروا», i.e.: "for His guiding you" (على هدايته إياكم).
﴿ولعلكم﴾: conjoined to what preceded; «لعل» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the kāf is its noun (ism).
﴿تشكرون﴾: the clause is the khabar of «لعل».

muyesser-irab:186-186.t:
﴿وإذا﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya).
﴿سألك﴾: a past verb, and the kāf is its object.
﴿عبادي﴾: fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).
﴿عني﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «سألك».
﴿فإني﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb) of «إذا»; «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the yāʾ is its noun (ism).
﴿قريب﴾: its khabar (predicate); the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition (jawāb sharṭ ghayr jāzim). The clause «وإذا سألك...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿أجيب﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "I" (أنا); the verbal clause is a second khabar.
﴿دعوة﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿الداع﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive, the sign of its genitive being the kasra implied on the omitted yāʾ.
﴿إذا﴾: the adverb (ẓarf) is attached to «أجيب».
﴿دعان﴾: the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation.
﴿فليستجيبوا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; the lām is the lām of command, and «يستجيبوا» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command.
﴿لي﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يستجيبوا». The clause «فليستجيبوا لي» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وليؤمنوا بي﴾: conjoined to His words «فليستجيبوا لي».
﴿لعلهم يرشدون﴾: «لعل» is an abrogating particle, and the hāʾ is its noun; the clause of hope (rajāʾ) is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:229-229.t:
﴿الطلاق مرتان﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فإمساك﴾: the fāʾ is the "eloquent" fāʾ (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa), as though it were said: "if you know how divorce is to be pronounced, then one of the two options is incumbent on you." إمساك is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e. "then incumbent on you is retaining them" (فعليكم إمساكهن).
﴿بمعروف﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of إمساك.
﴿أو تسريح بإحسان﴾: أو is a conjunction; تسريح is conjoined to إمساك; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt of تسريح.
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, or resumptive; لا is negative.
﴿يحل﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿لكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يحل.
﴿أن تأخذوا﴾: أن and what follows it are to be interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) which is the fāʿil (agent) of يحل.
﴿مما﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تأخذوا, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿آتيتموهن﴾: the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative [noun], with no grammatical position; the wāw after the mīm, which marks the masculine plural, is for prolonging the ḍamma of the mīm.
﴿شيئا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause ﴿ولا يحل لكم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إلا أن يخافا﴾: إلا is a particle of restriction because a negation precedes, or of exception; أن and the verb after it are to be interpreted as a maṣdar, accusative as a ḥāl, or as excepted from the mafʿūl bihi, which is ﴿شيئًا﴾.
﴿ألا يقيما حدود الله﴾: أن and what falls within its scope are in the position of accusative as the object of يخافا; حدود الله is mafʿūl bihi; لا is negative.
﴿فإن خفتم﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إن is conditional; خفتم is a past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the tāʾ is the fāʿil.
﴿ألا يقيما حدود الله﴾: أن and what follows it are in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi of خفتم.
﴿فلا جناح عليهما﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); لا is the lā of generic negation; جناح is its noun (ism); ﴿عليهما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of لا.
﴿فيما افتدت به﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are in the position of accusative as a ḥāl; the clause افتدت is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the preposition and its genitive noun [به] are attached to افتدت. The clause فلا جناح is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. The clause ﴿فإن خفتم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿تلك حدود الله﴾: تلك, the demonstrative, is mubtadaʾ, and حدود الله is its khabar.
﴿فلا تعتدوها﴾: the fāʾ is the eloquent fāʾ, i.e. "if you know these rulings, then do not overstep them"; the clause after it has no grammatical position. The clause ﴿تلك حدود الله﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. لا is prohibitive; تعتدوها is an imperfect verb made jussive by لا; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ومن يتعد حدود الله﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; من is a conditional noun governing the jussive, and is mubtadaʾ; يتعد is the protasis, jussive, the sign of its being jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; حدود الله is mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فأولئك هم الظالمون﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis; أولئك is mubtadaʾ; هم is a second mubtadaʾ and الظالمون is its khabar, and the second mubtadaʾ with its khabar is the khabar of the first; or هم is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position, and الظالمون is the khabar of أولئك. The clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis with its apodosis is the khabar of ﴿من﴾. The clause ﴿ومن يتعد...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:230-230.t:
﴿فإن طلقها فلا تحل له﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, or a conjunction; إن is conditional; طلقها is a past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); ﴿ها﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); لا is negative; تحل is an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "she" (هي); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) تحل; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis.
﴿من بعد﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿حتى تنكح زوجا غيره﴾: حتى is a particle of limit and a preposition; تنكح is an imperfect verb made accusative by an implied أن after حتى; the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the imperfect verb after it are to be interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) made genitive by حتى, and حتى with its genitive is attached to تحل; زوجًا is mafʿūl bihi, and غير is a naʿt (adjective). The clause ﴿فإن طلقها...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فإن طلقها﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إن is conditional; طلقها is a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis; the agent is latent, referring to the second husband; ﴿ها﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فلا جناح عليهما أن يتراجعا﴾: the fāʾ is linking; لا is the lā of generic negation; جناح is its noun (ism), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; ﴿عليهما﴾, the preposition and its genitive noun, is attached to its omitted khabar (predicate); the clause فلا جناح is the apodosis of the condition. أن and what falls within its scope are a maṣdar, accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e. "in returning to each other" (في التراجع), the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to an omitted ḥāl; the [dual] pronoun refers to the wife and the first husband. The clause ﴿فإن طلقها...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن ظنا﴾: إن is conditional; ظنا is a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, and the alif is the fāʿil. It is the protasis, and its apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.
﴿أن يقيما﴾: أن is a maṣdar-forming particle governing the accusative; يقيما is an imperfect verb made accusative by أن. The interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن﴾ and what falls within its scope is the first object of ظن, and the second object is omitted, the implied form being: "if they think the upholding of Allah's limits to be possible" (إن ظنا إقامة حدود الله ممكنة); the alif is the fāʿil; the apodosis is omitted.
﴿حدود الله﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وتلك﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and تلك is mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿حدود الله﴾: khabar. The clause ﴿وتلك حدود الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿يبينها﴾: an imperfect verb with a latent agent referring to the Name of Majesty; ﴿ها﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of nominative as a second khabar, or [is] a ḥāl.
﴿لقوم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يبينها.
﴿يعلمون﴾: the clause is a naʿt of قوم.

muyesser-irab:231-231.t:
﴿وإذا طلقتم النساء﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إذا is a future adverb implying the meaning of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis; the clause طلقتم النساء is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); النساء is the object of طلقتم.
﴿فبلغن أجلهن﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; بلغن is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn; the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil (agent); أجلهن is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فأمسكوهن بمعروف﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); أمسكوهن is an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أمسكوهن. The clause ﴿وإذا طلقتم النساء﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿أو سرحوهن بمعروف﴾: the clause is conjoined to the one before it.
