﴿ولا تمسكوهن ضرارا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تمسكوهن is an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by لا, the sign of its being jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi, and the nūn is the sign of the feminine. ضرارًا is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "for the sake of harming," or a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "harming them" (مضارِّين لهن).
﴿لتعتدوا﴾: the lām is of reason (lām al-taʿlīl); تعتدوا is an imperfect verb made accusative by an implied أن after the lām; the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the imperfect verb after it are to be interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) made genitive by the lām of reason, and the lām of reason with its genitive is attached to ﴿ضرارًا﴾.
﴿ومن يفعل ذلك﴾: the wāw is resumptive; من is conditional and is mubtadaʾ (subject); يفعل is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), its agent being "he" (هو); ذلك is mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فقد ظلم نفسه﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis; قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq); ظلم is a past verb, its fāʿil being "he" (هو); نفسه is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis with its apodosis is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿من﴾. The clause ﴿ومن يفعل ذلك...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولا تتخذوا آيات الله هزوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, or [a wāw] of resumption, in which case the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; لا is prohibitive; تتخذوا is an imperfect verb made jussive by لا; the wāw is the fāʿil; آيات الله is the first mafʿūl bihi, and هزوًا is the second mafʿūl bihi of تتخذوا, i.e. "mocked at" (مهزوءًا بها).
﴿واذكروا نعمت الله عليكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اذكروا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil; نعمة الله is mafʿūl bihi; عليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿نعمة﴾ if it is taken as a maṣdar, i.e. "remember His bestowing [favour] upon you," or attached to an omitted ḥāl of ﴿نعمة﴾ if it is taken as a noun, i.e. "remember His favour, being upon you."
﴿وما أنزل عليكم من الكتاب والحكمة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is a relative noun conjoined to نعمة; the clause أنزل is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; عليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنزل; من الكتاب, the preposition and its genitive noun, is attached to an omitted ḥāl; الحكمة is conjoined to الكتاب.
﴿يعظكم به﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "He" (هو); the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a ḥāl; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يعظكم.
﴿واتقوا الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اتقوا is conjoined to اذكروا.
﴿واعلموا أن الله بكل شيء عليم﴾: conjoined to what precedes; أن and what falls within its scope stand in place of the two objects of اعلموا.

muyesser-irab:232-232.t:
﴿وإذا طلقتم النساء﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إذا is a future adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis; the clause طلقتم النساء is in the position of genitive by the adverb's being annexed to it (iḍāfa). النساء is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فبلغن أجلهن﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; بلغن is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn; the nūn is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined to the clause طلقتم.
﴿فلا تعضلوهن﴾: the fāʾ is linking; لا is prohibitive; تعضلوهن is an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by لا; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of إذا.
﴿أن ينكحن أزواجهن﴾: أن and what follows it are a maṣdar, accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ); and it has been said: the maṣdar is in the position of accusative as a badal (substitute) of the pronoun, a substitute of inclusion (badal ishtimāl). أزواجهن is mafʿūl bihi.
﴿إذا تراضوا بينهم بالمعروف﴾: إذا is a future adverb implying the meaning of condition, attached to تعضلوهن or to بينحكن [Translator's note: so in the source; evidently a misprint for ينكحن]. The clause تراضوا is in the position of genitive by annexation; بينهم is an adverb attached to تراضوا; بالمعروف is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent of تراضوا, or [is] a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar. The clause ﴿وإذا طلقتم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ذلك﴾: the demonstrative is mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿يوعظ به﴾: an imperfect verb in the passive (whose agent is not named); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يوعظ; the clause يوعظ به is the khabar (predicate) of the demonstrative, and the demonstrative clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿من كان﴾: من is a relative noun in the position of nominative as the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of يوعظ; كان is a defective past verb (one of kāna and its sisters), its noun (ism) being a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿منكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿يؤمن بالله واليوم الآخر﴾: the verbal clause is in the position of accusative as the khabar of كان.
﴿ذلكم أزكى لكم وأطهر﴾: ذلكم is mubtadaʾ and أزكى is its khabar; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أزكى. The clause ﴿ذلك أزكى لكم﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿والله يعلم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ, and the clause يعلم is the khabar. The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وأنتم لا تعلمون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أنتم is mubtadaʾ; لا is negative; the clause ﴿لا تعلمون﴾ is the khabar of أنتم.

muyesser-irab:233-233.t:
﴿والوالدات﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, or resumptive; الوالدات is mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿يرضعن﴾: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn; the nūn is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿أولادهن﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿يرضعن﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of الوالدات.
﴿حولين﴾: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) يرضعن.
﴿كاملين﴾: a naʿt (adjective).
﴿لمن﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "that ruling is for whoever" (ذلك الحكم لمن). The clause ﴿الوالدات يرضعن﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿أراد أن يتم الرضاعة﴾: the clause ﴿أراد﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position. أن and what falls within its scope are to be interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) which is the mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مَن﴾ refers to the mother; or the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يرضعن, in which case it refers to the father. The clause ﴿والوالدات يرضعن أولادهن...﴾ is resumptive, on the view that the wāw is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وعلى المولود له رزقهن وكسوتهن بالمعروف﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; على المولود [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; له is a preposition and its genitive noun in the position of nominative as the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of المولود, because it is a passive participle; رزقهن is a delayed mubtadaʾ, and كسوتهن is conjoined to it; بالمعروف [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿لا تكلف نفس إلا وسعها﴾: the clause is explicative (tafsīriyya) or gives the reason (taʿlīliyya), and on both views it has no grammatical position. لا is negative. تكلف is an imperfect verb in the passive (whose agent is not named); نفس is the nāʾib fāʿil; إلا is a particle of restriction; وسعها is the second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿لا تضار والدة بولدها﴾: لا is prohibitive, and تضار is an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by لا; the sign of its being jussive is the sukūn, the fatḥa having taken its place because of its lightness in a doubled verb; the verb is passive; والدة is the nāʾib fāʿil; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تضار; the clause is a ḥāl.
﴿ولا مولود له بولده﴾: conjoined to what precedes; the bāʾ in both is causal.
﴿وعلى الوارث مثل ذلك﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; مثل ذلك is a delayed mubtadaʾ.
﴿فإن أرادا فصالا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إن is conditional; أرادا is a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the alif is the fāʿil; فصالًا is mafʿūl bihi.
﴿عن تراض منهما وتشاور﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt of ﴿فصالًا﴾; منهما is a naʿt of تراض; تشاور is conjoined to تراض.
﴿فلا جناح عليهما﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); لا is the lā of generic negation; جناح is its noun (ism); ﴿عليهما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar; the clause is the apodosis. The clause ﴿فإن أرادا فصالا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وإن أردتم أن تسترضعوا أولادكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is conditional; أردتم is a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis; the tāʾ is the fāʿil; أن and what falls within its scope are to be interpreted as a maṣdar which is the mafʿūl bihi of أردتم. أولادكم is the second mafʿūl bihi of تسترضعوا, the first object being omitted; and it has been said: أولادكم is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), the preposition and its genitive noun being the second object, the implied form being: "that you seek for your children a wet-nurse other than the mother" (أن تسترضعوا لأولادكم غير الوالدة).
﴿فلا جناح عليكم﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis; لا is the lā of generic negation; جناح is its noun, and عليكم is its khabar; the clause is the apodosis.
﴿إذا سلمتم ما آتيتم بالمعروف﴾: إذا is an adverb for future time, governing its condition in the genitive and made accusative by its omitted apodosis; the clause سلمتم is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); ما is a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the clause آتيتم has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun; بالمعروف, the preposition and its genitive noun, is attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿واتقوا الله﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the clause ﴿اتقوا الله﴾, consisting of the verb, the fāʿil and the mafʿūl bihi, is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿واعلموا﴾: conjoined to واتقوا.
﴿أن الله بما تعملون بصير﴾: أن and what follows it stand in place of the two objects of اعلموا; the clause تعملون is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; بصير is the khabar of أن.

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿وعلم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «علم» is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa; its fāʿil (agent) is a pronoun latent (mustatir) in it, its implied form being "he" (هو), referring back to Allah; the clause is conjoined to omitted clauses, their implied form being: "So He placed a vicegerent on the earth and named him Adam" (فجعل في الأرض خليفة وسماه آدم).
﴿آدم﴾: the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿الأسماء﴾: the second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿كلها﴾: a tawkīd (emphasis) of «الأسماء».
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction for sequence with delay (tarākhī).
﴿عرضهم﴾: conjoined to the clause «وعلم», i.e.: "and He presented the things named, or cast them into their hearts".
﴿على الملائكة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عرضهم».
﴿فقال﴾: conjoined to the clause «عرضهم».
﴿أنبئوني﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the omission of the nūn, because its imperfect is one of the five verbs; the wāw is the fāʿil; the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya); and the yāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), mafʿūl bihi.
﴿بأسماء﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are in the place of the second object.
﴿هؤلاء﴾: the demonstrative, indeclinable on kasra, in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by annexation.
﴿إن﴾: a conditional particle that makes [the verb] jussive.
﴿كنتم﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb [of kāna and its sisters], and the tāʾ is its noun.
﴿صادقين﴾: its khabar (predicate); «كنتم» is in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being: "then inform Me" (فأنبئوني).

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿قالوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿سبحانك﴾: standing in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb) by an omitted verb; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿لا﴾: the lā of generic negation.
﴿علم﴾: the noun of «لا», indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of an accusative.
﴿لنا﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of «لا».
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿ما﴾: maṣdariyya (infinitival) or a relative noun; [as maṣdariyya] together with what it governs, or [as relative noun] on its own, it is in the place of a nominative (marfūʿ) as a badal (substitute) from the position of «لا» and its noun.
﴿علمتنا﴾: a verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿إنك﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the kāf is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of an accusative, the noun of «إن».
﴿أنت﴾: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position.
﴿العليم﴾: the first khabar of «إن».
﴿الحكيم﴾: the second khabar of «إن»; or «أنت» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose two khabars are «العليم» and «الحكيم», and the nominal clause is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of «إن».

muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿قال﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿يا آدم﴾: «يا» is a vocative particle for the one at middle distance, and «آدم» is the one addressed (munādā), a single proper noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma.
﴿أنبئهم﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on sukūn; its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿بأسمائهم﴾: in the place of the second object.
﴿فلما﴾: the fāʾ conjoins to an omitted clause, the implied form being: "so he informed them of their names, and when he had informed them" (فأنبأهم بأسمائهم فلما أنبأهم); the clause was omitted because the meaning is clear. «لما» is adverbial in the sense of "when" (حين), or connective (rābiṭa), containing the meaning of condition in either case.
﴿أنبأهم﴾: the clause is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the annexation of the adverb to it, if «لما» is taken as adverbial; or conjoined, if it is for linking.
﴿بأسمائهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أنبأهم».
﴿قال﴾: the clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿ألم﴾: the hamza is for the interrogation of affirmation (istifhām taqrīrī) — when the hamza enters upon a negation it conveys affirmation — and «لم» is a particle of negation, conversion [of the imperfect to past meaning], and jussive.
﴿أقل﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لم»; its fāʿil is a pronoun latent in it, its implied form being "I" (أنا).
﴿لكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «أقل».
﴿إني﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the yāʾ is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of an accusative, the noun of «إن».
﴿أعلم﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; the clause of «إن» and what falls within its scope is in the position of an accusative as the object of speech.
﴿غيب السماوات﴾: «غيب»: the object of «أعلم».
﴿والأرض﴾: conjoined to «السماوات».
﴿وأعلم﴾: conjoined to the first «أعلم».
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi.
﴿تبدون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative; the clause «تبدون» is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of «ما».
﴿وما﴾: conjoined to the first «ما».
﴿كنتم﴾: «كان» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the tāʾ is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of a nominative, the noun of «كان».
﴿تكتمون﴾: the verbal clause is in the position of an accusative, the khabar of «كنتم».

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿وإذ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «إذ» is a noun of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), conjoined to the first «إذ» in the words of the Exalted «وإذ قال ربك».
﴿قلنا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the verbal clause is in the position of a genitive (majrūr), muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿للملائكة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قلنا».
﴿اسجدوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the omission of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the verbal clause is in the position of an accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿لآدم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «اسجدوا».
﴿فسجدوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «سجدوا» is a verb and its fāʿil.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of exception.
﴿إبليس﴾: excepted by «إلا», connected (muttaṣil) [exception] if Iblīs was originally one of the angels; and it has been said: disconnected (munqaṭiʿ), because he is not one of them.
﴿أبى﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif; the verbal clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "in the state of his refusing the command, being arrogant towards it, disbelieving in it".
﴿واستكبر﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «استكبر» is a past verb conjoined to «أبى».
﴿وكان﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «كان» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb [of kāna and its sisters]; its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو).
﴿من الكافرين﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of «كان».

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿وقلنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «قلنا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), conjoined to «قلنا».
﴿يا آدم﴾: «يا» is a vocative particle, and «آدم» is the one addressed (munādā), a single proper noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb).
﴿اسكن﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت).
﴿أنت﴾: a tawkīd (emphasis) of the fāʿil latent in «اسكن».
﴿وزوجك﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «زوجك» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the pronoun latent in «اسكن».
﴿الجنة﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) by extension of usage (ʿalā al-saʿa).
﴿وكلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «كلا» is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the omission of the nūn, because its imperfect is one of the five verbs; the alif is an attached pronoun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), fāʿil.
﴿منها﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «كلا».
﴿رغدا﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "an abundant eating" (أكلًا رغدًا), so it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); or a ḥāl (circumstantial) interpreted as a derived word, i.e. "in abundance and ease" (راغدين هانئين).
﴿حيث﴾: an adverb of place, indeclinable on ḍamma, attached to «كلا».
﴿شئتما﴾: the verbal clause is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the annexation of the adverb of place to it.
﴿ولا تقربا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «لا» is prohibitive, and «تقربا» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لا», the sign of its jussive being the omission of the nūn; the alif is the fāʿil.
﴿هذه﴾: a demonstrative in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi.
﴿الشجرة﴾: a badal (substitute) from the demonstrative.
﴿فتكونا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ of causation (fāʾ al-sababiyya), and «تكونا» is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن» after the fāʾ of causation; the alif is an attached pronoun in the position of a nominative, the noun of «تكونا».
﴿من الظالمين﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of «تكون».
﴿وقلنا﴾: conjoined to what precedes; the clause «كان» is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. [Translator's note: this final line does not fit this ayah — «وقلنا» was already parsed at its start and there is no relative noun or «كان» here; it appears to be carried over from elsewhere in the source.]

muyesser-irab:108-108.t:
﴿أم﴾: a disconnective (munqaṭiʿa) conjunction in the sense of بل plus the hamza, the implied form being: بل أتريدون ... (nay, do you want…), and it is a rhetorical interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī).
﴿تريدون﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿أن تسألوا﴾: أن together with what falls within its scope is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is the object of تريدون.
﴿رسولكم﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of تسألوا.
﴿كما سئل موسى﴾: the kāf is a noun in the sense of مثل (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar, i.e.: أن تسألوا رسولكم سؤالا مثل سؤال... (that you ask your Messenger a questioning like the questioning…); ما is maṣdarī; ﴿سئل﴾ is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and ﴿موسى﴾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause ﴿سئل﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdarī ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position, and the interpreted maṣdar formed from the maṣdarī ﴿ما﴾ and the verb ﴿سئل﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct).
﴿من قبل﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) سئل.
﴿ومن﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and من is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿يتبدل﴾: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).
﴿الكفر﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿بالإيمان﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يتبدل.
﴿فقد﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq).
﴿ضل﴾: a past verb, and its fāʿil is هو.
﴿سواء السبيل﴾: its object; the clause is in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis, and the clause ﴿من يتبدل...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:109-109.t:
﴿ود كثير من أهل الكتاب﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the preposition and its genitive noun are a naʿt (adjective) of كثير.
﴿لو يردونكم﴾: لو is maṣdarī; together with what follows it, it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is the object of ﴿ود﴾; يردونكم is a verb, its fāʿil, and first object.
﴿من بعد إيمانكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) يردون, and إيمانكم is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct).
﴿كفارا﴾: second object of يردونكم.
﴿حسدا﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).
﴿من عند أنفسهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ود.
﴿من بعد ما تبين لهم الحق﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ود; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdarī, interpreted together with the verb after it as a maṣdar in the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; الحق is the fāʿil of ﴿تبين﴾.
﴿فاعفوا﴾: the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa ("disclosing") fāʾ, and ﴿اعفوا﴾ is an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil.
﴿واصفحوا﴾: conjoined to فاعفوا.
﴿حتى يأتي الله بأمره﴾: حتى is a particle of limit and of the genitive; يأتي is an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an أن implied after حتى; أن and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar in the genitive by حتى, and the preposition with its genitive noun is attached to اعفوا; الله is the fāʿil, and بأمره is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يأتي.
﴿إن الله على كل شيء قدير﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism), and قدير its khabar (predicate); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to قدير; the clause ﴿إن الله...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position, or serves as a justification (taʿlīl).

muyesser-irab:110-110.t:
﴿وأقيموا الصلاة﴾: the wāw is resumptive; أقيموا is an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the nūn, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and الصلاة is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clauses are resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وآتوا الزكاة﴾: conjoined to what preceded.
﴿وما تقدموا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ما is a jussive conditional noun in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi; تقدموا is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the wāw is the fāʿil.
﴿لأنفسكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) تقدموا.
﴿من خير﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are a naʿt (adjective) of the conditional noun, or a tamyīz (specification).
﴿تجدوه﴾: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the omission of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi.
﴿عند الله﴾: the adverb is attached to تجدوه or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause ﴿وما تقدموا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن الله﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism).
﴿بما تعملون﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to بصير.
﴿بصير﴾: the khabar (predicate) of إن; the clause ﴿إن الله...﴾ has no grammatical position, being resumptive or causal (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:111-111.t:
﴿وقالوا﴾: conjoined to ود; the pronoun refers to the People of the Book among the Jews and the Christians.
﴿لن﴾: a particle of negation, of the accusative, and of the future.
﴿يدخل﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by لن.
﴿الجنة﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa).
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿من﴾: a relative noun, fāʿil (agent).
﴿كان﴾: a defective past verb; its noun (ism) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being: هو.
﴿هودا﴾: its khabar (predicate).
﴿أو نصارى﴾: conjoined to ﴿هودًا﴾.
﴿تلك﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿أمانيهم﴾: khabar; the nominal clause ﴿تلك أمانيهم﴾ is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya), with no grammatical position.
﴿قل هاتوا برهانكم﴾: قل is an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being: أنت; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿هاتوا﴾: an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil.
﴿برهانكم﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿إن كنتم صادقين﴾: a condition and its verb; the apodosis (jawāb) is omitted, the implied form being: فهاتوا برهانكم (then produce your proof).

muyesser-irab:112-112.t:
﴿بلى﴾: a particle of response, cancelling the negation in their saying: ﴿لن يدخل الجنة ...﴾.
﴿من﴾: a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿أسلم وجهه﴾: a past verb; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being هو, and وجهه is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The verbal clause is in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).
﴿لله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أسلم.
﴿وهو﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, and هو is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿محسن﴾: its khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فله أجره﴾: the fāʾ is linking; the preposition and its genitive noun are a fronted khabar, and أجره is a delayed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the clause of the protasis and its apodosis is the khabar of the conditional noun ﴿مَن﴾.
﴿عند ربه﴾: the adverb is attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿ولا خوف﴾: the wāw: a conjunction; لا: negative; and خوف: a mubtadaʾ; it is permissible to begin with it though it is indefinite because the negation precedes it.
﴿عليهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ.
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿لا﴾ is negative.
﴿هم﴾: an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ.
﴿يحزنون﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿يحزنون﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ﴿هم﴾.

muyesser-irab:113-113.t:
﴿وقالت اليهود﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿ليست النصارى على شيء﴾: ليس is a defective past verb, النصارى is its noun (ism), and على شيء its khabar (predicate); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿وقالت النصارى ليست اليهود على شيء﴾: conjoined to the first clause.
﴿وهم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and هم is a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿يتلون﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar of هم, and the nominal clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿الكتاب﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun in the sense of مثل (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar placed before its governor, i.e.: قولا مثل ذلك قال الذين لا يعلمون (a saying like that said those who do not know); and ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address.
﴿قال الذين﴾: a verb and its fāʿil.
﴿لا يعلمون﴾: لا is negative, يعلمون is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين.
﴿مثل قولهم﴾: ﴿مثلَ﴾ is a badal (substitute) from the position of the kāf, accusative, or the mafʿūl bihi of ﴿يعلمون﴾; ﴿قولهم﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the attached pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿فالله﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and الله is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿يحكم﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is هو; the clause is the khabar of الله.
﴿بينهم﴾: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) يحكم.
﴿يوم القيامة﴾: the adverb is attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿فيما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يحكم.
﴿كانوا﴾: كان is a past, defective, abrogating (nāsikh) verb, and the wāw is its noun; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿فيه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يختلفون.
﴿يختلفون﴾: the verbal clause is the khabar of كان; the clause ﴿فالله يحكم بينهم﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:114-114.t:
﴿ومن﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and مَن is an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿أظلم﴾: the khabar (predicate) of من.
﴿ممن﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أظلم.
﴿منع مساجد الله﴾: a past verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) referring to من, and مساجد الله is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the clause ﴿ومن أظلم ممن...﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is resumptive.
﴿أن يذكر﴾: أن together with what falls within its scope is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is the second object of منع; or the maṣdar is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e.: كراهة أن يذكر فيها اسمه (out of aversion to His name being mentioned in them); or it is a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) from مساجد الله, because they include the remembrance.
﴿فيها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يذكر.
﴿اسمه﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿وسعى﴾: conjoined to منع.
﴿في خرابها﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to سعى.
﴿أولئك﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ما﴾: negative.
﴿كان﴾: a defective past verb.
﴿لهم﴾: the fronted khabar of كان.
﴿أن يدخلوها﴾: the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and what falls within its scope is the delayed noun (ism) of كان.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿خائفين﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of يدخلوها.
﴿لهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are a fronted khabar.
﴿في الدنيا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿خزي﴾: a delayed mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿لهم في الدنيا خزي﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is resumptive.
﴿ولهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لهم is a fronted khabar.
﴿في الآخرة﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl.
﴿عذاب﴾: a delayed mubtadaʾ.
﴿عظيم﴾: naʿt (adjective) of عذاب.

muyesser-irab:115-115.t:
﴿ولله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition and its genitive noun are a fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿المشرق﴾: a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿والمغرب﴾: conjoined to المشرق.
﴿فأينما﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and أينما is a jussive conditional noun in the position of the accusative as an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) what follows it.
﴿تولوا﴾: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).
﴿فثم﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and ثم is an adverb of place attached to an omitted fronted khabar.
﴿وجه الله﴾: a delayed mubtadaʾ; the clause is in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis, and the clause ﴿فأينما تولوا فثم وجه الله﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿إن الله واسع عليم﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism), and ﴿واسع عليم﴾ are its two khabars.

muyesser-irab:116-116.t:
﴿وقالوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and قالوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause قالوا is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿اتخذ الله ولدا﴾: a verb, its fāʿil, and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿سبحانه﴾: standing in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb) by an omitted verb, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct); together with its omitted verb it is a parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya) clause with no grammatical position.
﴿بل﴾: a particle of conjunction and of digression (iḍrāb).
﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, delayed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿في السماوات﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿والأرض﴾: conjoined to السماوات.
﴿كل﴾: an indefinite mubtadaʾ; it is permissible to begin with it because of the sense of generality in it; the tanwīn on كل is in compensation for a word, i.e.: كل فرد من أفراد المخلوقات (every single one of the created beings).
﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿قانتون﴾, i.e.: humble and submissive.
﴿قانتون﴾: the khabar of كل.

muyesser-irab:117-117.t:
﴿بديع السماوات﴾: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject); it belongs to the category of annexing the resembling adjective (al-ṣifa al-mushabbaha) to its agent, the original being بديع سماواته (whose heavens are wondrously originated).
﴿والأرض﴾: conjoined to السماوات.
﴿وإذا﴾: an adverb of future time, putting its condition in the genitive [by annexation] and accusative by its apodosis (jawāb).
﴿قضى أمرا﴾: the clause is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it.
﴿فإنما﴾: the fāʾ is linking, and إنما is restraining (kāffa).
﴿يقول له﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) يقول; the clause has no grammatical position.
﴿كن﴾: an imperative verb from the complete (tāmma) كان in the sense of حدث (to come into being).
﴿فيكون﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and يكون is a complete imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), i.e.: فهو يحدث (so it comes into being); the clause كن is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), and the clause ﴿فهو يكون﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:118-118.t:
﴿وقال الذين لا يعلمون﴾: the wāw is resumptive; قال is a past verb, and الذين is the fāʿil (agent); the clause لا يعلمون is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿وقال الذين لا يعلمون﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿لولا يكلمنا الله﴾: لولا is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ) in the sense of هلا (why not); يكلمنا الله is a verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil.
﴿أو﴾: a conjunction.
﴿تأتينا﴾: conjoined to يكلمنا.
﴿آية﴾: fāʿil.
﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun in the sense of مثل (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar placed before its governor, i.e.: قولا مثل ذلك قال الذين من قبلهم (a saying like that said those before them); and ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address.
﴿قال الذين من قبلهم﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; من قبلهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted ṣila of the relative noun; the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿مثل قولهم﴾: ﴿مثلَ﴾ is a badal (substitute) from the position of the kāf, accusative; ﴿قولهم﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the attached pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿تشابهت قلوبهم﴾: a verb and its fāʿil.
﴿قد﴾: a particle of realization (taḥqīq).
﴿بينا الآيات﴾: a verb and its fāʿil, and الآيات is mafʿūl bihi, the sign of its accusative being the kasra.
﴿لقوم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to بينا.
﴿يوقنون﴾: the clause is a naʿt of قوم.

muyesser-irab:36-36.t:
﴿فأزلهما﴾: the fāʾ conjoins to an omitted, implied [clause] required by the context of speech, i.e.: "so they ate from that very tree" (فأكلا من الشجرة عينها). «أزلهما» is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa; the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the mīm and the alif are two letters indicating the dual.
﴿الشيطان﴾: the fāʿil (agent) of «أزل».
﴿عنها﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أزلهما», or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فأخرجهما﴾: conjoined to «أزلهما».
﴿مما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «أخرجهما».
﴿كانا﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb [of kāna and its sisters], and the alif is its noun.
﴿فيه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of «كان».
﴿وقلنا﴾: conjoined to what precedes; the clause «كان» is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿اهبطوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the omission of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿بعضكم﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿لبعض﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to His word «عدو»; attached to an omitted ḥāl, because it was originally a naʿt (adjective) of «عدو» and was brought forward before it. [Translator's note: the source lists the two analyses without "or" between them.]
﴿عدو﴾: the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the clause «بعضكم ..» etc. is a nominal clause in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl, i.e. "being enemies to one another" (متعادين).
﴿ولكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «لكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar.
﴿في الأرض﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the [notion of] settling (al-istiqrār) to which the khabar is attached, or to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿مستقر﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ.
﴿ومتاع﴾: conjoined to «مستقر».
﴿إلى حين﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt of «متاع».

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿فتلقى﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and «تلقى» is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the implied (muqaddar) fatḥa.
﴿آدم﴾: fāʿil (agent).
﴿من ربه﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تلقى».
﴿كلمات﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by the kasra, because it is a sound feminine plural. The clause «تلقى آدم...» is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿فتاب﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction [conjoining] to an omitted [clause] required by the situation, i.e.: "so he said them, and He turned [to him]" (فقالها فتاب).
﴿عليه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «تاب».
﴿إنه﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun.
﴿هو﴾: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position; or a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿التواب﴾: the first khabar (predicate) of «إن».
﴿الرحيم﴾: the second khabar of «إن»; or [the two are] two khabars of «هو», and the nominal clause is the khabar of «إن».

muyesser-irab:38-38.t:
﴿قلنا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿اهبطوا﴾: the verbal clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿منها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اهبطوا».
﴿جميعا﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw; the clause «قلنا اهبطوا» follows the clause «وقلنا اهبطوا», as an emphasis (tawkīd) of it.
﴿فإما﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, «إن» is conditional, and «ما» is a connective (ṣila) for emphasis.
﴿يأتينكم﴾: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because of its attachment to the nūn of emphasis, in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the kāf is an attached pronoun in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿مني﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يأتينكم».
﴿هدى﴾: fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif.
﴿فمن﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and «من» is a conditional noun that makes [the verb] jussive, in the position of a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿تبع﴾: a past verb in the position of a jussive as the protasis; the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو).
﴿هداي﴾: the object of «تبع», the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa implied on what precedes the yāʾ of the speaker; the fāʾ and what it governs are in the position of a jussive as the apodosis.
﴿فلا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and «لا» is negative.
﴿خوف﴾: a mubtadaʾ; it is permissible to begin with it although it is indefinite because the negation precedes it.
﴿عليهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ.
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «لا» is negative.
﴿هم﴾: an indeclinable pronoun in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ.
﴿يحزنون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; the clause «يحزنون» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «هم». The conditional clause and its apodosis are the khabar of «مَن».

muyesser-irab:39-39.t:
﴿والذين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «الذين» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is conjoined to His word «فمن تبع هداي».
﴿كفروا﴾: the verbal clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿وكذبوا﴾: conjoined to «كفروا», falling within the scope of the ṣila.
﴿بآياتنا﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «كذبوا».
﴿أولئك﴾: a demonstrative, a second mubtadaʾ.
﴿أصحاب﴾: the khabar (predicate) of «أولئك»; the nominal clause is the khabar of «الذين».
﴿النار﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿هم﴾: a detached pronoun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ.
﴿فيها﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «خالدون».
﴿خالدون﴾: the khabar of «هم»; the clause «هم فيها خالدون» is in the position of a nominative as a second khabar of «أولئك», or in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «أصحاب» or from «النار».

muyesser-irab:40-40.t:
﴿يا بني﴾: «يا» is a vocative particle, and «بني» is the one addressed (munādā), annexed (muḍāf), the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ in place of the fatḥa, because it is treated like the sound masculine plural.
﴿إسرائيل﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), the sign of its genitive being the fatḥa in place of the kasra, because it is a diptote, for being a proper name and foreign.
﴿اذكروا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the nūn, because of its attachment to the wāw of the plural; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿نعمتي﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on what precedes the yāʾ of the speaker; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿التي﴾: a relative noun in the position of an accusative, a naʿt (adjective) of «نعمتي».
﴿أنعمت﴾: a verb and its fāʿil.
﴿عليكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أنعمت»; the clause «أنعمت» is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿وأوفوا﴾: conjoined to «اذكروا».
﴿بعهدي﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «أوفوا».
﴿أوف﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) in answer to the request.
﴿بعهدكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «أوف».
﴿وإياي﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «إياي» is a detached pronoun in the position of an accusative, a fronted mafʿūl bihi of an implied verb explained by what follows it, its implied form being: "fear" (ارهبوا).
﴿فارهبون﴾: the fāʾ is a connective (ṣila); «ارهبونِ» is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the omission of the nūn; the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya); and the omitted yāʾ of the speaker is the object; the clause «ارهبونِ» is explicative (tafsīriyya), a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:187-187.t:
﴿أحل﴾: a past verb, passive (built for that whose agent is not named).
﴿لكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أحل».
﴿ليلة الصيام﴾: an adverb (ẓarf), accusative (manṣūb).
﴿الرفث﴾: the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of «أحل».
﴿إلى نسائكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «الرفث»; the clause «أحل» and what follows it is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿هن﴾: a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿لباس﴾: khabar (predicate).
﴿لكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of «لباس»; the clause «هن لباس لكم» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وأنتم لباس لهن﴾: conjoined to the one before it.
﴿علم الله﴾: the clause gives the reason for the occasion of the verse's revelation.
﴿أنكم﴾: «أن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the kāf is its noun (ism).
﴿كنتم﴾: a deficient (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun.
﴿تختانون أنفسكم﴾: the verbal clause is the khabar of «كنتم». «أن» and what falls within its scope take the place of the two objects of «علم».
﴿وعفا عنكم﴾: conjoined to the clause «علم الله».
﴿فالآن﴾: conjoined to an omitted, implied [clause], i.e.: "so you repented and He relented towards you"; «الآن» is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to «باشروهن».
﴿باشروهن﴾: an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent), and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وابتغوا﴾: conjoined to «باشروهن».
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi.
﴿كتب الله لكم﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of «ما».
﴿وكلوا واشربوا﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause «وكلوا» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿حتى﴾: a particle of limit (ghāya) and a preposition.
﴿يتبين﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an «أن» concealed after «حتى»; the interpreted maṣdar formed from «أن» and the verb is genitive by «حتى», and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «كلوا».
﴿لكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يتبين».
﴿الخيط﴾: fāʿil.
﴿الأبيض﴾: an adjective.
﴿من الخيط﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يتبين».
﴿الأسود﴾: an adjective.
﴿من الفجر﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: the white being the dawn.
﴿ثم أتموا﴾: «ثم» is a conjunction for sequence with an interval, and «أتموا» is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil.
﴿الصيام﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿إلى الليل﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «أتموا».
﴿ولا تباشروهن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «لا» is prohibitive (nāhiya), and «تباشروهن» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لا».
﴿وأنتم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, and «أنتم» is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿عاكفون﴾: khabar.
﴿في المساجد﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «عاكفون»; the nominal clause is a ḥāl.
﴿تلك﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ.
﴿حدود الله﴾: khabar and muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause «تلك حدود الله...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فلا تقربوها﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an omitted condition), «لا» is prohibitive, and «تقربوها» is an imperfect verb, jussive by «لا»; the clause «فلا تقربوها...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun) placed before its governor, the implied form being: "with a clarifying like that Allah clarifies His signs"; «ذلك»: «ذا» is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address.
﴿يبين الله﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil.
﴿آياته﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause «كذلك يبين الله...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿للناس﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يبين».
﴿لعلهم يتقون﴾: «لعل» is an abrogating particle, the hāʾ is its noun, and the clause «يتقون» is its khabar; the clause of hope (rajāʾ) is a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:188-188.t:
﴿ولا تأكلوا﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), «لا» is prohibitive (nāhiya), and «تأكلوا» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لا»; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿أموالكم﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «ولا تأكلوا أموالكم» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿بينكم﴾: an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from «أموالكم», i.e.: "do not consume them, being between you."
﴿بالباطل﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «تأكلوا», i.e.: "do not take them by a false means."
﴿وتدلوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «تدلوا» is an imperfect verb conjoined to «تأكلوا», falling within the scope of the prohibition; or [the wāw] is for accompaniment (maʿiyya), and «تدلوا» is accusative by an «أن» concealed after it.
﴿بها﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «تدلوا».
﴿إلى الحكام﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e.: "having recourse [to them], seeking judgement."
﴿لتأكلوا﴾: the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and «تأكلوا» is an imperfect verb, accusative by an «أن» concealed after the lām of causation; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the preposition and its genitive noun are in the position of the accusative as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).
﴿فريقا﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿من أموال الناس﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa).
﴿بالإثم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e.: "clinging to what entails sin, such as false testimony and lying oaths."
﴿وأنتم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «أنتم» is a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿تعلمون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the clause is the khabar (predicate), and the clause after the circumstantial wāw is a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:189-189.t:
﴿يسألونك﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), with its fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿عن الأهلة﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يسألونك».
﴿قل﴾: an imperative verb, with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil, its implied form being "you" (أنت).
﴿هي مواقيت﴾: a nominal clause of mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), in the position of the accusative as the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿للناس﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of «مواقيت».
﴿والحج﴾: conjoined to «الناس». The clause «قل هي مواقيت...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وليس﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and «ليس» is a deficient (nāqiṣ) past verb.
﴿البر﴾: the noun (ism) of «ليس».
﴿بأن تأتوا البيوت﴾: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; «أن» and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar), the khabar of «ليس»; «البيوت» is mafʿūl bihi.
﴿من ظهورها﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «تأتوا». The clause «وليس البر بأن تأتوا البيوت...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولكن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «لكن» is an abrogating particle of rectification (istidrāk).
﴿البر﴾: its noun, accusative (manṣūb); something omitted must be implied for the speech to be coherent, as if it were said: "what you do in pressing your questions is not righteousness; rather righteousness [is]..."
﴿من﴾: a relative noun, the khabar of «لكن», on the assumption that a muḍāf has been omitted, i.e.: "the righteousness of whoever" (بر من).
﴿اتقى﴾: the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿وأتوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction.
﴿البيوت﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿من أبوابها﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «أتوا».
﴿واتقوا الله﴾: the clause is conjoined to the imperative clause.
﴿لعلكم تفلحون﴾: «لعل» is an abrogating particle, the kāf is its noun, and the clause «تفلحون» is its khabar; the clause of hope (rajāʾ) is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:234-234.t:
﴿والذين يتوفون منكم﴾: الذين is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. "among what is recited to you is their ruling" (فيما يتلى عليكم حكمهم). It has been said: الذين is a mubtadaʾ on the assumption that a muḍāf has been omitted, i.e. "and the wives of those of you who die" (وأزواج الذين يتوفون منكم), its khabar being the clause يتربصن. And it has been said: the clause ﴿يتربصن﴾ is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "their wives wait" (أزواجهم يتربصن), and the nominal clause is the khabar of ﴿الذين﴾, the linking element being the pronoun, i.e. the nūn in ﴿يتربصن﴾. The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. منكم: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ويذرون﴾: conjoined to يتوفون.
﴿أزواجا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿يتربصن بأنفسهن﴾: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn.
﴿أربعة أشهر﴾: an adverb of time attached to يتربصن.
﴿وعشرا﴾: conjoined to أربعة.
﴿فإذا بلغن أجلهن﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إذا is a future adverb attached to the apodosis; بلغن is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); أجلهن is mafʿūl bihi; the verbal clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).
﴿فلا جناح عليكم﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis; لا is the lā of generic negation; جناح is its noun (ism); عليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted khabar; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿فيما فعلن في أنفسهن بالمعروف﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl; the clause ﴿فعلن﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; في أنفسهن is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to فعلن; بالمعروف, the preposition and its genitive noun, is attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "being in accordance with what is right" (متلبسات بالمعروف). The clause ﴿فإذا بلغن أجلهن...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿والله بما تعملون خبير﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to خبير; the clause ﴿تعملون﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; خبير is the khabar of the Name of Majesty. The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:190-190.t:
﴿وقاتلوا﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and «قاتلوا» is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿في سبيل الله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قاتلوا».
﴿الذين يقاتلونكم﴾: the relative noun is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause «يقاتلونكم» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position. The clause «وقاتلوا...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولا تعتدوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «لا» is prohibitive (nāhiya), and «تعتدوا» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لا»; the wāw is the fāʿil.
﴿إن الله﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism).
﴿لا يحب المعتدين﴾: «لا» is negating (nāfiya), and «يحب» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), referring back to the Name of Majesty, and «المعتدين» is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause «لا يحب المعتدين» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», and the clause of «إن» and what follows it is causal (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:235-235.t:
﴿ولا جناح عليكم فيما عرضتم به﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is the lā of generic negation; جناح is its noun (ism); عليكم is attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate); the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. [Translator's note: so in the source; there is no condition here, and this last remark appears to be carried over from the parsing of ﴿فلا جناح عليكم﴾ in the preceding ayah (2:234).]
﴿من خطبة النساء﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿أو أكننتم في أنفسكم﴾: أو is a conjunction; the clause أكننتم is conjoined to عرضتم; في أنفسكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أكننتم.
﴿علم الله أنكم ستذكرونهن﴾: the clause serves as a giving of the reason (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position; أن and what follows it stand in place of the two objects of علم; the clause ستذكرونهن is the khabar of أن.
﴿ولكن لا تواعدوهن سرا﴾: the wāw conjoins [this] to something omitted on which the rectification falls, i.e. "so mention them" (فاذكروهن). ﴿لكن﴾ is lightened and inoperative (mukhaffafa muhmala); لا is prohibitive; تواعدهن is an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا; the hāʾ is the first object, and سرًّا is its second object; or [it is] a ḥāl in interpreted form, i.e. "concealing yourselves from people"; or it is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e. "in secret" (في السر); or it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a qualifier of the maṣdar, i.e. "a secret promising" (مواعدة سرًّا).
﴿إلا أن تقولوا قولا معروفا﴾: إلا is a particle of exception; أن is maṣdariyya; تقولوا is an imperfect verb made accusative by أن; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن﴾ and what follows it is accusative as excepted from ﴿سرًّا﴾; قولًا is a mafʿūl muṭlaq, and معروفًا is a naʿt (adjective).
﴿ولا تعزموا عقدة النكاح﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تعزموا is an imperfect verb made jussive by لا; عقدة النكاح is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "upon the marriage tie" (على عقدة النكاح).
﴿حتى يبلغ الكتاب أجله﴾: [حتى is] a particle of limit and a preposition; يبلغ is an imperfect verb made accusative by an implied أن after حتى; the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the imperfect verb after it are to be interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) made genitive by حتى, and حتى with its genitive is attached to تعزموا; الكتاب is the fāʿil (agent), and أجله is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿واعلموا أن الله يعلم ما في أنفسكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اعلموا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; أن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause يعلم is the khabar of أن; أن and what it governs stand in place of the two objects of اعلموا; ما is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi; في أنفسكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, i.e. "[what] is settled in your souls" (استقر في أنفسكم); the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿فاحذروه﴾: the fāʾ is the "eloquent" fāʾ (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa), i.e. "if you know that, then beware of Him."
﴿واعلموا أن الله غفور حليم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اعلموا is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; أن is an abrogating particle; the Name of Majesty is its noun, and غفور حليم are its two khabars; [أن and what it governs] stand in place of the two objects of اعلموا.

muyesser-irab:191-191.t:
﴿واقتلوهم﴾: also conjoined; the command to kill them is repeated for emphasis.
﴿حيث﴾: an adverb of place (ẓarf makān), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اقتلوهم».
﴿ثقفتموهم﴾: a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural, and it has been lengthened with a wāw; the verbal clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).
﴿وأخرجوهم﴾: conjoined to «اقتلوهم».
﴿من حيث﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «أخرجوهم».
﴿أخرجوكم﴾: a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation.
﴿والفتنة﴾: the wāw is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya), and «الفتنة» is a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿أشد﴾: khabar (predicate).
﴿من القتل﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «أشد»; the clause «والفتنة أشد من القتل» is parenthetical, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولا تقاتلوهم عند المسجد الحرام حتى يقاتلوكم فيه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «لا» is prohibitive and jussive-governing; «تقاتلوهم» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, with the wāw as fāʿil, and the mafʿūl bihi; «عند» is an adverb of place attached to «تقاتلوهم», «المسجد» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and «الحرام» is an adjective (ṣifa) of «المسجد»; «حتى» is a preposition, «يقاتلوكم» is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by a concealed «أن», the wāw is the fāʿil and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi; «فيه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يقاتلوا»; the interpreted maṣdar is genitive by «حتى», and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «تقاتلوهم».
﴿فإن﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and «إن» is conditional.
﴿قاتلوكم﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi; the verb is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).
﴿فاقتلوهم﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and «اقتلوهم» is an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause «فاقتلوهم» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. The clause «فإن قاتلوكم فاقتلوهم» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿كذلك جزاء الكافرين﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مِثل), indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; «ذلك»: «ذا» is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; «جزاء الكافرين» is the khabar. Or the kāf in His words «كذلك» is in the position of the nominative as a fronted khabar, and «جزاء الكافرين» is a postponed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause «كذلك جزاء الكافرين» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:236-236.t:
﴿لا جناح عليكم﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position.
﴿إن طلقتم النساء﴾: إن is conditional; طلقتم is a past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. "then do not give them the dower" (فلا تعطوهن المهر); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ما لم تمسوهن﴾: ما is a temporal adverbial maṣdariyya (maṣdariyya ẓarfiyya zamāniyya), or conditional; لم is a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and jussive; تمسوهن is an imperfect verb made jussive by لم.
﴿أو تفرضوا لهن فريضة﴾: أو is a conjunction; تفرضوا is conjoined to تمسوهن; the clause is conjoined to the omitted apodosis of إن. The meaning is: if you divorce women at a time when there has been no touching and no fixing of an obligatory amount, then do not give them the dower.
﴿ومتعوهن﴾: conjoined to فلا تعطوهن المهر, i.e. "give them something they may enjoy."
﴿على الموسع قدره﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); قدره is a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وعلى المقتر قدره﴾: conjoined to what precedes.
﴿متاعا بالمعروف﴾: متاعًا stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar); بالمعروف is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective).
﴿حقا﴾: a mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb, emphasizing the content of the clause, the implied form being "that is due, truly due" (حق ذلك حقا); or a naʿt of ﴿متاعا﴾, the implied form being "a provision according to what is right, binding upon those who do good" (متاعا بالمعروف واجبا على المحسنين).
﴿على المحسنين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the maṣdar.

muyesser-irab:192-192.t:
﴿فإن﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and «إن» is conditional.
﴿انتهوا﴾: an indeclinable (mabnī) past verb in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). The clause «فإن انتهوا» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فإن﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh).
﴿الله﴾: the noun (ism) of «إن».
﴿غفور رحيم﴾: two khabars (predicates) of «إن».

muyesser-irab:237-237.t:
﴿وإن طلقتموهن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is conditional; طلقتم is a past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), with its fāʿil (agent) and its object.
﴿من قبل أن تمسوهن﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) طلقتموهن; أن and what falls within its scope are to be interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar), genitive by annexation (iḍāfa), i.e. "before the touching" (من قبل المسيس).
﴿وقد﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq).
﴿فرضتم﴾: a verb and its fāʿil.
﴿لهن﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿فرضتم﴾.
﴿فريضة﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa.
﴿فنصف﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); نصف is mubtadaʾ (subject) and the khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. "then incumbent on you is half" (فعليكم نصف); or [it is] the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "then what is due is half" (فالواجب نصف).
﴿ما فرضتم﴾: ما is a relative noun in the position of genitive by annexation; the clause ﴿فرضتم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the clause after the fāʾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis.
﴿إلا أن يعفون﴾: إلا is a particle of exception; the interpreted maṣdar from أن and what falls within its scope is accusative as a disjoined exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ); يعفون is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural, and it is in the position of accusative.
﴿أو يعفو﴾: conjoined to يعفون; the sign of its being accusative is the fatḥa.
﴿الذي﴾: the fāʿil of يعفو.
﴿بيده عقدة النكاح﴾: بيده, the preposition and its genitive noun, is attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; عقدة النكاح is a delayed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿وأن تعفوا أقرب للتقوى﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the interpreted maṣdar from أن and what falls within its scope is a nominative mubtadaʾ; أقرب is the khabar; للتقوى is attached to أقرب. The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولا تنسوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تنسوا is an imperfect verb made jussive by لا; the wāw is the fāʿil.
﴿الفضل﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿بينكم﴾: the adverb is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿إن الله بما تعملون بصير﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to بصير; the clause تعملون is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; بصير is the khabar of إن; the clause gives the reason for what precedes.

muyesser-irab:193-193.t:
﴿وقاتلوهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «قاتلوهم» is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿حتى﴾: a particle of limit (ghāya) and a preposition; what is meant by it here is causation (taʿlīl).
﴿لا﴾: negating (nāfiya).
﴿تكون﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an «أن» concealed after «حتى»; «تكون» here is complete (tāmma); the concealed «أن» and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) in the genitive by «حتى», and «حتى» and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قاتلوهم».
﴿فتنة﴾: the fāʿil of «تكون».
﴿ويكون﴾: conjoined to «تكون», and here it is deficient (nāqiṣa).
﴿الدين﴾: its noun (ism).
﴿لله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to its omitted khabar (predicate); or «الدين» is the fāʿil of the complete «يكون», and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "being purely for Allah."
﴿فإن﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and «إن» is conditional.
﴿انتهوا﴾: a past verb in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).
﴿فلا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and «لا» is the lā of generic negation.
﴿عدوان﴾: its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿على الظالمين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of «لا»; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. The clause «فإن انتهوا» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:238-238.t:
﴿حافظوا على الصلوات﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position. حافظوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); على الصلوات is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) حافظوا.
﴿والصلاة﴾: conjoined to الصلوات.
﴿الوسطى﴾: a naʿt (adjective).
﴿وقوموا لله قانتين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; قوموا is conjoined to حافظوا; لله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to قانتين; قانتين is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent of قوموا.

muyesser-irab:239-239.t:
﴿فإن خفتم﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إن is conditional; خفتم is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and it is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).
﴿فرجالا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); رجالًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial), and the governing word is omitted, its implied form being "then pray" (فصلوا), or "then guard it on foot" (فحافظوا عليها رجالًا); the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis.
﴿أو ركبانا﴾: conjoined to ﴿رجالًا﴾. The clause ﴿فإن خفتم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فإذا أمنتم﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إذا is a future adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis; the clause أمنتم is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).
﴿فاذكروا الله﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis of إذا; اذكروا الله is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
﴿كما علمكم﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as the naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar, the implied form being: "remember Allah with a remembrance like His teaching of you" (اذكروا الله ذكرًا مثلَ تعليمه إياكم). The meaning is: remember Him with a remembrance that equals and matches the favour of what He taught you, such that the one remembering strives to make his remembrance resemble the favour in measure and adequacy, even if he is unable to attain that. ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya; ﴿علمكم﴾ is a past verb, a latent (mustatir) agent and a first mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿علمكم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; the interpreted maṣdar from the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾ and the verb ﴿علمكم﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿ما لم تكونوا تعلمون﴾: ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, the second object of علمكم; the clause ﴿لم تكونوا﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; the clause تعلمون is the khabar (predicate) of تكون. The clause ﴿فإذا أمنتم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:41-41.t:
﴿وآمنوا﴾: conjoined to what precedes.
﴿بما﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «آمنوا».
﴿أنزلت﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿مصدقا﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative noun.
﴿لما﴾: the lām is a preposition strengthening the transitivity, and «ما» is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the lām; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «مصدقًا».
﴿معكم﴾: an adverb of place attached to an omitted ṣila of the relative noun; the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «لا» is prohibitive.
﴿تكونوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the omission of the nūn; the wāw is its noun.
﴿أول﴾: the khabar (predicate) of «تكونوا».
﴿كافر﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿به﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «كافر».
﴿ولا تشتروا﴾: conjoined to «ولا تكونوا».
﴿بآياتي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «تشتروا».
﴿ثمنا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «تشتروا».
﴿قليلا﴾: a naʿt (adjective).
﴿وإياي﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «إياي» is a detached pronoun in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), mafʿūl bihi of an implied verb explained by the verb mentioned, its implied form being: "be mindful of" (اتقوا).
﴿فاتقون﴾: the fāʾ is a connective (ṣila); «اتقونِ» is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the omission of the nūn; the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya); and the omitted yāʾ of the speaker is the object; the clause «اتقونِ» is explicative (tafsīriyya), a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:42-42.t:
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «لا» is prohibitive.
﴿تلبسوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لا», the sign of its jussive being the omission of the nūn, because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿الحق﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿بالباطل﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تلبسوا»; the bāʾ is for accompaniment (mulābasa) or for instrumentality (istiʿāna).
﴿وتكتموا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «تكتموا» is an imperfect verb, jussive, conjoined to «تلبسوا», falling under the ruling of the prohibition. Or the wāw is of simultaneity (maʿiyya), and «تكتموا» is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an «أن» implied after it, it being preceded by a prohibition.
﴿الحق﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وأنتم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «أنتم» is a detached pronoun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿تعلمون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the verbal clause «تعلمون» is the khabar (predicate) of «أنتم». The nominal clause «وأنتم تعلمون» is circumstantial.

muyesser-irab:43-43.t:
﴿وأقيموا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «أقيموا» is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿الصلاة﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وآتوا الزكاة﴾: conjoined to «أقيموا الصلاة».
﴿واركعوا﴾: likewise conjoined.
﴿مع﴾: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اركعوا».
﴿الراكعين﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:44-44.t:
﴿أتأمرون﴾: the hamza is for the interrogation of disapproval (istifhām inkārī), and «تأمرون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿الناس﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿بالبر﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تأمرون».
﴿وتنسون﴾: conjoined to «تأمرون».
﴿أنفسكم﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وأنتم﴾: the wāw is the wāw of circumstance (ḥāl), and «أنتم» is a detached pronoun in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿تتلون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; the verbal clause «تتلون» is the khabar (predicate) of «أنتم», and the nominal clause «وأنتم» is circumstantial, from the fāʿil of «تنسون».
﴿الكتاب﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿أفلا﴾: the hamza is for the interrogation of disapproval, the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «لا» is prohibitive [Translator's note: so in the source, «لا ناهية»; since «تعقلون» is indicative, «لا» here is negative (nāfiya)].
﴿تعقلون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:45-45.t:
﴿واستعينوا﴾: conjoined to what precedes.
﴿بالصبر﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «استعينوا».
﴿والصلاة﴾: conjoined to «الصبر».
﴿وإنها﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun.
﴿لكبيرة﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and «كبيرة» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن».
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿على الخاشعين﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «كبيرة»; the exception is emptied (mufarragh), the meaning being: "and it is not light or easy except for the humble".

muyesser-irab:46-46.t:
﴿الذين﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of a genitive (majrūr), a naʿt (adjective) of «الخاشعين».
﴿يظنون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿أنهم﴾: «أن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun.
﴿ملاقو﴾: its khabar (predicate).
﴿ربهم﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «أن» and what falls within its scope stand in place of the two objects of «يظنون».
﴿وأنهم﴾: conjoined to «أنهم».
﴿إليه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «راجعون».
﴿راجعون﴾: the khabar of «أن».

muyesser-irab:119-119.t:
﴿إنا﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism).
﴿أرسلناك﴾: a verb, its fāʿil (agent), and mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿بالحق﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial): متلبسًا به ومصاحبًا له (invested with it and accompanied by it); the clause أرسلناك is its khabar (predicate).
﴿بشيرا﴾: also a ḥāl.
﴿ونذيرا﴾: conjoined to ﴿بشيرًا﴾.
﴿ولا تسأل﴾: the wāw is resumptive, لا is negative, and تسأل is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a pronoun necessarily latent (mustatir), its implied form being: أنت. The clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿عن أصحاب الجحيم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تسأل.

muyesser-irab:120-120.t:
﴿ولن﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and لن is a particle of negation, of the accusative, and of the future.
﴿ترضى﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by لن.
﴿عنك﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ترضى.
﴿اليهود﴾: fāʿil (agent).
﴿ولا النصارى﴾: conjoined to اليهود.
﴿حتى﴾: a particle of limit and of the genitive.
﴿تتبع﴾: an imperfect verb in the accusative by an أن necessarily implied after حتى; أن and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive, and the preposition with its genitive noun is attached to ترضى.
﴿ملتهم﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: أنت. The clause ﴿لن ترضى...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
