﴿قل﴾: an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being أنت; the clause ﴿قل...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن﴾: an abrogating (nāsikh) particle.
﴿هدى الله﴾: its noun (ism); the clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿هو﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿الهدى﴾: its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is the khabar of إن.
﴿ولئن﴾: the wāw is resumptive, the lām paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam), and إن is a jussive conditional particle.
﴿اتبعت﴾: a past verb indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is the fāʿil.
﴿أهواءهم﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the response to the oath.
﴿بعد﴾: an adverb.
﴿الذي﴾: a relative noun in the position of the genitive by annexation; the adverb is attached to اتبعت.
﴿جاءك من العلم﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; من العلم is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ما لك﴾: ما is negative, and لك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar.
﴿من الله﴾: من is a preposition and the Name of Majesty is a genitive noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ولي.
﴿من ولي﴾: من is a preposition, and ولي is genitive in form and nominative in position, because it is a delayed mubtadaʾ.
﴿ولا نصير﴾: conjoined to ولي; the clause ﴿لئن اتبعت...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:121-121.t:
﴿الذين﴾: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿آتيناهم الكتاب﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the two objects of آتينا; the clause آتيناهم has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿يتلونه﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of الذين.
﴿حق تلاوته﴾: standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).
﴿أولئك﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ.
﴿يؤمنون به﴾: the clause is the khabar of أولئك, and the clause أولئك يؤمنون به is a khabar after a khabar.
﴿ومن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and من is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ.
﴿يكفر﴾: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).
﴿به﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) يكفر.
﴿فأولئك﴾: the fāʾ is linking, and the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿هم﴾: a second mubtadaʾ.
﴿الخاسرون﴾: the khabar of هم, and the nominal clause is the khabar of أولئك; or هم is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:122-122.t:
﴿يا بني إسرائيل﴾: يا is a vocative particle, بني is a munādā (one addressed in the vocative) in a genitive construct, and إسرائيل is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), the sign of its genitive being the fatḥa in place of the kasra, because it is a diptote (mamnūʿ min al-ṣarf) on account of being a proper name and foreign.
﴿اذكروا﴾: an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿نعمتي﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿التي﴾: a relative noun, naʿt (adjective).
﴿أنعمت عليكم﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿وأني﴾: أن and what follows it are conjoined to نعمتي, i.e.: وتفضيلي إياكم على عالمي زمانكم (and My preferring you over the worlds of your time).
﴿فضلتكم﴾: a verb, its fāʿil, and object; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of أني.
﴿على العالمين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) فضلتكم.

muyesser-irab:123-123.t:
﴿واتقوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اتقوا is an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿يوما﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), on the omission of a muḍāf, i.e.: خافوا عذابه (fear its punishment).
﴿لا تجزي﴾: لا is negative, and تجزي is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿نفس﴾: fāʿil.
﴿عن نفس﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) تجزي.
﴿شيئا﴾: mafʿūl bihi, or standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), the implied form being: لا تجزي شيئا من الجزاء (it will not avail anything of availing). The clause ﴿لا تجزي...﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿يومًا﴾.
﴿ولا يقبل منها عدل﴾: conjoined to what preceded, and عدل is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿ولا تنفعها شفاعة﴾: also conjoined.
﴿ولا هم ينصرون﴾: also conjoined; هم is a mubtadaʾ (subject), the clause ينصرون is the khabar (predicate), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:124-124.t:
﴿وإذ﴾: the wāw: resumptive; and إذ: a noun of time in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being: اذكر (remember).
﴿ابتلى﴾: a past verb.
﴿إبراهيم﴾: a fronted mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ربه﴾: a delayed fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿ابتلى﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct).
﴿بكلمات﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ابتلى.
﴿فأتمهن﴾: conjoined to ابتلى. The clause ﴿وإذ ابتلى إبراهيم ربه...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿قال﴾: a past verb; its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being: هو; the clause is resumptive, or explicative (tafsīriyya) of the trial, and on both views it has no grammatical position.
﴿إني﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and the yāʾ is its noun (ism).
﴿جاعلك﴾: the khabar (predicate) of إن; the kāf is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, by way of annexing the active participle to its object; here it is annexed to its first object. The clause ﴿إني جاعلك للناس إماما﴾ is the object of the first ﴿قال﴾.
﴿للناس﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جاعلك, i.e.: for the sake of the people; or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿إمامًا﴾, because it was originally its adjective and was placed before it.
﴿إماما﴾: the second object of جاعلك.
﴿قال﴾: a past verb, and its fāʿil is: هو.
﴿ومن ذريتي﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition and its genitive noun are conjoined to the kāf; or: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to something omitted, the implied form being: واجعل من ذريتي إمامًا (and make from my offspring an imam).
﴿قال لا ينال عهدي الظالمين﴾: عهدي is the fāʿil, and الظالمين is mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:125-125.t:
﴿وإذ﴾: the wāw: a conjunction; and إذ: a noun of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative, conjoined to ﴿إذ﴾ in the saying of Allah the Exalted ﴿وإذ ابتلى﴾.
﴿جعلنا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct).
﴿البيت﴾: the first object of جعلنا.
﴿مثابة﴾: the second object of جعلنا.
﴿للناس﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of مثابة.
﴿وأمنا﴾: conjoined to مثابة. The clause ﴿وإذ جعلنا البيت...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿واتخذوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اتخذوا is an imperative verb indeclinable on the omission of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the object of an omitted saying conjoined to جعلنا.
﴿من مقام﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to اتخذوا.
﴿إبراهيم﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the fatḥa, because it is a diptote (mamnūʿ min al-ṣarf) on account of being a proper name and foreign.
﴿مصلى﴾: the object of اتخذوا; من is for the starting point (ibtidāʾ), as though it were said: take a place of prayer, starting from this place.
﴿وعهدنا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil.
﴿إلى إبراهيم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to عهدنا.
﴿وإسماعيل﴾: conjoined to إبراهيم.
﴿أن﴾: explicative (tafsīriyya) in the sense of أي (that is), because it occurs after a clause containing the meaning of saying but not its letters.
﴿طهرا﴾: an imperative verb indeclinable on the omission of the nūn; the clause is explicative, with no grammatical position. Or ﴿أن﴾ is maṣdarī, and the interpreted maṣdar is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ); the clause ﴿طهرا بيتي﴾ is then the ṣila of the maṣdarī ﴿أن﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿بيتي﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿للطائفين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿طهرا﴾.
﴿والعاكفين والركع السجود﴾: conjoined to الطائفين.

muyesser-irab:126-126.t:
﴿وإذ قال إبراهيم﴾: the wāw: a conjunction; and إذ: a noun of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the preceding ﴿إذ﴾; ﴿قال إبراهيم﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the verbal clause is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct).
﴿رب﴾: a munādā (one addressed in the vocative) from which the vocative particle has been omitted; it is annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person.
﴿اجعل﴾: an imperative verb, and its fāʿil is أنت.
﴿هذا﴾: a demonstrative, first mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿بلدا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿آمنا﴾: naʿt (adjective).
﴿وارزق أهله﴾: conjoined to اجعل, and أهله is mafʿūl bihi.
﴿من الثمرات﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ارزق.
﴿من﴾: a relative noun, badal (substitute) from أهله.
﴿آمن﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿منهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿بالله﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition and the Name of Majesty ﴿الله﴾ is a genitive noun, the sign of the genitive being the kasra; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to آمن.
﴿واليوم الآخر﴾: conjoined to the Name of Majesty.
﴿قال﴾: a past verb.
﴿ومن﴾: a relative noun conjoined to the first من.
﴿كفر﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of ﴿من﴾.
﴿فأمتعه﴾: the fāʾ is linking, because the relative noun contains the sense of condition; أمتعه is an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil, and mafʿūl bihi.
﴿قليلا﴾: standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is the adjective of the maṣdar. The clause ﴿قال ومن...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction.
﴿أضطره﴾: conjoined to أمتعه.
﴿إلى عذاب النار﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أضطره.
﴿وبئس﴾: the wāw is resumptive; بئس: a past verb for the expression of censure (inshāʾ al-dhamm), indeclinable on the fatḥa.
﴿المصير﴾: the fāʿil of بئس; the clause of verb and fāʿil is in the position of the nominative as the fronted khabar (predicate) of an omitted delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), which is the one specified for censure (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm), the implied form being: بئس المصير مصيره (wretched is the destination—his destination). The clause ﴿بئس المصير﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:127-127.t:
﴿وإذ﴾: the wāw: a conjunction; and إذ: a noun of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the preceding ﴿إذ﴾.
﴿يرفع إبراهيم﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the verbal clause is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct).
﴿القواعد﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿من البيت﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are in the place of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وإسماعيل﴾: conjoined to إبراهيم.
﴿ربنا﴾: a munādā (one addressed in the vocative) in a genitive construct, from which the vocative particle has been omitted; an omitted saying must be assumed, i.e.: يقولان: ربنا (the two of them saying: our Lord).
﴿تقبل﴾: a verb of supplication.
﴿منا﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) تقبل.
﴿إنك﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and the kāf is its noun (ism).
﴿أنت﴾: an attached pronoun [Translator's note: so in the source («ضمير متصل»); أنت is a detached (munfaṣil) pronoun] with no grammatical position, or a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿السميع العليم﴾: two khabars (predicates) of إن, or of أنت, the nominal clause [in the latter case] being the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:128-128.t:
﴿ربنا﴾: a munādā (one addressed in the vocative) in a genitive construct, from which the vocative particle has been omitted; an omitted saying must be assumed, i.e.: يقولان ربنا (the two of them saying: our Lord).
﴿واجعلنا﴾: conjoined to what preceded.
﴿مسلمين﴾: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿لك﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of مسلمين.
﴿ومن ذريتنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to something omitted indicated by what is mentioned, i.e.: واجعل من ذريتنا (and make from our offspring).
﴿أمة﴾: first mafʿūl bihi of the omitted verb, and من ذريتنا is the second object.
﴿مسلمة﴾: naʿt.
﴿لك﴾: a second naʿt of أمة.
﴿وأرنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أر is an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the weak letter; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being: أنت; and نا is an attached pronoun in the position of the accusative as first mafʿūl bihi.
﴿مناسكنا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وتب علينا﴾: also conjoined.
﴿إنك﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and the kāf is its noun (ism).
﴿أنت﴾: a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿التواب﴾: first khabar (predicate).
﴿الرحيم﴾: second khabar; the nominal clause is the khabar of إن. Or the pronoun is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position, and التواب الرحيم are the two khabars of إن.

muyesser-irab:129-129.t:
﴿ربنا﴾: a munādā (one addressed in the vocative) in a genitive construct, from which the vocative particle has been omitted; an omitted saying must be assumed, i.e.: يقولان: ربنا (the two of them saying: our Lord).
﴿وابعث﴾: conjoined to what preceded.
﴿فيهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ابعث.
﴿رسولا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿منهم﴾: naʿt (adjective) of ﴿رسولًا﴾.
﴿يتلو﴾: the clause is a second naʿt, or a ḥāl (circumstantial), because رسولًا has been qualified by His saying منهم.
﴿عليهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يتلو.
﴿آياتك﴾: the object of يتلو.
﴿ويعلمهم﴾: conjoined to يتلو, and the hāʾ is first mafʿūl bihi.
﴿الكتاب﴾: second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿والحكمة﴾: conjoined to الكتاب.
﴿ويزكيهم﴾: conjoined to يعلمهم.
﴿إنك﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and the kāf is its noun (ism).
﴿أنت﴾: a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿العزيز﴾: first khabar (predicate).
﴿الحكيم﴾: second khabar; the nominal clause is the khabar of إن. Or the pronoun is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position, and العزيز الحكيم are the two khabars of إن.

muyesser-irab:240-240.t:
﴿والذين يتوفون منكم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; الذين is mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause يتوفون is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); منكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ويذرون أزواجا﴾: conjoined to يتوفون; أزواجًا is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وصية لأزواجهم﴾: وصية is the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e. "they make a bequest" (يوصون وصية), and this verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of الذين; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of وصية.
﴿متاعا﴾: stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq, because it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar); or it is accusative as a badal (substitute) of وصية, or as a ḥāl. And it has been said: it is made accusative by وصية.
﴿إلى الحول﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of ﴿متاعًا﴾, i.e. "extending to the [end of the] year."
﴿غير إخراج﴾: غير is a ḥāl, i.e. "in the state of their not being turned out of their dwelling." And it has been said: it is a naʿt of His saying متاعًا, i.e. "not a turning out." And it has been said: it is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ). The clause ﴿والذين يتوفون...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فإن خرجن﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إن is conditional; خرجن is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).
﴿فلا جناح عليكم﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis.
﴿في ما فعلن في أنفسهن من معروف﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl; the clause فعلن is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; في أنفسهن is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to His saying فعلن; من معروف is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl. The clause ﴿فإن خرجن...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿والله عزيز حكيم﴾: الله is mubtadaʾ, and عزيز حكيم are its two khabars; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:241-241.t:
﴿وللمطلقات متاع بالمعروف﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); متاع is a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); بالمعروف is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of متاع. The clause ﴿وللمطلقات متاع بالمعروف﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿حقا على المتقين﴾: حقا is the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, emphasizing the content of the clause, the implied form being "that is due, truly due" (حق ذلك حقا); على المتقين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿حقًّا﴾.

muyesser-irab:242-242.t:
﴿كذلك يبين الله لكم آياته﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as the naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar placed before its governing word, the implied form being: "with an explaining like that does Allah explain His signs to you" (تبيينًا مثل ذلك يبين الله لكم آياته). ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address. ﴿يبين﴾ is an imperfect verb; the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil (agent) of يبين; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يبين﴾; ﴿آياته﴾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿لعلكم تعقلون﴾: ﴿لعلكم﴾: لعل is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); the kāf is the noun (ism) of لعل, and the mīm is the sign of the plural; the clause ﴿تعقلون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of لعل, and the clause of hope is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:243-243.t:
﴿ألم تر إلى الذين خرجوا من ديارهم﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of affirmation (al-istifhām al-taqrīrī); لم is a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and jussive; تر is an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by لم; the agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تر﴾; the clause ﴿خرجوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿ألم تر﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. من ديارهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to خرجوا.
﴿وهم ألوف﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); هم is mubtadaʾ (subject), ألوف is khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿حذر الموت﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).
﴿فقال لهم الله موتوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; قال is a past verb; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to قال; the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿موتوا﴾ is in the position of accusative as the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿ثم أحياهم﴾: ثم is a conjunction for sequence with delay; أحياهم is conjoined to something omitted.
﴿إن الله لذو فضل على الناس﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ذو فضل is the khabar of إن; على الناس is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of فضل.
﴿ولكن أكثر الناس لا يشكرون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; لكن is a particle of rectification governing the accusative; أكثر الناس is its noun, and the clause لا يشكرون is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:244-244.t:
﴿وقاتلوا في سبيل الله﴾: the wāw conjoins [this] to something implied, i.e. "do not flee, and fight your enemies"; في سبيل الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) قاتلوا.
﴿واعلموا أن الله سميع عليم﴾: also conjoined; أن and what falls within its scope stand in place of the two objects of اعلموا; سميع عليم are two khabars (predicates) of أن.

muyesser-irab:245-245.t:
﴿من ذا الذي﴾: من is interrogative and is mubtadaʾ (subject); ذا is a demonstrative, the khabar (predicate); الذي is a badal (substitute) of the demonstrative, or a naʿt (adjective) of it.
﴿يقرض الله﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. The clause ﴿من ذا الذي...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿قرضا﴾: stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar), the maṣdar being إقراضا; or [it is] a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿حسنًا﴾: an accusative naʿt.
﴿فيضاعفه له أضعافا كثيرة﴾: the fāʾ is causal (lil-sababiyya); يضاعفه is an imperfect verb made accusative by an implied أن after the causal fāʾ occurring in answer to the question; the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to a maṣdar understood from the preceding speech, i.e. "Is there a lending from you to Allah, and so a multiplying from Him for you?" The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) يضاعفه. ﴿أضعافًا﴾ is an explanatory ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ; and it has been said: a second mafʿūl bihi, on the view that ﴿يضاعف﴾ implies the meaning of "makes [it] become" (يصير), i.e. He makes it, by multiplication, manifold; and it has been said: it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq. كثيرة is a naʿt of أضعاف.
﴿والله يقبض ويبسط﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ; the clause يقبض is the khabar, and يبسط is conjoined to يقبض. The clause ﴿والله يقبض ويبسط﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وإليه ترجعون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إليه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ترجعون; the clause is conjoined to the one before it.

muyesser-irab:246-246.t:
﴿ألم تر إلى الملأ من بني إسرائيل﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of affirmation (al-istifhām al-taqrīrī); لم is a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and jussive; ﴿تر﴾ is an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by لم; the agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); إلى الملأ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تر﴾; ﴿من بني﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of الملأ; ﴿إسرائيل﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause ﴿ألم تر...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿من بعد موسى﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "after his death," likewise.
﴿إذ قالوا﴾: an adverb for past time, attached to something implied that the context calls for, i.e. "Have you not seen the story of the chiefs, or their account, when they said…"; the clause ﴿قالوا﴾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).
﴿لنبي﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to قالوا.
﴿لهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective).
﴿ابعث لنا ملكا﴾: the clause, composed of the imperative verb and the fāʿil (agent), is in the position of accusative as the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); لنا is attached to ابعث; ملكًا is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿نقاتل في سبيل الله﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab); في سبيل الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نقاتل; the clause نقاتل is conjoined to ابعث. [Translator's note: so in the source, although it has just parsed نقاتل as the jussive answer to the request rather than as a conjoined clause.]
﴿قال﴾: a past verb; its agent is latent, its implied form being "he" (هو); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿هل عسيتم﴾: هل is an interrogative particle for affirmation (taqrīr); عسيتم is a past verb of the verbs of hope, and the tāʾ is its noun (ism).
﴿إن كتب عليكم القتال﴾: إن is conditional; كتب is a past verb in the passive (whose agent is not named), in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); عليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿كتب﴾; القتال is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being "then you will not hasten to fight" (فلا تبادرون إلى القتال). The protasis and its apodosis are a parenthetical clause with no grammatical position, coming parenthetically between the noun of عسى and its khabar (predicate), which is His saying ﴿ألا تقاتلوا﴾.
﴿ألا تقاتلوا﴾: أن is a maṣdar-forming particle governing the accusative; لا is negative; تقاتلوا is an imperfect verb made accusative by أن; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿ألا تقاتلوا﴾ is the khabar of عسى, accusative. The clause هل عسيتم is the object of the speech.
﴿قالوا﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; قالوا is a verb and its fāʿil.
﴿وما لنا ألا نقاتل في سبيل الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction linking the speech to what precedes it; ما is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); لنا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن لا نقاتل﴾ is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), the implied form being: "and what is with us in abandoning fighting?" (وما لنا في ترك القتال؟).
﴿وقد أخرجنا من ديارنا﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq); أخرجنا is a past verb in the passive, and the pronoun is the nāʾib fāʿil; من ديارنا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أخرجنا.
﴿وأبنائنا﴾: conjoined to ﴿ديارنا﴾, on the view that the verb of expelling implies the meaning of separation, so that the conjunction is valid; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
﴿فلما كتب عليهم القتال﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; ﴿لما﴾ is temporal (ḥīniyya) or linking; كتب is a past verb in the passive; عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to كتب; القتال is the nāʾib fāʿil.
﴿تولوا إلا قليلا منهم﴾: the clause تولوا has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of ﴿لما﴾, which is a non-jussive conditional; تولوا is a verb and its fāʿil; إلا is a particle of exception; قليلًا is a connected excepted (mustathnā muttaṣil), because they are of the same kind as the people; منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of ﴿قليلًا﴾. The clause ﴿فلما كتب عليهم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿والله عليم بالظالمين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; الله is mubtadaʾ, and عليم is khabar; بالظالمين, the preposition and its genitive noun, is attached to عليم. The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:47-47.t:
﴿يا﴾: a vocative particle.
﴿بني﴾: the one addressed (munādā), annexed (muḍāf), the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ in place of the fatḥa, because it is treated like the sound masculine plural.
﴿إسرائيل﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), the sign of its genitive being the fatḥa in place of the kasra, because it is a diptote, for being a proper name and foreign.
﴿اذكروا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿نعمتي﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿التي﴾: a relative noun in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), a naʿt (adjective) of «نعمتي».
﴿أنعمت﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿عليكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أنعمت».
﴿وأني﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «أن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the yāʾ of the speaker is the noun of «أن».
﴿فضلتكم﴾: a past verb; the tāʾ is the fāʿil, the kāf is the object, and the mīm is the sign of the plural; the clause «فضلتكم» is in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), the khabar (predicate) of «أني».
﴿على العالمين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «فضلتكم». The interpreted maṣdar from «أني فضلتكم» is conjoined to «نعمتي», i.e.: "remember My favour and My preferring [you]" (اذكروا نعمتي وتفضيلي).

muyesser-irab:48-48.t:
﴿واتقوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «اتقوا» is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿يوما﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. "the punishment of a day" or "the terror of a day"; or accusative (manṣūb) as an adverb (ẓarf), the mafʿūl bihi being omitted, its implied form being: "guard against the punishment on a day" (اتقوا العذاب يومًا).
﴿لا﴾: negative.
﴿تجزي﴾: an imperfect verb.
﴿نفس﴾: the fāʿil of «تجزي»; the verbal clause is in the position of an accusative, a naʿt (adjective) of «يومًا».
﴿عن نفس﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تجزي».
﴿شيئا﴾: mafʿūl bihi, or standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), the implied form being: "it will not avail anything of availing" (لا تجزي شيئا من الجزاء). The clause «لا تجزي...» is a naʿt of «يومًا».
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «لا» is negative.
﴿يقبل﴾: an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive).
﴿منها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يقبل».
﴿شفاعة﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿ولا﴾: conjoined to what precedes.
﴿يؤخذ﴾: an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive).
﴿منها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يؤخذ».
﴿عدل﴾: nāʾib fāʿil.
﴿ولا﴾: likewise conjoined.
﴿هم﴾: a detached pronoun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿ينصرون﴾: an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); the wāw is an attached pronoun in the position of a nominative, nāʾib fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of «هم».

muyesser-irab:49-49.t:
﴿وإذ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «إذ» is a noun of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), conjoined to «نعمتي» in the words of the Exalted «اذكروا نعمتي».
﴿نجيناكم﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn; «نا» is an attached pronoun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), fāʿil (agent); the kāf is an attached pronoun in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «نجيناكم» is in the position of a genitive (majrūr), muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿من آل فرعون﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نجيناكم»; «فرعون» is muḍāf ilayhi, the sign of its genitive being the fatḥa in place of the kasra, because it is a diptote, for being a proper name and foreign.
﴿يسومونكم﴾: the clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); it may also be resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿سوء العذاب﴾: a second mafʿūl bihi, because «سام» is transitive to two [objects]; or accusative as a maṣdar, being a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar, i.e.: "they inflicted on you an inflicting of the worst of punishment" (يسومونكم سومًا سوء العذاب).
﴿يذبحون﴾: the clause is in the position of an accusative as a badal (substitute) from the clause «يسومونكم», or explicative (tafsīriyya), a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿أبناءكم﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ويستحيون﴾: conjoined to «يذبحون».
﴿نساءكم﴾: the object of «يستحيون».
﴿وفي ذلكم﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are a fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿بلاء﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿من ربكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt of «بلاء».
﴿عظيم﴾: a second naʿt of «بلاء»; the clause «في ذلكم بلاء...» is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:50-50.t:
﴿وإذ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «إذ» is a noun of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), conjoined to «نعمتي» in the words of the Exalted «اذكروا نعمتي».
﴿فرقنا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of a genitive (majrūr), muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿بكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «فرقنا», or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "We split it, it being in contact with you" (فصلناه ملتبسًا بكم).
﴿البحر﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فأنجيناكم وأغرقنا﴾: likewise conjoined.
﴿آل فرعون﴾: mafʿūl bihi; «فرعون» is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿وأنتم﴾: a detached pronoun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿تنظرون﴾: the clause is in the position of a nominative, the khabar (predicate) of «أنتم»; the nominal clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl from the kāf in «فأنجيناكم».

muyesser-irab:51-51.t:
﴿وإذ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «إذ» is a noun of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), conjoined to «نعمتي» in the words of the Exalted «اذكروا نعمتي».
﴿واعدنا﴾: the clause is in the position of a genitive (majrūr), muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿موسى﴾: the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿أربعين﴾: the second mafʿūl bihi; it may not be made accusative as an adverb (ẓarf), because that would corrupt the meaning, since His promise was not [made] during forty nights; the sign of its accusative is the yāʾ, because it is treated like the sound masculine plural.
﴿ليلة﴾: an explicit tamyīz (specification); what governs this type is the number noun before it.
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction for sequence with delay (tarākhī).
﴿اتخذتم﴾: conjoined to «واعدنا».
﴿العجل﴾: the first mafʿūl bihi; the second object is omitted because it is understood from the context, i.e. "as a god" (إلهًا).
﴿من بعده﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وأنتم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «أنتم» is a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿ظالمون﴾: its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:52-52.t:
﴿ثم عفونا﴾: conjoined to «اتخذتم».
﴿عنكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عفونا».
﴿من بعد ذلك﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the reference is to the maṣdar understood from «اتخذ», i.e.: "after that taking" (من بعد ذلك الاتخاذ).
﴿لعلكم﴾: «لعل» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the kāf is its noun.
﴿تشكرون﴾: the clause is in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), the khabar (predicate) of «لعل»; the clause of hope is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

muyesser-irab:53-53.t:
﴿وإذ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «إذ» is a noun of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), conjoined to «نعمتي» in the words of the Exalted «اذكروا نعمتي».
﴿آتينا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of a genitive (majrūr), muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿موسى﴾: the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿الكتاب﴾: the second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿والفرقان﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «الفرقان» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «الكتاب».
﴿لعلكم﴾: «لعل» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the kāf is its noun.
﴿تهتدون﴾: the clause is the khabar (predicate) of «لعل»; the clause of hope is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

muyesser-irab:194-194.t:
﴿الشهر الحرام﴾: «الشهر» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «الحرام» is an adjective (ṣifa).
﴿بالشهر﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate), on the assumption that a muḍāf has been omitted, i.e.: "the violation of the sanctity of the sacred month."
﴿الحرام﴾: an adjective; the clause «الشهر الحرام...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿والحرمات قصاص﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «الحرمات» is a mubtadaʾ, and «قصاص» is the khabar.
﴿فمن﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «من» is conditional, mubtadaʾ.
﴿اعتدى﴾: a past verb in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).
﴿عليكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «اعتدى».
﴿فاعتدوا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «اعتدوا» is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis.
﴿عليه﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to His word «فاعتدوا».
﴿بمثل﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «اعتدوا», or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ما﴾: maṣdariyya.
﴿اعتدى﴾: a past verb; the interpreted maṣdar formed from «ما» and «اعتدى» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), i.e.: "with the like of his aggression" (بمثل اعتدائه).
﴿عليكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «اعتدى».
﴿واتقوا الله﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «اتقوا» is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, the wāw is the fāʿil, and the Name of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿واعلموا﴾: conjoined to «اتقوا».
﴿أن الله﴾: «أن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism).
﴿مع المتقين﴾: «مع» is an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to an omitted khabar, and «المتقين» is muḍāf ilayhi; «أن» and what falls within its scope take the place of the two objects of «اعلموا».

muyesser-irab:195-195.t:
﴿وأنفقوا﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «أنفقوا» is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿في سبيل الله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أنفقوا».
﴿ولا تلقوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «لا» is prohibitive (nāhiya), and «تلقوا» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لا»; the wāw is the fāʿil.
﴿بأيديكم﴾: the bāʾ is connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant), because «ألقى» is a verb that is transitive by itself. It has been said: «تلقوا» is made to contain the sense of a verb that is transitive with the bāʾ, i.e.: "do not lead [yourselves] by your own hands" (لا تفضوا بأيديكم). And it has been said: the second object is omitted, its implied form being: "do not cast yourselves, by your own hands" (ولا تلقوا أنفسكم بأيديكم).
﴿إلى التهلكة﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «تلقوا».
﴿وأحسنوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «أحسنوا» is an imperative verb and its fāʿil.
﴿إن الله﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism).
﴿يحب المحسنين﴾: an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil, and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «يحب المحسنين» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», and the clause of «إن» and what falls within its scope is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:196-196.t:
﴿وأتموا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «أتموا» is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿الحج﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿والعمرة﴾: conjoined to «الحج».
﴿لله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "purely for His Face"; or attached to «أتموا», in which case the lām is the lām of the mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).
﴿فإن﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «إن» is conditional.
﴿أحصرتم﴾: a past verb, passive (built for that whose agent is not named), in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).
﴿فما﴾: the fāʾ is linking (rābiṭa), and «ما» is a relative noun in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e.: "then upon you is what is easy" (فعليكم ما استيسر); the clause is [in the position of the] jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).
﴿استيسر﴾: a past verb, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of «ما».
﴿من الهدي﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e.: "being of the sacrificial animals" (كائنًا من الهدي).
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «لا» is prohibitive (nāhiya).
﴿تحلقوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by «لا», and the wāw is the fāʿil.
﴿رءوسكم﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿حتى يبلغ﴾: «حتى» is a particle of limit (ghāya) and a preposition, and «يبلغ» is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by a concealed «أن»; «أن» and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) in the genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «تحلقوا».
﴿الهدي﴾: fāʿil.
﴿محله﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فمن﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and «من» is a jussive conditional noun (ism sharṭ jāzim) in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ.
﴿كان﴾: a deficient (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis; its noun is a latent pronoun referring back to «من».
﴿منكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿مريضا﴾: the khabar of «كان».
﴿أو﴾: a conjunction.
﴿به﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar.
﴿أذى﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ, the sign of its nominative being a ḍamma implied on the alif that was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters.
﴿من رأسه﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of «أذى».
﴿ففدية﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and «فدية» is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e.: "then upon him is a ransom" (فعليه فدية); the clause is the apodosis.
﴿من صيام﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective of «فدية».
﴿أو﴾: a conjunction.
﴿صدقة﴾: conjoined to «صيام».
﴿أو﴾: a conjunction.
﴿نسك﴾: conjoined to «صيام»; the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of «من». The clause «فمن كان منكم...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فإذا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and «إذا» is an adverb (ẓarf) for future time.
﴿أمنتم﴾: the verbal clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).
﴿فمن تمتع بالعمرة إلى الحج﴾: the fāʾ is [that of] the response to «إذا»; «من» is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ; «تمتع» is a past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis; «بالعمرة» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «تمتع»; and «إلى الحج» is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted [verb], i.e.: "and his enjoyment and benefiting from what is [otherwise] forbidden continued until the Hajj." The clause «فإذا أمنتم...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فما﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and «ما» is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ, whose khabar is omitted, i.e.: "then upon him is what..." (فعليه ما).
﴿استيسر﴾: a past verb; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun; the clause «فما استيسر» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis.
﴿من الهدي﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿فمن﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and «من» is conditional, mubtadaʾ.
﴿لم يجد﴾: «لم» is a particle of negation, conversion [of the imperfect to past sense] and jussive; «يجد» is an imperfect verb, jussive by «لم», and the jussive verb is the protasis; its fāʿil is a latent pronoun referring back to «من», and its object is omitted because the meaning is evident, the implied form being: "whoever does not find what is easy of the sacrificial animals."
﴿فصيام﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and «صيام» is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e.: "then upon him is fasting" (فعليه صيام); the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis.
﴿ثلاثة أيام﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿في الحج﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿وسبعة﴾: conjoined to «ثلاثة».
﴿إذا رجعتم﴾: «إذا» is an adverb for future time, and the clause «رجعتم» is in the position of the genitive by annexation. The clause «فمن لم يجد...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿تلك﴾: the demonstrative, mubtadaʾ.
﴿عشرة﴾: khabar.
﴿كاملة﴾: an adjective.
﴿ذلك﴾: the demonstrative, mubtadaʾ.
﴿لمن﴾: the lām is a preposition, and «من» is a relative noun in the position of the genitive by the lām; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar.
﴿لم يكن﴾: «لم» is a particle of negation, conversion and jussive, and «يكن» is a deficient imperfect verb, jussive by «لم».
﴿أهله﴾: its noun (ism); the clause «لم يكن» has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun.
﴿حاضري﴾: the khabar of «يكن».
﴿المسجد﴾: muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿الحرام﴾: an adjective.
﴿واتقوا الله﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «اتقوا» is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, the wāw is the fāʿil, and the Name of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi. The clause «واتقوا الله» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿واعلموا﴾: conjoined to «اتقوا».
﴿أن الله﴾: «أن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the Name of Majesty is its noun.
﴿شديد العقاب﴾: the khabar of «أن»; «أن» and what falls within its scope take the place of the two objects of «اعلموا».

muyesser-irab:197-197.t:
﴿الحج أشهر معلومات﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and «معلومات» is an adjective (ṣifa) of «أشهر»; the clause «الحج أشهر معلومات» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فمن﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «من» is a jussive conditional noun (ism sharṭ jāzim), mubtadaʾ.
﴿فرض﴾: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); its fāʿil (agent) is "he" (هو).
﴿فيهن﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «فرض».
﴿الحج﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فلا رفث﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «لا» is the lā of generic negation, and «رفث» is its noun.
﴿ولا فسوق﴾: conjoined to His words «فلا رفث».
﴿ولا جدال في الحج﴾: also conjoined; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar of «لا»; the nominal clause is in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis, and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of «من».
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and «ما» is a jussive conditional noun in the position of the accusative as the fronted mafʿūl bihi of «تفعلوا».
﴿تفعلوا﴾: the protasis, jussive, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn.
﴿من خير﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿يعلمه الله﴾: the apodosis; the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil. The clause «وما تفعلوا...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وتزودوا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and «تزودوا» is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil. The clause «وتزودوا» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فإن﴾: the fāʾ is causal (taʿlīliyya), and «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh).
﴿خير الزاد﴾: the noun (ism) of «إن» and muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿التقوى﴾: its khabar; the clause has no grammatical position.
﴿واتقون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «اتقون» is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya), and the omitted yāʾ of the speaker, indicated by the kasra, is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿يا أولي الألباب﴾: «يا» is a vocative particle, and «أولي الألباب» is the one addressed (munādā), annexed (muḍāf), the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ, because it is treated like the sound masculine plural; «الألباب» is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined to the clause «تزودوا».

muyesser-irab:198-198.t:
﴿ليس عليكم جناح﴾: «ليس» is a deficient (nāqiṣ) past verb; «عليكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted fronted khabar (predicate); and «جناح» is the postponed noun (ism) of «ليس».
﴿أن﴾: a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle.
﴿تبتغوا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by «أن», the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). «أن» and what falls within its scope are interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) in the accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e.: "in that you seek" (في أن تبتغوا), and the preposition and its genitive noun are an adjective (ṣifa) of «جناح».
﴿فضلا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿من ربكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «تبتغوا», or to an omitted adjective of «فضلًا».
﴿فإذا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and «إذا» is an adverb (ẓarf) for future time, attached to the response.
﴿أفضتم﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).
﴿من عرفات﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «أفضتم».
﴿فاذكروا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «اذكروا» is an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, because it comes as the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
﴿الله﴾: the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi.
﴿عند المشعر﴾: the adverb is attached to «اذكروا», or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "being at the Sacred Monument" (كائنين عند المشعر الحرام).
﴿الحرام﴾: an adjective of «المشعر». The clause «فإذا أفضتم...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿واذكروه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and He repeated it for emphasis. «اذكروه» is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿كما هداكم﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being: "remember Him with a goodly remembrance like His guiding you with a goodly guidance"; «ما» is maṣdariyya, and «هداكم» is a past verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; the clause «هداكم» is the ṣila of the maṣdariyya «ما», with no grammatical position, and the interpreted maṣdar formed from the maṣdariyya «ما» and the verb «هدى» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وإن﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «إن» is the lightened [form], inoperative (mukhaffafa muhmala).
﴿كنتم﴾: the deficient «كان», and the tāʾ is its noun.
﴿من قبله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿لمن الضالين﴾: the lām is the distinguishing lām (al-fāriqa), and «من الضالين» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of «كنتم».

muyesser-irab:199-199.t:
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction for sequence with an interval.
﴿أفيضوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿من حيث﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أفيضوا»; «حيث» is an adverb of place (ẓarf makān), indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the genitive.
﴿أفاض الناس﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).
﴿واستغفروا الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «استغفروا الله» is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿إن الله غفور رحيم﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism), and «غفور رحيم» are its two khabars (predicates); the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:54-54.t:
﴿وإذ قال موسى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «إذ» is a noun of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), conjoined to «نعمتي» in the words of the Exalted «اذكروا نعمتي»; «قال موسى» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the verbal clause is in the position of a genitive (majrūr), muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿لقومه﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قال».
﴿يا قوم﴾: «يا» is a vocative particle, and «قوم» is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the speaker.
﴿إنكم﴾: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the kāf is its noun.
﴿ظلمتم﴾: the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of «إن».
﴿أنفسكم﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿باتخاذكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «ظلمتم»; the bāʾ is causal, i.e. "because of your taking".
﴿العجل﴾: mafʿūl bihi of the maṣdar (verbal noun) «اتخاذ».
﴿فتوبوا﴾: the fāʾ is causal (taʿlīliyya), because the wrongdoing is the cause of the repentance; «توبوا» is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the omission of the nūn.
﴿إلى بارئكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «توبوا».
﴿فاقتلوا﴾: the fāʾ is for conjunction and immediate sequence (taʿqīb).
﴿أنفسكم﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ذلكم﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿خير﴾: khabar.
﴿لكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «خير», because it is an elative noun (ism tafḍīl) formed irregularly.
﴿عند﴾: an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿بارئكم﴾: muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿فتاب﴾: the fāʾ conjoins to an omitted [clause], the implied form being: "so you did what He commanded you, and He turned [to you]" (ففعلتم ما أمركم فتاب).
﴿عليكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «تاب».
﴿إنه﴾: an abrogating particle, and the hāʾ is its noun.
﴿هو﴾: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position.
﴿التواب﴾: the first khabar of «إن».
﴿الرحيم﴾: the second khabar of «إن»; or «هو» is a mubtadaʾ whose two khabars are «التواب» and «الرحيم», and the nominal clause is the khabar of «إن».

muyesser-irab:55-55.t:
﴿وإذ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «إذ» is a noun of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), conjoined to «نعمتي» in the words of the Exalted «اذكروا نعمتي».
﴿قلتم﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the verbal clause is in the position of a genitive (majrūr), muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿يا﴾: a vocative particle.
﴿موسى﴾: the one addressed (munādā), a single proper noun.
﴿لن﴾: a particle of negation, of the accusative, and of the future.
﴿نؤمن﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by «لن»; its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "we" (نحن); the clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿لك﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نؤمن».
﴿حتى﴾: a particle of limit (ghāya) and of the genitive.
﴿نرى﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by an «أن» necessarily implied after «حتى»; the implied «أن» and the verb are interpreted as a genitive maṣdar (verbal noun), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «نؤمن».
﴿الله﴾: the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿جهرة﴾: standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a kind of the maṣdar «الرؤية» ("seeing"); or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil, i.e. "we see Him, beholding Him", or from the object, i.e. "we see Him, beheld".
﴿فأخذتكم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «أخذتكم» is a past verb, the tāʾ is the quiescent tāʾ of the feminine, and the kāf is an attached pronoun in the position of an accusative, a fronted mafʿūl bihi.
﴿الصاعقة﴾: fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to «قلتم».
﴿وأنتم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «أنتم» is a detached pronoun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿تنظرون﴾: an imperfect verb; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause «تنظرون» is the khabar (predicate) of «أنتم», and the clause «أنتم تنظرون» is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:56-56.t:
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction for sequence and delay (tarākhī).
﴿بعثناكم﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿من بعد﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «بعثناكم».
﴿موتكم﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿لعلكم﴾: «لعل» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the kāf is its noun.
﴿تشكرون﴾: the clause is the khabar (predicate) of «لعل». The clause «بعثناكم» is conjoined to the clause «فأخذتكم».

muyesser-irab:57-57.t:
﴿وظللنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «ظللنا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿عليكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ظللنا».
﴿الغمام﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وأنزلنا﴾: conjoined to «وظللنا».
﴿عليكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «أنزلنا».
﴿المن﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿والسلوى﴾: conjoined to «المن».
﴿كلوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause «كلوا» is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl), i.e.: "and We said: eat" (وقلنا: كلوا).
﴿من طيبات﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «كلوا».
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by annexation.
﴿رزقناكم﴾: a verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «ما» is negative.
﴿ظلمونا﴾: a verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined to an omitted [clause] required by the context of speech, the implied form being: "so they wronged themselves by their ingratitude for that ample favour" (فظلموا أنفسهم بكفران تلك النعمة السابغة).
﴿ولكن﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «لكن» is a particle of rectification (istidrāk), inoperative because its nūn is lightened.
﴿كانوا﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb [of kāna and its sisters], and the wāw is its noun.
﴿أنفسهم﴾: a fronted mafʿūl bihi of «يظلمون».
﴿يظلمون﴾: an imperfect verb; the wāw is the fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of «كانوا»; the clause of «لكن» and what falls within its scope is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:130-130.t:
﴿ومن يرغب﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and من is an interrogative noun whose meaning is negation and disapproval, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause يرغب is its khabar (predicate).
﴿عن ملة﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) يرغب.
﴿إبراهيم﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct), the sign of its genitive being the fatḥa, because it is a diptote (mamnūʿ min al-ṣarf) on account of being a proper name and foreign.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿من﴾: a relative noun in the position of the nominative as a badal (substitute) from the pronoun in يرغب, because the speech is non-affirmative; or accusative as the excepted.
﴿سفه نفسه﴾: سفه is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being هو; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; and نفسه: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause ﴿ومَن يرغب...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿ولقد﴾: the wāw is resumptive, the lām is the response to an omitted oath, and قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq).
﴿اصطفيناه﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil, and mafʿūl bihi.
﴿في الدنيا﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to اصطفيناه. The clause ﴿ولقد اصطفيناه...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وإنه﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and the hāʾ is its noun (ism).
﴿في الآخرة﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿لمن الصالحين﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:131-131.t:
﴿إذ﴾: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قال أسلمت﴾, i.e.: he said "I have submitted" at the time of Allah's saying to him "Submit"; or attached to ﴿اصطفيناه﴾ on the assumption of a conjunction, i.e.: We chose him when his Lord said to him "Submit", and he said "I have submitted".
﴿قال﴾: the verbal clause is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it.
﴿له﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to قال.
﴿ربه﴾: the fāʿil (agent) of قال, and the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by annexation.
﴿أسلم﴾: an imperative verb; its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being: أنت; the verbal clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿قال﴾: a past verb; its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being: هو.
﴿أسلمت﴾: the verbal clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying.
﴿لرب﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أسلمت.
﴿العالمين﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct), the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ, because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural.

muyesser-irab:132-132.t:
﴿ووصى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and وصى is a past verb.
﴿بها﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) وصى.
﴿إبراهيم﴾: the fāʿil (agent) of وصى.
﴿بنيه﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ, because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural; the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by annexation.
﴿ويعقوب﴾: conjoined to إبراهيم, included in its ruling.
﴿يا بني﴾: a munādā (one addressed in the vocative) in a genitive construct, on the implication of a saying, i.e.: قائلين (saying), so the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿إن الله﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism).
﴿اصطفى﴾: the verbal clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of إن; the fāʿil of اصطفى is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: هو.
﴿لكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to اصطفى.
﴿الدين﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فلا تموتن﴾: the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa ("disclosing") fāʾ, i.e.: since you know this; لا is prohibitive; تموتن is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا, the sign of its jussive being the omission of the nūn; the doubled nūn is for emphasis, and the wāw of the plural, dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the fāʿil.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿وأنتم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and أنتم is a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿مسلمون﴾: khabar; the nominal clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:133-133.t:
﴿أم﴾: connective (muttaṣila), conjoining to something omitted and implied, as though it were said: أتَدَّعون على الأنبياء أنهم يهود أم كنتم شهداء وحضورًا؟ (do you claim of the prophets that they were Jews, or were you witnesses and present?); or disconnective (munqaṭiʿa) in the sense of بل (nay), i.e.: بل كنتم ...؟ (nay, were you…?), i.e.: were your forefathers…, or He places them in the position of their forefathers, since their forefathers had transmitted that to them; or in the sense of بل plus the interrogative hamza indicating disapproval, the implied form being: بل أكنتم شهداء؟ (nay, were you witnesses?). ﴿كنتم﴾: كان is a past, defective, abrogating (nāsikh) verb, and the tāʾ is its noun (ism).
﴿شهداء﴾: its khabar (predicate).
﴿إذ﴾: an adverb of past time attached to (mutaʿalliq) شهداء.
﴿حضر﴾: a past verb; the clause is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it.
﴿يعقوب﴾: a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿الموت﴾: a delayed fāʿil (agent).
﴿إذ﴾: an adverb, a badal (substitute) from the first إذ.
﴿قال﴾: a past verb and a latent (mustatir) fāʿil; the verbal clause is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it.
﴿لبنيه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to قال.
﴿ما تعبدون﴾: ما is an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as the fronted mafʿūl bihi of تعبدون; تعبدون is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿من بعدي﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿قالوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil.
﴿نعبد إلهك﴾: the clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying.
﴿وإله آبائك﴾: conjoined to إلهك.
﴿إبراهيم﴾: badal from آبائك.
﴿وإسماعيل وإسحاق﴾: conjoined to إبراهيم.
﴿إلها﴾: badal from إلهك, or a preparatory ḥāl (ḥāl muwaṭṭiʾa), or accusative by way of specification (ikhtiṣāṣ), to negate what might occur to the mind of a multiplicity of gods.
﴿واحدا﴾: naʿt (adjective). The clause ﴿قالوا نعبد إلهك...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿ونحن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, or parenthetical, or circumstantial. نحن is a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿مسلمون﴾.
﴿مسلمون﴾: the khabar of نحن. The clause ﴿ونحن له مسلمون﴾ is conjoined, or a ḥāl, or parenthetical with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:134-134.t:
﴿تلك أمة﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate).
﴿قد خلت﴾: the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of أمة.
﴿لها﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are a fronted khabar.
﴿ما﴾: a delayed mubtadaʾ.
﴿كسبت﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative ﴿ما﴾.
﴿ولكم ما كسبتم﴾: conjoined to the preceding clause.
﴿ولا تسألون﴾: the wāw is resumptive; تسألون is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿عما﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) تسألون.
﴿كانوا﴾: the clause is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿يعملون﴾: the verbal clause is the khabar of كانوا. The clause ﴿ولا تسألون...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:135-135.t:
﴿وقالوا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and قالوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿كونوا هودا﴾: كان is a defective past verb [Translator's note: so in the source; كونوا is the imperative of the defective verb كان], the wāw is its noun (ism), and هودا its khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿أو﴾: a conjunction.
﴿نصارى﴾: conjoined to ﴿هودًا﴾.
﴿تهتدوا﴾: an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm), because it occurs as the answer to the request. The clause ﴿وقالوا كونوا...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿قل﴾: an imperative verb; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿بل﴾: a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction.
﴿ملة﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, i.e.: تتبع (we follow); or accusative by way of incitement (ighrāʾ), the implied form being: الزموا (hold to).
﴿إبراهيم﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct).
﴿حنيفا﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial) from إبراهيم.
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is negative.
﴿كان﴾: a defective past verb; its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being: هو.
﴿من المشركين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar.

muyesser-irab:136-136.t:
﴿قولوا﴾: an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the nūn, because its imperfect is one of the five verbs; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿آمنا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿بالله﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition and the Name of Majesty ﴿الله﴾ is a genitive noun, the sign of the genitive being the kasra; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) آمنا.
﴿وما أنزل إلينا﴾: conjoined to the Name of Majesty; the clause أنزل is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿وما أنزل إلى إبراهيم وإسماعيل وإسحاق ويعقوب والأسباط﴾: also conjoined.
﴿وما﴾: also conjoined.
﴿أوتي﴾: the clause is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿موسى﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿وعيسى﴾: conjoined to موسى.
﴿وما أوتي النبيون من ربهم﴾: also conjoined.
﴿لا نفرق بين أحد منهم﴾: the verbal clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial), and منهم is a naʿt (adjective) of أحد.
﴿ونحن﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and نحن is a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿مسلمون﴾.
﴿مسلمون﴾: the khabar (predicate) of نحن; the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:137-137.t:
﴿فإن آمنوا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إن is a jussive conditional particle, and آمنوا is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).
﴿بمثل﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) آمنوا.
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of the genitive by annexation.
﴿آمنتم﴾: the verbal clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿فقد﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq).
﴿اهتدوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the verbal clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. The clause ﴿فإن آمنوا...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿وإن تولوا﴾: conjoined to فإن آمنوا.
﴿فإنما﴾: the fāʾ is linking, and إنما is a restraining particle and the restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa).
﴿هم﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿في شقاق﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of هم.
﴿فسيكفيكهم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction for immediate succession (taʿqīb), the sīn is a particle of the future, and يكفي is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ); the kāf is first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hāʾ is second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿الله﴾: fāʿil.
﴿وهو﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and هو is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿السميع العليم﴾: two khabars. The clause ﴿وهو السميع العليم﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:138-138.t:
﴿صبغة الله﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e.: صُبِغنا (we have been dyed).
﴿ومن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and من is an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿أحسن﴾: khabar (predicate).
﴿من الله﴾: من is a preposition and the Name of Majesty is a genitive noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أحسن.
﴿صبغة﴾: tamyīz (specification).
﴿ونحن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and نحن is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿له﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿عابدون﴾.
﴿عابدون﴾: the khabar of نحن.

muyesser-irab:139-139.t:
﴿قل﴾: an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is أنت.
﴿أتحاجوننا﴾: the hamza is for the rhetorical interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī); تحاجون is an imperfect verb, the wāw is the fāʿil, and نا is in the position of the accusative as object.
﴿في الله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) تحاجوننا.
﴿وهو﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and هو is a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿ربنا﴾: khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وربكم﴾: conjoined to ربنا.
﴿ولنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لنا, the preposition and its genitive noun, is a fronted khabar.
﴿أعمالنا﴾: a delayed mubtadaʾ; the clause is a ḥāl.
﴿ولكم أعمالكم﴾: conjoined to the preceding clause.
﴿ونحن﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, and نحن is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿له﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿مخلصون﴾.
﴿مخلصون﴾: the khabar of نحن; the clause is also a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:140-140.t:
﴿أم﴾: a conjunction counterbalancing the interrogative, so it is connective (muttaṣila); it has also been said: it is disconnective (munqaṭiʿa) in the sense of بل plus the hamza, the implied form being: بل أتقولون ... (nay, do you say…), and it is a rhetorical interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī).
﴿تقولون﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿إن إبراهيم﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and إبراهيم is its noun (ism).
﴿وإسماعيل وإسحاق ويعقوب والأسباط﴾: nouns conjoined to إبراهيم; the clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿كانوا﴾: كان is a past, defective, abrogating verb, and the wāw is its noun.
﴿هودا﴾: the khabar (predicate) of كان.
﴿أو﴾: a conjunction.
﴿نصارى﴾: conjoined to ﴿هودًا﴾; the verbal clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of إن.
﴿قل﴾: an imperative verb; its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being: أنت.
﴿أأنتم﴾: the hamza is for the rhetorical interrogative of disapproval, and أنتم is a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿أعلم﴾: khabar.
﴿أم الله﴾: conjoined to أنتم.
﴿ومن﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and من is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ.
﴿أظلم﴾: khabar.
﴿ممن﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أظلم; the clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿كتم﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being: هو; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿شهادة﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿عنده﴾: the adverb is attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of شهادة.
﴿من الله﴾: من is a preposition and the Name of Majesty is a genitive noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted second naʿt of شهادة, or attached to كتم on the assumption of a muḍāf, i.e.: من كتم من عباد الله شهادة عنده (whoever conceals from Allah's servants a testimony he has). The clause ﴿ومن أظلم ممن...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction or resumptive, and ما is the Ḥijāzī negative ما, which operates like ليس.
﴿الله﴾: the Name of Majesty, the noun of ما.
﴿بغافل﴾: the bāʾ: a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; and غافل: the khabar of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position and genitive in form by the bāʾ.
﴿عما﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to غافل.
﴿تعملون﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿وما الله..﴾ is conjoined, or resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:247-247.t:
﴿وقال لهم نبيهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; قال is a past verb; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قال﴾; نبيهم is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿إن الله قد بعث لكم طالوت ملكا﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism); the clause ﴿قد بعث﴾ is its khabar (predicate); طالوت is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ملكًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of طالوت; إن and what follows it are a nominal clause in the position of accusative as the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿قالوا أنى يكون له الملك علينا﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; أنى is an interrogative noun meaning "how" (كيف), in the position of accusative as a ḥāl; يكون is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb (one of kāna and its sisters); له is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted, fronted khabar of ﴿يكون﴾; الملك is the delayed noun of يكون; علينا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to الملك. The interrogative clause and what falls within its scope are in the position of accusative as the object of the speech of قالوا.
﴿ونحن أحق بالملك منه﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); نحن is mubtadaʾ (subject) and أحق is its khabar; بالملك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أحق, and منه is likewise attached to أحق; the clause following the wāw is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
﴿ولم يؤت سعة من المال﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لم is a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and jussive; يؤت is an imperfect verb in the passive (whose agent is not named), made jussive (majzūm) by لم; the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); سعة is the second mafʿūl bihi. من المال is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of سعة.
﴿قال إن الله اصطفاه عليكم﴾: قال is a past verb; its agent is latent, its implied form being "he" (هو), referring to the prophet; إن is an abrogating particle, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; اصطفاه is a verb, a latent agent and a mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the khabar of إن; the clause of إن and what falls within its scope is in the position of accusative as the object of the speech; عليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to اصطفاه.
﴿وزاده بسطة في العلم والجسم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; زاده is a verb, a latent agent and a first mafʿūl bihi; بسطة is the second mafʿūl bihi; and it has been said: بسطة is a tamyīz (specification). في العلم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of بسطة; الجسم is conjoined to العلم.
﴿والله يؤتي ملكه من يشاء﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ; the clause يؤتي is the khabar; ملكه is the first mafʿūl bihi; من is a relative noun in the position of accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi; the clause يشاء is a naʿt. [Translator's note: so in the source; the clause يشاء is more usually described as the ṣila (relative clause) of من.]
﴿والله واسع عليم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ, and واسع عليم are its two khabars. The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:248-248.t:
﴿وقال لهم نبيهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, or resumptive, in which case the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; قال is a past verb; لهم is attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قال﴾; نبيهم is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿إن آية ملكه أن يأتيكم التابوت﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); آية is its noun (ism); ملكه is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن يأتيكم﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إن, nominative; إن and what falls within its scope are in the position of accusative as the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); التابوت is the fāʿil of يأتيكم, and the kāf is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فيه سكينة﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; سكينة is a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of التابوت.
﴿من ربكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of سكينة.
﴿وبقية مما ترك آل موسى وآل هارون﴾: بقية is conjoined to سكينة; مما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of بقية; ﴿ترك آل موسى﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; آل موسى is the fāʿil of ترك, and آل هارون is conjoined to آل موسى.
﴿تحمله الملائكة﴾: an imperfect verb; the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi, and الملائكة is its fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl of التابوت.
﴿إن في ذلك لآية لكم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle; the clause serves as a giving of the reason (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position; في ذلك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); آية is the delayed noun of إن; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of آية; the clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.
﴿إن كنتم مؤمنين﴾: إن is conditional; كنتم is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb (one of kāna and its sisters) in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the tāʾ is the noun of كان, and مؤمنين is its khabar. The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being: "then reflect on the matter, take heed, and comply with the command of your Lord and His signs." The conditional clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:249-249.t:
﴿فلما فصل طالوت بالجنود﴾: the fāʾ conjoins [this] to omitted, implied clauses, i.e. "so they acknowledged his kingship and called one another to jihad; then when…". لما is adverbial and temporal (ḥīniyya), so it is a noun, or linking, and in either case it implies the meaning of condition.
