The clause فصل طالوت بالجنود is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa) if it is an adverb. بالجنود is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) فصل, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "with the soldiers accompanying him."
﴿قال إن الله مبتليكم بنهر﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; إن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism), and مبتليكم is its khabar (predicate); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to مبتليكم; the nominal clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿فمن شرب منه فليس مني﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; من is a conditional noun governing the jussive, and is mubtadaʾ (subject); شرب is a past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), with a latent (mustatir) agent, its implied form being "he" (هو); منه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to شرب; the fāʾ links the apodosis; ليس is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb (one of kāna and its sisters), its noun being a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو); ﴿مني﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted khabar; the clause after the fāʾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis with its apodosis is the khabar of من.
﴿ومن لم يطعمه فإنه مني﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; من is conditional and is mubtadaʾ; لم is a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and jussive; يطعمه is an imperfect verb made jussive by لم; the fāʾ is linking; إن is an abrogating particle, and the hāʾ is its noun; مني is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted khabar; the clause after the fāʾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis with its apodosis is the khabar of من.
﴿إلا من اغترف غرفة بيده﴾: إلا is a particle of exception; من is a relative noun in the position of accusative as excepted from His saying ﴿فمن شرب منه﴾, the second clause having been placed between them because of the concern with its content. The clause اغترف has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾. غرفة is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), or it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a maṣdar of single instance; بيده is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of غرفة.
﴿فشربوا منه﴾: the fāʾ is the "eloquent" fāʾ (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa); شربوا is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); منه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to شربوا.
﴿إلا قليلا منهم﴾: إلا is a particle of exception; قليلًا is excepted from His saying فشربوا منه; منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of ﴿قليلًا﴾.
﴿فلما جاوزه هو والذين آمنوا معه﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, or resumptive, in which case the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; لما is adverbial and temporal, or a linking particle, implying the meaning of condition in either case; the clause جاوزه is in the position of genitive by annexation if we consider ﴿لما﴾ adverbial, or [otherwise] has no grammatical position. هو is a detached pronoun, a tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun latent in ﴿جاوزه﴾; الذين is conjoined to ﴿هو﴾; the clause آمنوا is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; معه is an adverb of place attached to جاوزه.
﴿قالوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil.
﴿لا طاقة لنا اليوم بجالوت وجنوده﴾: the clause is in the position of accusative as the object of the speech; لا is the lā of generic negation; طاقة is its noun; لنا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted khabar; اليوم is an adverb attached to that to which the khabar is attached, namely ﴿لنا﴾, and likewise His saying بجالوت.
﴿قال الذين﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
﴿يظنون أنهم ملاقو الله﴾: the clause يظنون has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of الذين; the wāw is the fāʿil; أن with its noun and its khabar stand in place of the two objects of يظنون; the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿كم من فئة قليلة﴾: كم is predicative (khabariyya), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; من فئة is the tamyīz (specification) of the predicative كم; قليلة is a naʿt of فئة.
﴿غلبت فئة كثيرة بإذن الله﴾: the khabar of ﴿كم﴾; the clause of كم and what falls within its scope is in the position of accusative as the object of the speech.
﴿والله مع الصابرين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ; مع is an adverb of place attached to an omitted khabar; الصابرين is muḍāf ilayhi. The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:250-250.t:
﴿ولما برزوا لجالوت وجنوده﴾: the wāw is resumptive; لما is temporal (ḥīniyya), or linking, implying the meaning of condition; برزوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) برزوا; جنوده is conjoined to جالوت.
﴿قالوا﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿ربنا أفرغ علينا صبرا﴾: ربنا is the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, with the vocative particle omitted; أفرغ is a verb of supplication; علينا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أفرغ; صبرًا is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). The clause ﴿ولما برزوا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وثبت أقدامنا﴾: conjoined to the clause أفرغ.
﴿وانصرنا على القوم الكافرين﴾: also conjoined.

muyesser-irab:251-251.t:
﴿فهزموهم بإذن الله﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; هزموهم is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وقتل داود جالوت﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, [followed by] a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وآتاه الله الملك والحكمة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; آتاه is a past verb; the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi; the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; الملك is the second mafʿūl bihi; الحكمة is conjoined to الملك.
﴿وعلمه مما يشاء﴾: conjoined to ﴿آتاه﴾; مما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) علمه; the clause يشاء is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; the mafʿūl bihi is omitted.
﴿ولولا دفع الله الناس﴾: the wāw is resumptive; لولا is a particle of non-occurrence due to the existence [of something], implying the meaning of condition; دفع is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "existing" (موجود); the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); الناس is the mafʿūl bihi of the maṣdar.
﴿بعضهم ببعض﴾: بعضهم is a badal (substitute) of الناس; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to دفع.
﴿لفسدت الأرض﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis of لولا; the clause فسدت الأرض has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. The clause ﴿ولولا دفع الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولكن الله ذو فضل على العالمين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; لكن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism), and ذو فضل is its khabar; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of فضل. The clause ﴿ولكن الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:252-252.t:
﴿تلك آيات الله﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿نتلوها عليك بالحق﴾: the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); or ﴿آيات الله﴾ is a badal (substitute) of the demonstrative, and the clause ﴿نتلوها﴾ is the khabar. عليك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) نتلوها; بالحق is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "supported by the truth, backed by certainty."
﴿وإنك لمن المرسلين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); the kāf is its noun (ism); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:58-58.t:
﴿وإذ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «إذ» is a noun of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), conjoined to «نعمتي» in the words of the Exalted «اذكروا نعمتي».
﴿قلنا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the verbal clause is in the position of a genitive (majrūr), muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿ادخلوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the omission of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of an accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿هذه﴾: the hāʾ is a particle of alerting (tanbīh), and «ذه» is a demonstrative in the position of an accusative as an object, by extension of usage (ittisāʿan).
﴿القرية﴾: a badal (substitute) from the demonstrative.
﴿فكلوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «كلوا» is conjoined to «ادخلوا».
﴿منها﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «كلوا».
﴿حيث﴾: an adverb of place, indeclinable on ḍamma, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "moving about" (متنقلين).
﴿شئتم﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of a genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it.
﴿رغدا﴾: standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a naʿt (adjective) of the maṣdar; or a ḥāl interpreted as a derived word, i.e. "in abundance and ease" (راغدين هانئين).
﴿وادخلوا﴾: conjoined to «ادخلوا».
﴿الباب﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) by extension of usage (ʿalā al-saʿa).
﴿سجدا﴾: ḥāl, i.e. "humble and bowed low, like the state of one prostrating".
﴿وقولوا﴾: conjoined to «وادخلوا».
﴿حطة﴾: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "our request is relief [from sins]" (مسألتنا حطة), or "our affair is relief" (أمرنا حطة); the nominal clause is the object of speech.
﴿نغفر﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) in answer to the request.
﴿لكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «نغفر».
﴿خطاياكم﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وسنزيد﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «نزيد» is an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "we" (نحن).
﴿المحسنين﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause «سنزيد المحسنين» is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:59-59.t:
﴿فبدل﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «بدل» is a past verb; the clause «بدل» is conjoined to the preceding clause «قلنا».
﴿الذين﴾: a relative noun, fāʿil (agent).
﴿ظلموا﴾: the clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿قولا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿غير﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of «قولًا».
﴿الذي﴾: a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿قيل﴾: a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive).
﴿لهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قيل». The clause «بدل الذين ظلموا...» is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿فأنزلنا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «أنزلنا» is conjoined to the preceding clause.
﴿على الذين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «أنزلنا».
﴿ظلموا﴾: the clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun.
﴿رجزا﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿من السماء﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of «رجزًا», or to «أنزلنا».
﴿بما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, and «ما» is maṣdariyya (infinitival), interpreted together with what follows it as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive by the bāʾ, i.e. "because of their transgression" (بسبب فسقهم).
﴿كانوا﴾: «كان» is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb [of kāna and its sisters], and the wāw is its noun; the clause «يفسقون» is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:60-60.t:
﴿وإذ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «إذ» is a noun of time in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), conjoined to «نعمتي» in the words of the Exalted «اذكروا نعمتي».
﴿استسقى﴾: a past verb.
﴿موسى﴾: fāʿil (agent); the clause «استسقى موسى» is in the position of a genitive (majrūr), muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿لقومه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «استسقى».
﴿فقلنا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «قلنا» is a verb and its fāʿil.
﴿اضرب﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); the clause is in the position of an accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿بعصاك﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «اضرب».
﴿الحجر﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فانفجرت﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa ("the disclosing fāʾ"); «انفجرت» is a past verb, and the tāʾ is the quiescent tāʾ of the feminine; i.e.: "so he obeyed the command and struck", or: "if you strike, then there will have gushed forth".
﴿منه﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «انفجرت».
﴿اثنتا عشرة﴾: the fāʿil of «انفجرت», the sign of its nominative being the alif, because it is treated like the dual; «عشرة» is the [second] part of the compound number, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa.
﴿عينا﴾: an explicit tamyīz (specification).
﴿قد﴾: a particle of realisation (taḥqīq).
﴿علم﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on fatḥa.
﴿كل أناس﴾: fāʿil.
﴿مشربهم﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is resumptive.
﴿كلوا واشربوا﴾: «كلوا»: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the omission of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; «اشربوا» is conjoined to «كلوا».
﴿من رزق الله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «كلوا» or «اشربوا».
﴿ولا تعثوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «لا» is prohibitive, and «تعثوا» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لا», the sign of its jussive being the omission of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil.
﴿في الأرض﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «تعثوا»; the clause «كلوا واشربوا» is in the position of an accusative as the object of speech, i.e.: "and We said: eat" (وقلنا: كلوا).
﴿مفسدين﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ, because it is a sound masculine plural.

muyesser-irab:200-200.t:
﴿فإذا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and «إذا» is an adverb (ẓarf) for future time, putting its condition in the genitive and itself accusative by its response.
﴿قضيتم﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).
﴿مناسككم﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the kāf is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by annexation.
﴿فاذكروا الله﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «اذكروا الله» is an imperative verb, fāʿil and object; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. The clause «فإذا قضيتم...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿كذكركم﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being: "remember Allah with a remembrance like your remembrance of your fathers"; «ذكركم» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and it is a maṣdar annexed to its agent, which is the attached pronoun of those addressed, and the attached pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿آباءكم﴾: the mafʿūl bihi of the maṣdar that is annexed to its agent.
﴿أو أشد ذكرا﴾: «أو» is a conjunction; «أشد» is conjoined to «الكاف» (the kāf), accusative; or conjoined to «ذكركم», genitive with the fatḥa because it is a diptote, the implied form being: "remember Allah with a remembrance like your remembrance of your fathers, or like a remembrance more intense in remembrance"; or conjoined to the pronoun of those addressed in «كذكركم», i.e.: "like your remembrance of your fathers, or like the remembrance of a people more intense in remembrance than you"; or conjoined to «آباءكم», accusative, i.e.: "like your remembrance of your fathers, or [of what is] more intensely remembered than your fathers"; or an adjective of an omitted maṣdar, i.e.: "and remember [Him] with a remembrance more intense than your remembrance of your fathers"; «ذكرا» is tamyīz (specification).
﴿فمن الناس﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿من﴾: a relative noun, a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿يقول﴾: an imperfect verb; its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو), referring back to «من»; the resumptive clause has no grammatical position, and the clause «يقول» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «من», with no grammatical position.
﴿ربنا﴾: the one addressed (munādā), annexed (muḍāf), accusative (manṣūb); the vocative particle has been omitted.
﴿آتنا﴾: a verb of supplication, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter; the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "you" (أنت); the pronoun of the plural speaker is the first object of «آت», and the second object is omitted, i.e.: "our share" (نصيبنا).
﴿في الدنيا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «آتنا». The clause «فمن الناس...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «ما» is negating (nāfiya).
﴿له﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar.
﴿في الآخرة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿من خلاق﴾: «من» is a preposition, and «خلاق» is genitive in form and nominative in position, because it is a postponed mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:201-201.t:
﴿ومنهم من يقول ربنا آتنا في الدنيا حسنة وفي الآخرة حسنة﴾: conjoined to the preceding clause.
﴿وقنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «ق» is a verb of supplication, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter; its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت), and the plural pronoun is the first object of «ق».
﴿عذاب النار﴾: the second object of «ق».

muyesser-irab:202-202.t:
﴿أولئك﴾: the demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿لهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿نصيب﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is the khabar of the demonstrative, and the [whole] clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿مما﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of «نصيب».
﴿كسبوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun «ما», with no grammatical position.
﴿والله﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and «الله» is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿سريع الحساب﴾: its khabar. The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:203-203.t:
﴿واذكروا الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «اذكروا» is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the Name of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿في أيام﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اذكروا».
﴿معدودات﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of «أيام».
﴿فمن﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and «من» is conditional, mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿تعجل﴾: a past verb in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).
﴿في يومين﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «تعجل».
﴿فلا إثم﴾: the fāʾ is linking (rābiṭa); «لا» is the lā of generic negation, and «إثم» is its noun, indeclinable on the fatḥa.
﴿عليه﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of «لا»; the clause joined with the fāʾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of «من». The clause «فمن تعجل...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ومن تأخر فلا إثم عليه﴾: the clause is conjoined.
﴿لمن اتقى﴾: the lām is a preposition, and «من» is a relative noun in the position of the genitive by the lām; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e.: "that choice, and the negation of sin for the one who hastens and the one who delays, is for whoever is mindful [of Allah]."
﴿واتقوا الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «اتقوا» is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, the wāw is the fāʿil, and the Name of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿واعلموا﴾: conjoined to «اتقوا».
﴿أنكم﴾: «أن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the kāf is its noun (ism).
﴿إليه﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «تحشرون».
﴿تحشرون﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar of «أن», and «أن» and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) that takes the place of the two objects of «اعلموا».

muyesser-irab:204-204.t:
﴿ومن الناس﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); the clause is conjoined to the clause «فمن الناس».
﴿من﴾: a relative noun, a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿يعجبك قوله﴾: an imperfect verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and a postponed fāʿil (agent); the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿في الحياة﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «قوله» or «يعجبك»; on the first [view] the saying is issued in [this] life, and on the second the admiration occurs in it.
﴿الدنيا﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of «الحياة».
﴿ويشهد﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya) or a conjunction; «يشهد» is an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو).
﴿الله﴾: the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi. [Translator's note: so in the source; in «ويشهد الله» the Name of Majesty is normally parsed as the fāʿil of «يشهد», not its object.]
﴿على ما﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يشهد».
﴿في قلبه﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ṣila of the relative noun, i.e.: "of what his speech signifies"; the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. On the view that the wāw in «ويشهد» is resumptive, the clause «ويشهد الله...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وهو﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «هو» is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿ألد الخصام﴾: khabar.

muyesser-irab:205-205.t:
﴿وإذا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «إذا» is an adverb (ẓarf) for future time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the response.
﴿تولى﴾: a past verb; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).
﴿سعى﴾: a past verb; its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "he" (هو); the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition (jawāb sharṭ ghayr jāzim).
﴿في الأرض﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «سعى».
﴿ليفسد فيها﴾: the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and «يفسد» is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an «أن» concealed after the lām of causation; the concealed «أن» and the imperfect verb after it are interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) in the genitive by the lām of causation, and the lām of causation and its genitive noun are attached to «سعى»; «فيها» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يفسد».
﴿ويهلك الحرث والنسل﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «يهلك» is an imperfect verb, accusative by conjunction with «يفسد», and the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "he" (هو); «الحرث» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «النسل» is conjoined to «الحرث».
﴿والله﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and «الله» is a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿لا﴾: negating (nāfiya).
﴿يحب الفساد﴾: an imperfect verb, with a latent fāʿil, its implied form being "He" (هو), i.e. Allah the Exalted; «الفساد» is the mafʿūl bihi; the verbal clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. The clause «والله لا يحب الفساد» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:206-206.t:
﴿وإذا قيل﴾: the wāw is a conjunction [joining] to His words «يعجبك», or the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); «إذا» is an adverb (ẓarf) for future time, and the clause «قيل» is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).
﴿له﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قيل».
﴿اتق الله﴾: «اتق» is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter; its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت), and the Name of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿أخذته العزة﴾: a past verb with the quiescent tāʾ of the feminine; the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi, and «العزة» is its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition (jawāb sharṭ ghayr jāzim). The clause «وإذا قيل له...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿بالإثم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "accompanied [by it]", the bāʾ being for accompaniment (muṣāḥaba); or the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «أخذته», the bāʾ being for transitivity (taʿdiya).
﴿فحسبه جهنم﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an omitted condition), as though it were an answer about his destiny; «حسبه» is a fronted khabar (predicate), and «جهنم» is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿ولبئس المهاد﴾: the wāw of the oath, and the lām occurs in the response to an implied oath, i.e.: "by Allah" (والله) [Translator's note: so in the source, which calls the wāw "the wāw of the oath" while also saying the oath is implied]; «بئس» is an invariable (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame, and «المهاد» is its fāʿil; the clause of verb and fāʿil is a fronted khabar of an omitted postponed mubtadaʾ, which is the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm), i.e.: "Hell" (جهنم); the clause is the response to an oath, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:207-207.t:
﴿ومن الناس﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿من﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is conjoined to His words «فمن الناس».
﴿يشري نفسه﴾: an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿ابتغاء مرضات الله﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), and what follows it is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿والله﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and «الله» is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿رءوف﴾: khabar.
﴿بالعباد﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «رءوف». The clause «والله رءوف بالعباد» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:61-61.t:
﴿وإذ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «إذ» is a noun of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), conjoined to «نعمتي» in the words of the Exalted «اذكروا نعمتي».
﴿قلتم﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the verbal clause is in the position of a genitive (majrūr), muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿يا﴾: a vocative particle.
﴿موسى﴾: the one addressed (munādā), a single proper noun.
﴿لن نصبر﴾: «لن» is a particle of negation, of the accusative, and of the future; «نصبر» is an imperfect verb, accusative by «لن», its fāʿil a pronoun necessarily latent (mustatir), its implied form being "we" (نحن).
﴿على طعام﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نصبر».
﴿واحد﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of «طعام».
﴿فادع﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; «ادع» is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the omission of the weak letter; its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت).
﴿لنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «ادع».
﴿ربك﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «ادع لنا ربك» is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿يخرج﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) in answer to the request.
﴿لنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يخرج».
﴿مما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يخرج».
﴿تنبت﴾: an imperfect verb.
﴿الأرض﴾: fāʿil; the clause «تنبت الأرض» is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿من بقلها﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are a badal (substitute) with repetition of the preposition, or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the omitted pronoun, which is the one referring back to the relative noun, i.e. "[which] it grows" (تنبته).
﴿وقثائها وفومها وعدسها وبصلها﴾: nouns conjoined to «بقلها».
﴿قال﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on fatḥa; its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو).
﴿أتستبدلون﴾: the hamza is for the interrogation of disapproval (istifhām inkārī) with rebuke; the clause «أتستبدلون» is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿الذي﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi.
﴿هو﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿أدنى﴾: khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of «الذي».
﴿بالذي﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «تستبدلون».
﴿هو﴾: mubtadaʾ.
﴿خير﴾: khabar. The clause «قال أتستبدلون...» is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿اهبطوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the omission of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the object of an omitted verb of saying, i.e. "We said" (قلنا).
﴿مصرا﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فإن﴾: the fāʾ is causal (taʿlīliyya), and «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh).
﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted fronted khabar of «إن».
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of an accusative, the noun of «إن».
﴿سألتم﴾: the clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of «ما».
﴿وضربت﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «ضربت» is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the tāʾ is the quiescent tāʾ of the feminine.
﴿عليهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «ضربت».
﴿الذلة﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿والمسكنة﴾: conjoined to «الذلة». The clause «ضربت عليهم الذلة» is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿وباءوا﴾: conjoined to «ضربت».
﴿بغضب﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «باءوا».
﴿من الله﴾: «من» is a preposition and the Name of Majesty is a genitive noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt of «غضب».
﴿ذلك﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ.
﴿بأنهم﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition; «إن» is an abrogating particle, and the hāʾ is its noun; «إن» and what falls within its scope are in the position of a genitive by the bāʾ, i.e. "all that is because of their disbelief"; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar. [Translator's note: the source writes «إن» here for «أنّ».]
﴿كانوا﴾: «كان» is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb [of kāna and its sisters], and the wāw is its noun; the clause is the khabar of «أن».
﴿يكفرون﴾: the verbal clause is the khabar of «كانوا».
﴿بآيات الله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يكفرون».
﴿ويقتلون﴾: conjoined to «يكفرون».
﴿النبيين﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿بغير الحق﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "in the state of their being wrongdoers, denying the truth in their belief"; the clause «ذلك بأنهم...» is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿ذلك﴾: the demonstrative, mubtadaʾ.
﴿بما عصوا﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, and «ما» is maṣdariyya (infinitival), interpreted together with the verb as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive by the bāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar of «ذلك».
﴿وكانوا﴾: conjoined to «عصوا»; «كان» is a defective, abrogating past verb, and the wāw is its noun.
﴿يعتدون﴾: a verbal clause in the position of an accusative, the khabar of «كانوا».

muyesser-irab:62-62.t:
﴿إن﴾: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh).
﴿الذين﴾: a relative noun, its noun.
﴿آمنوا﴾: the verbal clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿والذين﴾: conjoined to the first «الذين».
﴿هادوا﴾: the clause is a clause with no grammatical position; the clause of «إن» and what follows it is resumptive.
﴿والنصارى والصابئين﴾: conjoined to the noun of «إن».
﴿من﴾: a relative noun, a badal (substitute) from the noun of «إن»; or [it is] conditional «من».
﴿آمن﴾: a past verb; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun; or [it is] in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).
﴿بالله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «آمن».
﴿واليوم الآخر﴾: conjoined to the Name of Majesty.
﴿وعمل﴾: conjoined to «آمن».
﴿صالحا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «عمل», or standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) because it is a naʿt (adjective) of the maṣdar, i.e. "he did a righteous deed" (عمل عملًا صالحًا).
﴿فلهم﴾: the fāʾ was brought because the relative noun contains the meaning of condition, or [it] links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «لهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿أجرهم﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is the khabar of «إنّ» if we take «مَن» as a relative noun, or in the position of a jussive as the apodosis if we take it as conditional, the whole conditional clause «من آمن بالله...» then being in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), the khabar of «إنّ».
﴿عند ربهم﴾: the adverb is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "being due" or "being established".
﴿ولا خوف﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «لا» is negative, and «خوف» is a mubtadaʾ; it is permissible to begin with it although it is indefinite because the negation precedes it.
﴿عليهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ.
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «لا» is negative.
﴿هم﴾: an indeclinable pronoun in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ.
﴿يحزنون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; the clause «يحزنون» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «هم».

muyesser-irab:253-253.t:
﴿تلك الرسل فضلنا بعضهم على بعض﴾: a resumptive nominal clause with no grammatical position. The demonstrative is mubtadaʾ (subject) and الرسل is khabar (predicate); فضلنا is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); the clause فضلنا is a ḥāl (circumstantial). Or: الرسل is a badal (substitute) of the demonstrative, and the clause فضلنا is the khabar. بعضهم is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); على بعض is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) فضلنا.
﴿منهم من كلم الله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; من is a relative noun, a delayed mubtadaʾ; كلم الله is a verb and its fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the referent pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, being the mafʿūl bihi. The nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; or [it is] a badal of the clause فضلنا under the two preceding views, or a second khabar of the demonstrative.
﴿ورفع بعضهم درجات﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; رفع is a past verb; its agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "He" (هو), referring to Allah the Exalted; بعضهم is mafʿūl bihi; درجات is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e. "in degrees" (في درجات); and it has been said: [it is] a ḥāl in interpreted form of ﴿بعضهم﴾, i.e. "possessing degrees."
﴿وآتينا عيسى ابن مريم البينات﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; آتينا is a verb and its fāʿil; عيسى is mafʿūl bihi; ابن is a badal of ﴿عيسى﴾ or a naʿt (adjective) of it; مريم is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); البينات is the second mafʿūl bihi, the sign of its being accusative being the kasra in place of the fatḥa, because it is a sound feminine plural.
﴿وأيدناه بروح القدس﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أيدناه is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أيدناه; القدس is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿ولو شاء الله﴾: the wāw is resumptive; لو is conditional; شاء الله is a verb and its fāʿil; the object of the willing is omitted, its implied form being "their not fighting one another" (عدم اقتتالهم).
﴿ما اقتتل الذين من بعدهم﴾: ما is negative; اقتتل الذين is a verb and its fāʿil; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted ṣila of the relative noun; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. The clause ﴿ولو شاء الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿من بعد ما جاءتهم البينات﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to اقتتل, or [are] a badal of His saying ﴿من بعدهم﴾ with the preposition repeated; and the interpreted maṣdar from the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾ together with what follows it is genitive by annexation (iḍāfa), i.e. "after the coming of the clear proofs." [Translator's note: the source text here reads «ووالمصدر المؤول … بعدها)», with a doubled wāw and an unmatched closing parenthesis; translated as evidently intended.]
﴿ولكن اختلفوا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; لكن is an inoperative (muhmal) particle of rectification (istidrāk); اختلفوا is a verb and its fāʿil.
﴿فمنهم من آمن﴾: the fāʾ is of consequence (tafrīʿiyya); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; من is a relative noun, a delayed mubtadaʾ; آمن is a past verb, its fāʿil being "he" (هو); the clause is the ṣila of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿ومنهم من كفر﴾: conjoined to the preceding clause.
﴿ولو شاء الله﴾: the wāw is resumptive; لو is conditional; شاء الله is a verb and its fāʿil; the object of the willing is omitted, its implied form being "their not fighting one another" (عدم اقتتالهم).
﴿ما اقتتلوا﴾: ما is negative; اقتتلوا is a verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; the repetition of the clause is for emphasizing the speech. The clause ﴿ولو شاء الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولكن الله يفعل ما يريد﴾: the wāw is resumptive; لكن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); its noun (ism) is the Name of Majesty, and the clause يفعل is its khabar; ما is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi; the clause يريد is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿ولكن الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:254-254.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: يا is a vocative particle; أي is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of accusative; ها is for drawing attention (tanbīh); الذين is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; آمنوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿أنفقوا مما رزقناكم﴾: an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; مما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنفقوا; رزقناكم is a verb, its fāʿil and its object, and the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of ما. The whole clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿من قبل أن يأتي يوم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are also attached to أنفقوا; أن and what follows it are to be interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar), genitive by annexation (iḍāfa), i.e. "before the coming"; يوم is the fāʿil of يأتي.
﴿لا بيع فيه ولا خلة﴾: لا is negative; بيع is mubtadaʾ (subject), beginning with it [as an indefinite] being permissible because the negation precedes it; فيه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted khabar (predicate); ولا خلة is conjoined to ﴿لا بيع﴾.
﴿ولا شفاعة﴾: also conjoined.
﴿والكافرون هم الظالمون﴾: the wāw is resumptive; الكافرون is mubtadaʾ; هم is a second mubtadaʾ, and الظالمون is its khabar; the nominal clause is the khabar of ﴿الكافرون﴾. Or ﴿هم﴾ is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), and ﴿الظالمون﴾ is the khabar of ﴿الكافرون﴾. The clause ﴿والكافرون هم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:255-255.t:
﴿الله﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿لا﴾: the lā of generic negation.
﴿إله﴾: its noun (ism), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa in the position of accusative.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction.
﴿هو﴾: a badal (substitute) of the position of لا and its noun, since their position is nominative as a mubtadaʾ; or a badal of the pronoun latent in the omitted khabar (predicate). The clause ﴿لا إله إلا هو﴾ is the khabar of the Name of Majesty.
﴿الحي﴾: a second khabar.
﴿القيوم﴾: a third khabar; or: ﴿الحي القيوم﴾ are two naʿts (adjectives) of ﴿الله﴾, Mighty and Majestic is He.
﴿لا تأخذه سنة ولا نوم﴾: the clause is a fourth khabar of the mubtadaʾ; لا is negative; تأخذه is an imperfect verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); سنة is the fāʿil (agent) of تأخذه; ولا نوم is conjoined to سنة.
﴿له ما في السماوات وما في الأرض﴾: the clause is a fifth khabar; له is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar; ما is a relative noun in the position of nominative as a delayed mubtadaʾ; ﴿في السماوات﴾, the preposition and its genitive noun, is attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. ﴿ما في الأرض﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ما في السماوات﴾.
﴿من ذا الذي يشفع﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. من is an interrogative noun whose meaning is negation, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; ذا, the demonstrative, is in the position of nominative as the khabar of ﴿من﴾; الذي is a relative noun, a badal. Or ﴿من ذا﴾ as a whole is an interrogative noun, the mubtadaʾ, and ﴿الذي﴾ is the khabar. يشفع is an imperfect verb; its agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun.
﴿عنده إلا بإذنه﴾: the adverb is attached to يشفع, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in يشفع; إلا is a particle of restriction; بإذنه, the preposition and its genitive noun, is attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿يعلم ما بين أيديهم وما خلفهم﴾: the clause is a sixth khabar; يعلم is an imperfect verb whose agent is latent, referring to the Name of Majesty; ما is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi; بين is an adverb attached to the omitted ṣila of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; أيديهم is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the wāw is a conjunction; ما is conjoined to the first ﴿ما﴾, and the adverb is attached to the omitted ṣila.
﴿ولا يحيطون بشيء من علمه﴾: the clause is conjoined to what precedes; لا is negative; يحيطون is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; بشيء is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يحيطون; ﴿من علمه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of شيء.
﴿إلا بما شاء﴾: إلا is a particle of restriction; بما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted badal of شيء, with the preposition repeated; the clause شاء has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of ما; the object of the willing is omitted, its implied form being "that He should teach them it" (أن يعلمهم به).
﴿وسع كرسيه السماوات والأرض﴾: the clause is a seventh khabar, or is accusative as a ḥāl; وسع كرسيه is a past verb and its fāʿil; السماوات is mafʿūl bihi; الأرض is conjoined to السماوات.
﴿ولا يئوده حفظهما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is negative; يئوده is an imperfect verb and a mafʿūl bihi; حفظهما is the fāʿil; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the mīm and the alif are two letters indicating the dual.
﴿وهو العلي العظيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; هو is mubtadaʾ, العلي is its khabar, and العظيم is a second khabar.

muyesser-irab:256-256.t:
﴿لا إكراه في الدين﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; لا is the lā of generic negation; إكراه is its noun (ism); في الدين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate).
﴿قد تبين الرشد من الغي﴾: the clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position; قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq); تبين is a past verb; الرشد is its fāʿil (agent); من الغي is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تبين.
﴿فمن يكفر بالطاغوت﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction of consequence (ʿāṭifa tafrīʿiyya); من is a conditional noun governing the jussive, and is mubtadaʾ (subject); يكفر is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm); its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun referring to ﴿من﴾; بالطاغوت is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يكفر.
﴿ويؤمن بالله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; يؤمن is conjoined to يكفر; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يؤمن.
﴿فقد استمسك بالعروة الوثقى﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), because it is joined with قد; استمسك is a past verb, its fāʿil being a latent pronoun referring to من; بالعروة is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to استمسك; الوثقى is a naʿt (adjective) of العروة. The clause joined with the fāʾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis with its apodosis is the khabar of من. The clause من يكفر has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. [Translator's note: so in the source; no non-jussive condition precedes here, and the clause is rather conjoined by the fāʾ of consequence, as stated above.]
﴿لا انفصام لها﴾: the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of العروة; لا is the lā of generic negation; انفصام is its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; لها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of لا.
﴿والله سميع عليم﴾: the clause is resumptive or parenthetical, and on both views it has no grammatical position; the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ, and سميع عليم are its two khabars.

muyesser-irab:257-257.t:
﴿الله ولي الذين آمنوا﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, explaining the grace that lies in the bringing out; the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject) and ولي is its khabar (predicate); الذين is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿يخرجهم من الظلمات إلى النور﴾: the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun latent in ﴿ولي﴾, or a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ ﴿الله﴾; من الظلمات is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) يخرجهم, and إلى النور is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يخرجهم, i.e. "beginning from the wrongdoers and ending at the light" [Translator's note: so in the source («بدءًا من الظالمين»); evidently a slip for الظلمات, "the darknesses"], or [the clause is] a ḥāl of the relative noun.
﴿والذين كفروا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; الذين is mubtadaʾ; the clause كفروا is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿أولياؤهم الطاغوت﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar; the nominal clause is the khabar of الذين, the linking element being the pronoun.
﴿يخرجونهم من النور إلى الظلمات﴾: يخرجونهم is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and ﴿هم﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is a ḥāl, or a second khabar; من النور is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يخرجونهم, and إلى الظلمات is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يخرجونهم.
﴿أولئك أصحاب النار﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar; النار is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is a ḥāl.
﴿هم فيها خالدون﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar; فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿خالدون﴾; the clause is a second ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:141-141.t:
﴿تلك﴾: a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿أمة﴾: khabar (predicate).
﴿قد﴾: a particle of realization (taḥqīq).
﴿خلت﴾: a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif, which is dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the tāʾ is the quiescent tāʾ of the feminine, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: هي; the verbal clause is a naʿt (adjective) of أمة.
﴿لها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar.
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, delayed mubtadaʾ.
﴿كسبت﴾: the verbal clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾.
﴿ولكم ما كسبتم﴾: conjoined to the clause before it.
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is negative.
﴿تسألون﴾: an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿عما﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تسألون.
﴿كانوا﴾: كان is a defective past verb, and the wāw is its noun (ism).
﴿يعملون﴾: the verbal clause is the khabar of كانوا; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

muyesser-irab:142-142.t:
﴿سيقول﴾: the sīn is a particle of the future, and يقول is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿السفهاء﴾: fāʿil (agent).
﴿من الناس﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from السفهاء; the clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿ما﴾: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿ولاهم﴾: a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil, and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of ما, and the whole clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿عن قبلتهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ولاهم.
﴿التي﴾: a relative noun in the position of the genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of قبلتهم.
﴿كانوا﴾: كان is a defective past verb, and the wāw is its noun (ism); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿التي﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿عليها﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar of كانوا.
﴿قل﴾: an imperative verb; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being: أنت.
﴿لله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar.
﴿المشرق﴾: a delayed mubtadaʾ.
﴿والمغرب﴾: conjoined to المشرق.
﴿يهدي﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative; its fāʿil is a latent pronoun referring to the Name of Majesty.
﴿من﴾: a relative noun, the object of يهدي; the nominal clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying.
﴿يشاء﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being: هو; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun.
﴿إلى صراط﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يهدي.
﴿مستقيم﴾: naʿt of صراط.

muyesser-irab:143-143.t:
﴿وكذلك﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the kāf: a noun in the sense of مثل (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar placed before its governor, the implied form being: جعلًا مثل ذلك جعلناكم (with a making like that We made you); and ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address.
﴿جعلناكم﴾: a verb, its fāʿil (agent), and the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of جعلنا.
﴿أمة﴾: the second object of جعلنا.
﴿وسطا﴾: naʿt of أمة.
﴿لتكونوا﴾: the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and تكونوا is an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an أن optionally implied after the lām of causation; the implied أن and the imperfect verb after it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive by the lām of causation, and the lām of causation with its genitive is in the position of the accusative as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); the wāw is its noun (ism). [Translator's note: in the source the Quranic brackets in this line are misplaced (opening before تكونوا and closing after the second أن); the wording is translated as intended.]
﴿شهداء﴾: its khabar (predicate).
﴿على الناس﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) شهداء.
﴿ويكون﴾: conjoined to تكونوا.
﴿الرسول﴾: the noun of يكون.
﴿عليكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿شهيدًا﴾.
﴿شهيدا﴾: the khabar of يكون. The clause ﴿وكذلك جعلناكم...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is negative.
﴿جعلنا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil.
﴿القبلة﴾: the first object of جعلنا.
﴿التي﴾: a relative noun in the position of the accusative as the second object of جعلنا.
﴿كنت﴾: كان is a defective past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun.
﴿عليها﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are the khabar of كنت; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of التي.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿لنعلم﴾: the lām is the lām of causation, and نعلم is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being: نحن; the position of لنعلم is that of a mafʿūl li-ajlihi, so it is an emptied exception (istithnāʾ mufarragh) from the most general of reasons.
﴿من﴾: a relative noun in the place of the accusative as the object of نعلم.
﴿يتبع الرسول﴾: the verbal clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun; الرسول is mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ممن﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to نعلم, which carries the sense of نميّز (We distinguish).
﴿ينقلب﴾: the verbal clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun.
﴿على عقبيه﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: مرتدًّا على عقبيه (turning back on his heels).
﴿وإن﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and إن is lightened from the heavy [إنّ] and inoperative (muhmala).
﴿كانت﴾: a defective past verb; its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being: هي, i.e.: the turning towards it.
﴿لكبيرة﴾: the lām is the distinguishing lām (al-lām al-fāriqa), and كبيرة is the khabar of كان; the clause ﴿وإن كانت لكبيرة﴾ is in the place of the accusative as a ḥāl.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of exception.
﴿على الذين﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are in the place of the accusative as the excepted, and that from which the exception is made is omitted, its implied form being: وإن كانت لكبيرة على الناس إلا على الناس الذين هداهم الله (though it was indeed hard upon people, except upon the people whom Allah guided); or: إلا is a particle of restriction, because the speech is incomplete, or because it carries the sense of negation, so the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to كبيرة.
﴿هدى الله﴾: the verbal clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of الذين.
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is negative.
﴿كان الله﴾: كان is a defective past verb, and the Name of Majesty is its noun.
﴿ليضيع﴾: the lām is the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd), which is preceded by a negated كان; يضيع is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an أن necessarily implied after the lām of denial; the khabar of كان is omitted, its implied form being: مريدًا (intending), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar.
﴿إيمانكم﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿إن الله﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and the Name of Majesty is its noun.
﴿بالناس﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to رءوف or رحيم.
﴿لرءوف﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and رءوف is the first khabar of إن.
﴿رحيم﴾: the second khabar of إن; the clause of إن and what falls within its scope has no grammatical position, because it is causal (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:144-144.t:
﴿قد﴾: for frequency (taktīr).
﴿نرى﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ); its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being: نحن.
﴿تقلب﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وجهك﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct).
﴿في السماء﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) تقلب, because it is a maṣdar (verbal noun).
﴿فلنولينك﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction for causation, the lām occurs in the response to an implied oath, and نولينك is an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being: نحن, and the kāf is first mafʿūl bihi.
﴿قبلة﴾: second mafʿūl bihi, or accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ).
﴿ترضاها﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative; its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being: أنت, and ﴿ها﴾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of قبلة, and the clause فلنولينك has no grammatical position, because it is causal (taʿlīliyya).
﴿فول﴾: the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa ("disclosing") fāʾ, and ول is an imperative verb indeclinable on the omission of the weak letter; its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being: أنت.
﴿وجهك﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the kāf is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by annexation.
﴿شطر المسجد﴾: mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of place attached to ول; المسجد is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿الحرام﴾: naʿt of المسجد; the clause فول has no grammatical position.
﴿وحيث ما﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and حيث ما is a jussive conditional noun, in the position of the accusative as an adverb, attached to the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of كنتم.
﴿كنتم﴾: كان is a defective past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun (ism); the clause is in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).
﴿فولوا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, because it is a request; ولوا is an imperative verb indeclinable on the omission of the nūn, because its imperfect is one of the five verbs, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).
﴿وجوهكم﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿شطره﴾: an adverb of place attached to ولوا. The clause ﴿وحيث ما كنتم...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿وإن الذين﴾: the wāw is resumptive, إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and الذين is its noun.
﴿أوتوا الكتاب﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; الكتاب is the second object of أوتوا, and the first is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), which is the wāw.
﴿ليعلمون﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and the clause يعلمون is the khabar of إن.
﴿أنه الحق﴾: أن is an abrogating particle, the hāʾ is its noun, and الحق its khabar; it stands in place of the two objects of يعلمون.
﴿من ربهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). The clause ﴿وإن الذين أوتوا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وما﴾: the wāw: resumptive; and ما: the Ḥijāzī negative ما, which operates like ليس.
﴿الله﴾: the Name of Majesty, the noun of ما.
﴿بغافل﴾: the bāʾ: a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; and غافل: the khabar of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position and genitive in form by the bāʾ.
﴿عما﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to غافل.
﴿يعملون﴾: the verbal clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾. The clause ﴿وما الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:145-145.t:
﴿ولئن﴾: the wāw is resumptive, the lām paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam), and إن is conditional.
﴿أتيت﴾: a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿الذين﴾: a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿أوتوا الكتاب﴾: a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and الكتاب is the second object of أوتوا.
﴿بكل آية﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أتيت.
﴿ما﴾: negative.
﴿تبعوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil.
﴿قبلتك﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the response to the oath, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the response to the oath. The clause ﴿ولئن أتيت...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is the Ḥijāzī negative ما, which operates like ليس.
﴿أنت﴾: the noun (ism) of ما.
﴿بتابع﴾: the bāʾ: a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; and تابع: genitive in form and accusative in position, as the khabar (predicate) of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾.
﴿قبلتهم﴾: mafʿūl bihi of the active participle تابع; this clause is conjoined to what preceded.
﴿وما بعضهم بتابع قبلة بعض﴾: the clause is conjoined to the one before it.
﴿ولئن﴾: the wāw is resumptive, the lām paves the way for the oath, and إن is conditional.
﴿اتبعت﴾: a verb and its fāʿil.
﴿أهواءهم﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿من بعد﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to اتبعت.
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of the genitive by annexation.
﴿جاءك﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾.
﴿من العلم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are in the place of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). The clause ﴿ولئن اتبعت أهواءهم﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إنك﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and the kāf is its noun.
﴿إذًا﴾: a particle of response and requital, inoperative (muhmala), brought to emphasize the oath.
﴿لمن الظالمين﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar of إن; the clause of إن and what falls within its scope has no grammatical position, because it is the response to the oath, and for that reason it is not linked with the fāʾ.

muyesser-irab:146-146.t:
﴿الذين﴾: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿آتيناهم الكتاب﴾: a verb, its fāʿil (agent), and mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and الكتاب is the second object of آتيناهم; the verbal clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين.
﴿يعرفونه﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil, and its object; the clause يعرفونه is the khabar (predicate) of الذين.
﴿كما﴾: the kāf is a noun in the sense of مثل (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar, the implied form being: يعرفونه معرفة مثلَ معرفتهم أبناءهم (they know it with a knowing like their knowing of their sons); and ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdarī.
﴿يعرفون﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿يعرفون﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the particle-relative, which is the maṣdarī ﴿ما﴾, and the interpreted maṣdar formed from the maṣdarī ﴿ما﴾ and the verb ﴿يعرفون﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct).
﴿أبناءهم﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وإن فريقا﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and فريقا is its noun (ism); the clause is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). Or the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position, to establish their condition.
﴿منهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt of ﴿فريقًا﴾.
﴿ليكتمون﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and يكتمون is a verb and its fāʿil.
﴿الحق﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of إن.
﴿وهم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, and هم is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿يعلمون﴾: the verbal clause is the khabar of هم; the clause after the wāw is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:63-63.t:
﴿وإذ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «إذ» is a noun of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), conjoined to «نعمتي» in the words of the Exalted: «اذكروا نعمتي».
﴿أخذنا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of a genitive (majrūr), muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿ميثاقكم﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ورفعنا﴾: conjoined to «أخذنا».
﴿فوقكم﴾: the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «رفعنا».
﴿الطور﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿خذوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the omission of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the object of an omitted verb of saying, i.e. "We said: take" (قلنا: خذوا); the clause of saying is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), the implied form being: "saying: take" (قائلين: خذوا).
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, the object of «خذوا». The clause «آتيناكم»: «آتى» is a past verb, «نا» is the fāʿil, and «كم» is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of «ما».
﴿بقوة﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), the meaning being: "take what We have given you in the state of your being resolved upon earnestness and action".
﴿واذكروا﴾: conjoined to «خذوا».
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, the object of «اذكروا».
﴿فيه﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ṣila of the relative noun; the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿لعلكم﴾: «لعل» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the kāf is its noun.
﴿تتقون﴾: the khabar (predicate) of «لعل».

muyesser-irab:64-64.t:
﴿ثم توليتم﴾: a conjoining that conveys delay (tarākhī), indicating that there was compliance with the command and then turning away from it.
﴿من بعد ذلك﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «توليتم».
﴿فلولا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «لولا» is a particle of "non-occurrence due to occurrence" (ḥarf imtināʿ li-wujūd) containing the meaning of condition.
﴿فضل الله﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "exists" (موجود).
﴿عليكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «فضل».
﴿ورحمته﴾: conjoined to «فضل».
﴿لكنتم﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis of «لولا»; «كان» is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb [of kāna and its sisters], and the tāʾ is its noun.
﴿من الخاسرين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of «كنتم»; the clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.

muyesser-irab:65-65.t:
﴿ولقد﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the lām is [the lām of] the answer to an omitted oath; and «قد» is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq).
﴿علمتم﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿الذين﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿اعتدوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿منكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «اعتدوا».
﴿في السبت﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «اعتدوا». The clause «قد علمتم...» is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿فقلنا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «قلنا» is a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to the clause «اعتدوا».
﴿لهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «قلنا».
﴿كونوا﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperative verb [of kāna and its sisters], indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the nūn; the wāw is its noun.
﴿قردة﴾: its khabar (predicate).
﴿خاسئين﴾: a second khabar, or a naʿt (adjective); and it has been said: both are [one] khabar, the two being treated as a single word.

muyesser-irab:66-66.t:
﴿فجعلناها﴾: the clause is conjoined to what precedes.
﴿نكالا﴾: the second object of «جعلنا».
﴿لما﴾: the lām is a preposition, and «ما» is a relative noun in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the lām; the preposition and its genitive noun are a naʿt (adjective) of «نكالًا».
﴿بين يديها﴾: the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿وما﴾: conjoined to «ما».
﴿خلفها﴾: an adverb attached to an omitted ṣila of the second «ما».
﴿وموعظة﴾: conjoined to «نكالًا».
﴿للمتقين﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are a naʿt of «موعظة».

muyesser-irab:67-67.t:
﴿وإذ قال موسى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «إذ» is a noun of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), conjoined to «نعمتي» in the words of the Exalted «اذكروا نعمتي»; «قال موسى» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the verbal clause is in the position of a genitive (majrūr), muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿لقومه﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قال».
﴿إن الله﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the Name of Majesty is its noun. The clause «يأمركم»: the clause is the khabar (predicate) of «إن».
﴿أن﴾: a maṣdar particle and [particle] of the accusative.
﴿تذبحوا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by «أن»; «إن» and what falls within its scope are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e. "to slaughter a cow" (بأن تذبحوا بقرة). [Translator's note: the source writes «إن» here for «أن».]
﴿بقرة﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿قالوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil.
﴿أتتخذنا﴾: the hamza is for the interrogation of disavowal (istifhām istinkārī); «تتخذنا» is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil, and the first mafʿūl bihi.
﴿هزوا﴾: the second mafʿūl bihi; the verbal clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿قال﴾: a past verb; its fāʿil is "he" (هو).
﴿أعوذ بالله﴾: the object of speech.
﴿أن أكون﴾: «أن» and what falls within its scope are a maṣdar, accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "from being" (من أن أكون); the noun of «أكون» is latent, its implied form being "I" (أنا).
﴿من الجاهلين﴾: its khabar.

muyesser-irab:208-208.t:
﴿يا أيها﴾: «يا» is a vocative particle, and «أي» is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of the accusative; «ها» is for drawing attention (tanbīh).
﴿الذين﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of «أي».
﴿آمنوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿ادخلوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil.
﴿في السلم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ادخلوا»; the clause «يا أيها الذين...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿كافة﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «ادخلوا», and from «السلم».
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, [and] «لا» is prohibitive (nāhiya).
﴿تتبعوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لا», the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil.
﴿خطوات الشيطان﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿إنه﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun (ism).
﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «عدو».
﴿عدو﴾: khabar (predicate).
﴿مبين﴾: an adjective; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:209-209.t:
﴿فإن زللتم﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), «إن» is conditional, and «زللتم» is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); it is in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).
﴿من بعد ما جاءتكم البينات﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «زللتم»; «ما» is maṣdariyya, interpreted together with the verb after it as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) in the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); «جاءتكم البينات» is a verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a fāʿil.
﴿فاعلموا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «اعلموا» is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis.
﴿أن الله عزيز حكيم﴾: «أن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism), and «عزيز حكيم» are its two khabars (predicates); [«أن» and what falls within its scope] take the place of the two objects of «اعلموا». The clause «فإن زللتم» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:210-210.t:
﴿هل﴾: an interrogative particle whose meaning is disapproval and rebuke.
﴿ينظرون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); its meaning is "they wait" (ينتظرون), or "they look", from looking (al-naẓar).
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿أن يأتيهم﴾: «أن» is a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; it and what falls within its scope are interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar), the object of «ينظرون»; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿الله﴾: the fāʿil of «يأتيهم».
﴿في ظلل﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يأتيهم».
﴿من الغمام﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of «ظلل».
﴿والملائكة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «الملائكة» is conjoined to the Name of Majesty.
﴿وقضي الأمر﴾: conjoined to «يأتيهم», falling within the scope of the waiting; or a resumptive clause with no grammatical position.
﴿وإلى الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «ترجع».
﴿ترجع﴾: an imperfect verb, passive (built for that whose agent is not named).
﴿الأمور﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

muyesser-irab:211-211.t:
﴿سل بني إسرائيل﴾: «سل» is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn; its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); «بني» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ, because it is treated like the sound masculine plural; «إسرائيل» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the sign of its genitive being the fatḥa in place of the kasra, because it is a diptote. The clause «سل بني إسرائيل» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿كم آتيناهم﴾: «كم» is an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as the second object of «آتيناهم»; «آتيناهم» is a verb, a fāʿil and a first object; the clause «آتيناهم» is in the place of the second object of «سل».
﴿من آية﴾: the tamyīz (specification) of the interrogative «كم», «من» being connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant); or [«من» is] explicative (bayāniyya) and the tamyīz is omitted. «من آية» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb.
﴿بينة﴾: an adjective (ṣifa).
﴿ومن﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and «من» is conditional, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿يبدل﴾: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).
﴿نعمة الله﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿من بعد ما جاءته﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); «ما» is maṣdariyya, interpreted together with what follows it as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) in the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); «جاءته» is a past verb and a mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "it" (هي).
﴿فإن الله﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism).
﴿شديد العقاب﴾: its khabar (predicate); the clause of «إن» and what follows it is in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis of the jussive condition. The clause «ومن يبدل...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:212-212.t:
﴿زين﴾: a past verb, passive (built for that whose agent is not named).
﴿للذين كفروا﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «زين»; the clause «كفروا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿الحياة﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿الدنيا﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of «الحياة»; the clause «زين للذين...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ويسخرون﴾: conjoined to the clause «زين», or the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: "and they mock" (وهم يسخرون).
﴿من الذين﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يسخرون».
﴿آمنوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the verbal clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of «الذين».
﴿والذين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «الذين» is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿اتقوا﴾: the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿فوقهم﴾: an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to an omitted khabar of «الذين».
﴿يوم القيامة﴾: an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to what the adverb of place is attached to.
﴿والله﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and «الله» is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿يرزق﴾: an imperfect verb; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), referring back to the Name of Majesty; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ.
﴿من﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿يشاء﴾: an imperfect verb; the clause is the ṣila of «من», with no grammatical position.
﴿بغير حساب﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يرزق». The clause «والله يرزق...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:213-213.t:
﴿كان الناس أمة﴾: «كان» is a deficient (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb; «الناس» is the noun (ism) of «كان», nominative (marfūʿ), and «أمة» is the khabar (predicate) of «كان», accusative (manṣūb).
﴿واحدة﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). The clause «كان الناس...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فبعث﴾: the fāʾ joins to a clause implied for brevity and concision, i.e.: "mankind was one community, then they differed, so [Allah] sent"; «بعث» is a past verb.
﴿الله﴾: fāʿil (agent).
﴿النبيين﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿مبشرين ومنذرين﴾: two ḥāls (circumstantials), the second conjoined to the first.
﴿وأنزل﴾: conjoined to «فبعث».
﴿معهم﴾: an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl from «الكتاب», i.e.: "and He sent down the Book accompanying them at the time of sending down." [Translator's note: so in the source ("adverb of time"); elsewhere the book calls «مع» an adverb of place.]
﴿الكتاب﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿بالحق﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «أنزل»; the bāʾ is for accompaniment (mulābasa), i.e.: "He sent it down with a sending down clothed in truth."
﴿ليحكم﴾: the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and «يحكم» is an imperfect verb, accusative by an «أن» concealed after the lām of causation; the concealed «أن» and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) in the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are also attached to «أنزل».
﴿بين الناس﴾: an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to «يحكم», and «الناس» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿فيما﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يحكم».
﴿اختلفوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative «ما».
﴿فيه﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «اختلفوا».
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «ما» is negating (nāfiya).
﴿اختلف﴾: a past verb.
﴿فيه﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «اختلاف». [Translator's note: so in the source; the verb in the verse is «اختلف».]
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿الذين﴾: the fāʿil of «اختلف».
﴿أوتوه﴾: a past verb, passive (built for that whose agent is not named); the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), which is the first object, and the hāʾ is the second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿من بعد﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «اختلف».
﴿ما﴾: maṣdariyya, interpreted together with what follows it as a maṣdar that is muḍāf ilayhi, i.e.: "after the coming of the clear proofs."
﴿جاءتهم البينات﴾: a verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi, and «البينات» is a postponed fāʿil.
﴿بغيا﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e.: "out of envy on their part"; or an interpreted ḥāl.
﴿بينهم﴾: an adverb of place attached to an omitted adjective of «بغيًا».
﴿فهدى الله الذين آمنوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «هدى» is a past verb, the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil, and «الذين» with its ṣila is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿لما﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «هدى», and «ما» is relative.
﴿اختلفوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of «ما», with no grammatical position.
﴿فيه﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «اختلفوا».
