﴿من الحق﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl from «ما».
﴿بإذنه﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl from «الذين آمنوا», i.e.: "being permitted", so it is a ḥāl from the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿والله﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿يهدي﴾: an imperfect verb; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "He" (هو), referring back to the Name of Majesty; the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ.
﴿من﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi.
﴿يشاء﴾: the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿إلى صراط مستقيم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يهدي»; «مستقيم» is an adjective. The clause «والله يهدي...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:214-214.t:
﴿أم﴾: a disjunctive (munqaṭiʿa) conjunction meaning «بل» and the interrogative hamza; the meaning is: «بل أحسبتم» ("nay, did you think…").
﴿حسبتم﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿أن تدخلوا﴾: «أن» is a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle, and «تدخلوا» is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by «أن», the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil.
﴿الجنة﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa); «أن» and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) that takes the place of the two objects of «حسبتم».
﴿ولما﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «لما» is a jussive-governing particle of negation.
﴿يأتكم﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لما», the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; the kāf is the object of «يأت».
﴿مثل﴾: the fāʿil of «يأت».
﴿الذين﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿خلوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين».
﴿من قبلكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خلوا».
﴿مستهم﴾: «مس» is a past verb, the tāʾ is the quiescent tāʾ of the feminine, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿البأساء﴾: fāʿil.
﴿والضراء﴾: conjoined to «البأساء»; the clause «مستهم البأساء» is resumptive or explicative (tafsīriyya), and on both views it has no grammatical position.
﴿وزلزلوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «زلزلوا» is a past verb, passive (built for that whose agent is not named), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is conjoined to «مستهم».
﴿حتى يقول الرسول﴾: «حتى» is a particle of limit (ghāya) and a preposition; «يقول» is an imperfect verb, accusative by an «أن» concealed after «حتى»; «أن» and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar in the genitive by «حتى», and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «زلزلوا»; «الرسول» is the fāʿil.
﴿والذين﴾: conjoined to «الرسول».
﴿آمنوا﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of «الذين».
﴿معه﴾: an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to «آمنوا».
﴿متى نصر الله﴾: «متى» is an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as an adverb of time (ʿalā al-ẓarfiyya al-zamāniyya); the adverb is attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), and «نصر الله» is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is in the position of the accusative as the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿ألا﴾: a particle of opening (istiftāḥ) and drawing attention (tanbīh).
﴿إن نصر الله قريب﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), «نصر الله» is its noun (ism), and «قريب» is its khabar; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:147-147.t:
﴿الحق﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿من ربك﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿الحق من ربك﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿فلا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and لا is prohibitive.
﴿تكونن﴾: the clause تكونن: an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, in the position of the jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا; the noun (ism) of تكونن is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being: أنت.
﴿من الممترين﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar. The clause ﴿فلا تكونن...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:148-148.t:
﴿ولكل﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿وجهة﴾: a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿هو﴾: mubtadaʾ.
﴿موليها﴾: khabar; the nominal clause is a naʿt (adjective) of وجهة. The clause ﴿ولكل وجهة...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿فاستبقوا﴾: the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa ("disclosing") fāʾ, i.e.: if you wish to know what is most correct, then race; استبقوا is an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿الخيرات﴾: accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), because استبق is intransitive, i.e.: إلى الخيرات (towards good deeds); the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of an implied condition.
﴿أين ما﴾: a jussive conditional noun, accusative as an adverb of place, attached to the omitted fronted khabar of ﴿تكونوا﴾.
﴿تكونوا﴾: an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm), because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the wāw is its noun (ism); the clause ﴿تكونوا﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿يأت﴾: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the sign of its jussive is the omission of the weak letter.
﴿بكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يأت.
﴿الله﴾: fāʿil.
﴿جميعا﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿إن الله﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and the Name of Majesty is its noun.
﴿على كل شيء﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to قدير.
﴿قدير﴾: the khabar of إن; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:149-149.t:
﴿ومن حيث﴾: the wāw is resumptive, or a conjunction. The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, the implied form being: ولِّ وجهك من حيث خرجت (turn your face, from wherever you go out).
﴿خرجت﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿خرجت﴾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation. The clause ﴿ومن حيث خرجت...﴾ is resumptive, or conjoined to the resumptive clause, and on both views it has no grammatical position.
﴿فول﴾: the fāʾ is linking, because of the hint of condition in ﴿حيث﴾; ﴿ولِّ﴾ is an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the weak letter.
﴿وجهك﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿شطر المسجد﴾: an adverb of place attached to ولّ, and المسجد is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct).
﴿الحرام﴾: naʿt (adjective).
﴿وإنه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction or circumstantial (ḥāliyya), إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and the hāʾ is its noun (ism).
﴿للحق﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and الحق is the khabar (predicate) of إن.
﴿من ربك﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وما﴾: the wāw: resumptive; and ما: the Ḥijāzī negative ما, which operates like ليس.
﴿الله﴾: its noun, in the nominative.
﴿بغافل﴾: the bāʾ: a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; and غافل: the khabar of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position and genitive in form by the bāʾ.
﴿عما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to غافل.
﴿تعملون﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. The clause ﴿وما الله...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:150-150.t:
﴿ومن حيث﴾: the wāw is resumptive, or a conjunction. The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, the implied form being: ولّ وجهك من حيث خرجت (turn your face, from wherever you go out).
﴿خرجت﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿خرجت﴾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation. The clause ﴿ومن حيث خرجت...﴾ is resumptive, or conjoined to the resumptive clause, and on both views it has no grammatical position.
﴿فول﴾: the fāʾ is linking, because of the hint of condition in ﴿حيث﴾; ﴿ولّ﴾ is an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the weak letter.
﴿وجهك﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿شطر المسجد﴾: an adverb of place attached to ولّ, and المسجد is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct).
﴿الحرام﴾: naʿt (adjective); the clause ﴿ومن حيث خرجت فول وجهك شطر المسجد الحرام﴾ is a second emphasis (tawkīd). The clause ﴿ومن حيث...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿وحيث ما كنتم فولوا وجوهكم شطره﴾: a third emphasis.
﴿لئلا﴾: the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and أن, merged into the negative لا, is a maṣdarī particle and governs the accusative.
﴿يكون﴾: a defective imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by أن; أن and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive, and the preposition with its genitive noun is attached to ولوا.
﴿للناس﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of يكون.
﴿عليكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally a naʿt of حجة and was placed before it, so it became accusative as a ḥāl.
﴿حجة﴾: the delayed noun (ism) of يكون, in the nominative.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of exception.
﴿الذين﴾: a continuous excepted (mustathnā muttaṣil) from الناس.
﴿ظلموا﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿منهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿فلا﴾: the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa ("disclosing") fāʾ, i.e.: since you know that and its truth has taken root in your souls; and لا is prohibitive.
﴿تخشوهم﴾: an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by لا, the sign of its jussive being the omission of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi.
﴿واخشوني﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اخشوا is an imperative verb indeclinable on the omission of the nūn, because its imperfect is one of the five verbs; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), the wāw is the fāʿil, and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ولأتم﴾: conjoined to لئلا يكون.
﴿نعمتي﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿عليكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أتم.
﴿ولعلكم تهتدون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لعل is its noun [Translator's note: so in the source («ولعل اسمها»); presumably what is meant is: لعل is an abrogating particle and the kāf is its noun], and the clause تهتدون is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:151-151.t:
﴿كما أرسلنا﴾: the kāf is a noun in the sense of مثل (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar, the implied form being: ولأتم نعمتي عليكم إتماما مثل إرسالنا الرسول فيكم (and that I may complete My favour upon you with a completing like Our sending the Messenger among you); ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdarī, and ﴿أرسلنا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿أرسلنا﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdarī ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position, and the interpreted maṣdar formed from the maṣdarī ﴿ما﴾ and the verb ﴿أرسلنا﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct).
﴿فيكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أرسلنا.
﴿رسولا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿منكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt.
﴿يتلو﴾: the verbal clause is a second naʿt of ﴿رسولًا﴾.
﴿عليكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يتلو.
﴿آياتنا﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿ويزكيكم ويعلمكم﴾: the two imperfect verbs are conjoined to يتلو.
﴿الكتاب﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿والحكمة﴾: conjoined to الكتاب.
﴿ويعلمكم﴾: conjoined to what preceded, and the kāf is first mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿لم﴾: a particle of negation, of inversion [of the imperfect to past meaning], and of the jussive.
﴿تكونوا﴾: a defective imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by لم, and the wāw is its noun (ism); the verbal clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿تعلمون﴾: the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of تكونوا.

muyesser-irab:68-68.t:
﴿قالوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿ادع﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the weak letter; its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); the clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿لنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ادع».
﴿ربك﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿يبين﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) in answer to the request.
﴿لنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يبين».
﴿ما﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿هي﴾: a detached pronoun in the position of a nominative, khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), the object of «يبين».
﴿قال﴾: a past verb.
﴿إنه﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun.
﴿يقول إنها بقرة﴾: the clause is the khabar of «إن»; the clause of «إن» and what falls within its scope is the object of speech.
﴿لا﴾: negative.
﴿فارض﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of «بقرة».
﴿ولا بكر﴾: conjoined to what precedes.
﴿عوان﴾: likewise a naʿt of «بقرة».
﴿بين ذلك﴾: the adverb is attached to an omitted naʿt of «عوان», and «ذلك» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿فافعلوا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa ("the disclosing fāʾ"), and «افعلوا» is a verb and its fāʿil.
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi.
﴿تؤمرون﴾: an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), nominative, the sign of its nominative being the nūn; the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil [Translator's note: so in the source; with a passive verb the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent)]; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, the resumptive pronoun (ʿāʾid) being omitted, i.e. "[commanded] with it" (به). And it has been said: «ما» is maṣdariyya, the meaning being "so do your command" (فافعلوا أمركم), the maṣdar then being in the sense of the passive participle, i.e. "what you are commanded" (مأموركم).

muyesser-irab:69-69.t:
﴿قالوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿ادع﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the weak letter; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); the clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿لنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ادع».
﴿ربك﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿يبين﴾: the answer to the request.
﴿لنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يبين».
﴿ما﴾: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿لونها﴾: khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the object.
﴿قال﴾: a past verb.
﴿إنه﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun.
﴿يقول﴾: the clause is the khabar of «إن».
﴿إنها بقرة﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle, the hāʾ is its noun, and «بقرة» is its khabar; the clause is the object of speech.
﴿صفراء﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of «بقرة».
﴿فاقع﴾: a second naʿt.
﴿لونها﴾: the fāʿil of «فاقع». Or «فاقع» is a fronted khabar and «لونها» a postponed mubtadaʾ, and the clause is a second naʿt of «بقرة».
﴿تسر الناظرين﴾: an imperfect verb, a latent fāʿil, and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a third naʿt of «بقرة».

muyesser-irab:70-70.t:
﴿قالوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿ادع﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the weak letter; its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); the clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿لنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ادع».
﴿ربك﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿يبين﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) in answer to the request.
﴿لنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يبين».
﴿ما﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿هي﴾: a detached pronoun in the position of a nominative, khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), the object of «يبين».
﴿إن﴾: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh).
﴿البقر﴾: its noun; the clause is a justification (taʿlīl) of the question, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿تشابه﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is "it" (هو); the clause is the khabar of «إن».
﴿علينا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «تشابه».
﴿وإنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «إن» is an abrogating particle, and «نا» is its noun.
﴿إن﴾: a conditional particle that makes [the verb] jussive.
﴿شاء﴾: a past verb in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).
﴿الله﴾: fāʿil; the apodosis (jawāb) of «إن» is omitted, its implied form being: "we will be guided" (اهتدينا).
﴿لمهتدون﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and «مهتدون» is the khabar of «إن».

muyesser-irab:71-71.t:
﴿قال﴾: a past verb.
﴿إنه يقول﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the hāʾ is its noun, and the clause «يقول» is its khabar (predicate).
﴿إنها بقرة﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle, the hāʾ is its noun, and «بقرة» is its khabar; the clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿لا﴾: negative.
﴿ذلول﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of «بقرة».
﴿تثير الأرض﴾: the verbal clause is in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), a second naʿt; what is meant is the negation of her ploughing the earth.
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «لا» is added to emphasise the first, because the meaning is: "not broken in, ploughing and watering".
﴿تسقي الحرث﴾: an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), and mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿مسلمة﴾: a third naʿt.
﴿لا﴾: [the lā] of generic negation, one of the sisters of «إن».
﴿شية﴾: its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa.
﴿فيها﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar; the clause is a fourth naʿt.
﴿قالوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil.
﴿الآن﴾: an adverb of time attached to «جئت».
﴿جئت﴾: the clause «جئت» is the object of speech.
﴿بالحق﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "clothed in the truth" (متلبسًا بالحق).
﴿فذبحوها﴾: conjoined to an omitted [clause] required by the context, i.e.: "so they sought her, found her and slaughtered her" (فطلبوها فوجدوها وذبحوها). Or the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa ("the disclosing fāʾ"), i.e.: "so when they obtained this cow combining the various parts of this description, they slaughtered her".
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «ما» is negative.
﴿كادوا﴾: «كاد» is a past verb, and the wāw is its noun, because it is one of the verbs of approximation (afʿāl al-muqāraba) that operate like «كان».
﴿يفعلون﴾: the khabar of «كادوا».

muyesser-irab:72-72.t:
﴿وإذ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «إذ» is a noun of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), conjoined to «نعمتي» in the words of the Exalted «اذكروا نعمتي».
﴿قتلتم﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the verbal clause is in the position of a genitive (majrūr), muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿نفسا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فادارأتم﴾: conjoined to «قتلتم».
﴿فيها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ادارأتم».
﴿والله﴾: the wāw is parenthetical, and «الله» is a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿مخرج﴾: khabar (predicate).
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi of «مخرج», because it is an active participle.
﴿كنتم﴾: «كان» is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb [of kāna and its sisters], and the tāʾ is its noun.
﴿تكتمون﴾: a verbal clause in the position of an accusative, the khabar of «كنتم»; the clause [«كنتم تكتمون»] is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of «ما»; the clause «والله مخرج...» is parenthetical, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:258-258.t:
﴿ألم تر إلى الذي حاج إبراهيم في ربه﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position. The hamza is interrogative, the question being for affirmation (taqrīr) and for making the hearer wonder; لم is a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and jussive; تر is an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by لم, the sign of its being jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت). إلى الذي is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تر﴾, on the assumption that a muḍāf is omitted, i.e. "to the story of the one who disputed." حاج is a past verb, its fāʿil being a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو); إبراهيم is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); في ربه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to حاج.
﴿أن آتاه الله الملك﴾: أن is a maṣdar-forming particle governing the accusative; آتاه is a past verb in the position of accusative by أن; the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. The interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb after it is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) with the lām implied, because the agent is not the same, i.e. "because He had given him" (لِأن آتاه). The Name of Majesty is the fāʿil of آتاه, and الملك is the second object of ﴿آتاه﴾.
﴿إذ قال إبراهيم﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb for past time, attached to ﴿حاج﴾; ﴿قال إبراهيم﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil, and the verbal clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).
﴿ربي الذي يحيي ويميت﴾: ربي is mubtadaʾ (subject) and الذي is its khabar (predicate); the clause يحيي is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; يميت is conjoined to يحيي; the clause ربي ... etc. is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿قال أنا أحيي وأميت﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; قال is a past verb, its fāʿil being a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو); أنا is mubtadaʾ; أحيي is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil being a latent pronoun, its implied form being "I" (أنا), and the clause is the khabar of أنا; the clause أنا أحيي is a nominal clause in the position of accusative as the object of the speech; أميت is conjoined to أحيي.
﴿قال إبراهيم﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فإن الله يأتي بالشمس من المشرق﴾: the fāʾ is the "eloquent" fāʾ (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa), which occurs in the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if you are capable, as you falsely and fraudulently claim, then Allah brings the sun from the east…". إن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism), and the clause يأتي is its khabar; the clause after the fāʾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of an implied non-jussive condition; بالشمس is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يأتي, and من المشرق is a preposition and its genitive noun also attached to يأتي.
﴿فأت بها من المغرب﴾: He repeated the eloquent fāʾ for emphasis and as a preparation for the argument; ائت is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, its fāʿil being "you" (أنت); بها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ائت; من المغرب is a preposition and its genitive noun also attached to it.
﴿فبهت الذي كفر﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; الذي is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) according to the wording, and it has been said: the fāʿil with regard to the meaning. كفر is a past verb with a latent agent, and the clause is the ṣila of ﴿الذي﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿والله لا يهدي القوم الظالمين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ; the clause لا يهدي is its khabar; القوم is mafʿūl bihi; الظالمين is a naʿt (adjective). The clause ﴿والله لا يهدي...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:259-259.t:
﴿أو كالذي مر على قرية﴾: ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction. ﴿كالذي﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مِثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, the implied form being: "or have you seen the like of the one who…" (أو رأيت مثلَ الذي), the verb having been omitted because ﴿ألم ترَ﴾ indicates it. Or the kāf is a noun in the position of genitive, conjoined to ﴿الذي﴾ in the saying of Allah the Exalted ﴿ألم تر إلى الذي...﴾, i.e. "Have you not seen the one who disputed with Ibrāhīm, or the like of the one who passed by a town?" ﴿الذي﴾ is a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿مر على قرية﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿وهي خاوية على عروشها﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (lil-ḥāl); هي is mubtadaʾ (subject) and خاوية is khabar (predicate); على عروشها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خاوية﴾, the meaning being: fallen down upon its roofs, in that the roof fell first and then the walls collapsed upon it; or [they are] attached to an omitted second khabar of ﴿هي﴾, the meaning being: empty of its inhabitants, standing upon its roofs.
﴿قال أنى يحيي هذه الله بعد موتها﴾: قال is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) being "he" (هو); أنى is an adverb attached to يحيي, and the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); or [أنى] means "how" (كيف), so that it is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of هذه, the governing word in it being يحيي; the clause is the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). يحيي is an imperfect verb; هذه is a fronted object; the Name of Majesty is a delayed fāʿil; بعد موتها is an adverb of time also attached to يحيي. The clause قال is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فأماته الله مائة عام﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; أماته الله is a verb, a mafʿūl bihi and a fāʿil; مائة is an adverb of time attached to أماته, and عام is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿ثم بعثه﴾: conjoined to أماته.
﴿قال كم لبثت﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; كم is an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as an adverb of time, attached to لبثت; its tamyīz (specification) is omitted, as though it were said: "how much time did you stay?" لبثت is a verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is in the position of accusative as the object of the speech.
﴿قال لبثت يوما أو بعض يوم﴾: the clause of saying is resumptive, with no grammatical position, so as to serve as the reply to the question; the clause لبثت is in the position of accusative as the object of the speech; يومًا is an adverb of time attached to لبثت; أو is a conjunction; بعض يوم is conjoined to يومًا.
﴿قال بل لبثت مائة عام﴾: the clause ﴿قال...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; بل is a conjunction, [conjoining] to an omitted clause, i.e. "you did not stay a day or part of a day; rather, you stayed a hundred years"; مائة عام is an adverb. The clause is the object of the speech.
﴿فانظر إلى طعامك وشرابك لم يتسنه﴾: the fāʾ is the "eloquent" fāʾ (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa), and here it is the apodosis of an implied condition, its implied form being: "if doubt and lack of reassurance about the matter of the resurrection have arisen in you, then look." انظر is an imperative verb, its fāʿil being a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); ﴿إلى طعامك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to انظر; شرابك is conjoined to طعامك; لم is a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and jussive; يتسنه is an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by لم, the sign of its being jussive being the sukūn, on the view that the hāʾ is a root letter of the word; the clause ﴿لم يتسنه﴾ is a ḥāl.
﴿وانظر إلى حمارك﴾: conjoined to what precedes; انظر is an imperative verb, its fāʿil being a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); ﴿إلى حمارك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to انظر.
﴿ولنجعلك آية للناس﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is of reason (lām al-taʿlīl); نجعلك is an imperfect verb made accusative by an implied أن after the lām of reason; أن and the verb are to be interpreted as a genitive maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar), and the lām of reason with its genitive is attached to an omitted verb. The fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "We" (نحن); the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi, and آية is the second mafʿūl bihi; للناس is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of آية.
﴿وانظر إلى العظام كيف ننشزها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; انظر is an imperative verb, its fāʿil being a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); إلى العظام is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to انظر; كيف is an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, the one to whom the ḥāl refers being the accusative pronoun in ننشزها; the clause is a badal (substitute) of العظام. ننشزها is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); ﴿ها﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "We" (نحن).
﴿ثم نكسوها لحما﴾: ثم is a conjunction for sequence with delay; نكسوها is an imperfect verb that takes two objects in the accusative, the first of them being the hāʾ, and لحمًا is the second object.
﴿فلما تبين له﴾: the fāʾ conjoins [this] to something implied that the context requires, as though it were said: "so Allah raised them and clothed them with flesh, and he looked at them, and it became clear to him how giving life and resurrection take place." لما is adverbial, non-jussive, attached to the apodosis; تبين is a past verb, indeclinable on the overt fatḥa; the fāʿil of تبين is a latent pronoun referring to the manner of giving life; or: "when what had been obscure to him became clear to him." The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تبين, and the clause تبين is in the position of genitive by annexation.
﴿قال أعلم أن الله على كل شيء قدير﴾: قال is a verb with a latent agent; the clause أعلم is the object of the speech; the clause of saying has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. أن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism); ﴿على كل شيء قدير﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted khabar, standing in place of the two objects of أعلم. [Translator's note: so in the source; on the usual analysis قدير is itself the khabar of أن and على كل شيء is attached to قدير, with أن and what falls within its scope standing in place of the two objects of أعلم.]

muyesser-irab:260-260.t:
﴿وإذ قال إبراهيم﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the speech is resumptive, with no grammatical position. إذ is a noun of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, the implied form being: "remember, O Muhammad, when Ibrāhīm said…"; or [it is] an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قال أولم تؤمن﴾. ﴿قال إبراهيم﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the verbal clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).
﴿رب أرني كيف تحي الموتى﴾: رب is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person; the clause is in the position of accusative as the object of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). أرني is a verb of supplication, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter; the nūn is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and the yāʾ of the first person is the first mafʿūl bihi; كيف is an interrogative, a ḥāl (circumstantial); تحيي is an imperfect verb with a latent (mustatir) agent; الموتى is mafʿūl bihi; the clause كيف تحيي الموتى is in the position of accusative as the second object of أرني.
﴿قال أولم تؤمن﴾: قال is a past verb, its fāʿil being "He" (هو); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The hamza is for the interrogative of affirmation (al-istifhām al-taqrīrī); the wāw is a conjunction; لم is a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and jussive; تؤمن is an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by لم; the interrogative clause is in the position of accusative as the object of the speech.
﴿قال بلى﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; بلى is a particle of answer that affirms what comes after the particle of negation, i.e. it affirms his faith.
﴿ولكن ليطمئن قلبي﴾: the wāw conjoins [this] to an omitted clause, its implied form being ﴿سألتك﴾ ("I asked You"); لكن is an inoperative (muhmal) particle of rectification (istidrāk). In ليطمئن the lām is of reason (lām al-taʿlīl), and يطمئن is an imperfect verb made accusative by an implied أن; the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the imperfect verb after it are to be interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) made genitive by the lām of reason, and the lām of reason with its genitive is attached to an omitted verb. قلبي is the fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma implied on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿قال فخذ أربعة من الطير﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; the fāʾ is the "eloquent" fāʾ (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa), i.e. "if you wish to know that by sight, then take." خذ is an imperative verb, its fāʿil being "you" (أنت); أربعة is mafʿūl bihi; من الطير is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of أربعة.
﴿فصرهن إليك﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; صرهن is an imperative verb; the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "you" (أنت); the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi, and the nūn is the sign of the feminine plural, with no grammatical position; إليك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "drawn close to you."
﴿ثم اجعل على كل جبل منهن جزءا﴾: ثم is a conjunction for sequence and delay; اجعل is an imperative verb, its fāʿil being "you" (أنت); على كل is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to اجعل, on the view that it is the second object of ﴿اجعل﴾; جبل is muḍāf ilayhi; منهن is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, because it was originally a naʿt of ﴿جزءًا﴾, and when it was placed before the word it qualifies it was parsed as a ḥāl; جزءًا is the first object.
﴿ثم ادعهن يأتينك سعيا﴾: also conjoined; ادعهن is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter; the fāʿil is "you" (أنت); the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi, and the nūn is the sign of the feminine, with no grammatical position. يأتينك is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of jussive as the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab); the nūn is the fāʿil, and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the answer to the request, with no grammatical position. سعيًا stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "a swift walking"; and it has been said: [it is] a ḥāl, i.e. "hastening."
﴿واعلم أن الله عزيز حكيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اعلم is an imperative verb, its fāʿil being "you" (أنت); أن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism), and عزيز حكيم are its two khabars (predicates); [أن and what it governs] stand in place of the two objects of اعلم.

muyesser-irab:215-215.t:
﴿يسألونك﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ماذا﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as the fronted mafʿūl bihi of «ينفقون»; or «ما» is an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and «ذا» is a relative noun in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate), and the clause is in the position of the accusative as the fronted object of «ينفقون» [Translator's note: so in the source; on this second analysis the nominal clause «ما ذا» would be the object of «يسألونك», while «ينفقون» is the ṣila of «ذا»]; the clause «يسألونك» is resumptive.
﴿ينفقون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the accusative as the second object of «يسألونك».
﴿قل﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ما أنفقتم﴾: «ما» is conditional, in the position of the accusative as the fronted mafʿūl bihi of «أنفقتم»; «أنفقتم» is a verb in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and a fāʿil; the clause is the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿من خير﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فللوالدين﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e.: "then it is for the parents" (فهو للوالدين); the nominal clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis.
﴿والأقربين واليتامى والمساكين وابن السبيل﴾: all conjoined to «الوالدين».
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and «ما» is a jussive conditional noun (ism sharṭ jāzim) in the position of the accusative as the fronted mafʿūl bihi of «تفعلوا».
﴿تفعلوا﴾: the protasis, jussive, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn.
﴿من خير﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿فإن الله به عليم﴾: the fāʾ is linking (rābiṭa); «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism), and «عليم» is its khabar; the clause is nominal, in the position of the jussive as the apodosis; «به» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar «عليم». The clause «وما تفعلوا من خير...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:216-216.t:
﴿كتب عليكم القتال﴾: «كتب» is a past verb, passive (built for that whose agent is not named); «عليكم» is [a preposition and its genitive noun, both] attached to (mutaʿalliq) «كتب»; «القتال» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وهو﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «هو» is a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿كره﴾: khabar (predicate).
﴿لكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «كره»; the nominal clause after the circumstantial wāw is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وعسى﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and «عسى» is an invariable (jāmid) past verb for expressing hope (tarajjī); here it is complete (tāmma).
﴿أن تكرهوا﴾: «أن» and what falls within its scope are interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar), the fāʿil (agent) of «عسى».
﴿شيئا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وهو﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, and «هو» is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿خير﴾: khabar.
﴿لكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «خير»; the nominal clause after the wāw is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl. The clause «وعسى أن تكرهوا...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وعسى﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and «عسى» is an invariable past verb for expressing hope; here it is complete.
﴿أن تحبوا﴾: «أن» and what falls within its scope are interpreted as a maṣdar, the fāʿil of «عسى».
﴿شيئا﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وهو﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, and «هو» is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿شر﴾: khabar.
﴿لكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «شر»; the nominal clause after the wāw is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl. The clause «وعسى أن تحبوا...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿والله﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿يعلم﴾: an imperfect verb and a latent (mustatir) fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ.
﴿وأنتم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «أنتم» is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿لا تعلمون﴾: «لا» is negating (nāfiya), «تعلمون» is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of «أنتم». The clause «والله يعلم...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:217-217.t:
﴿يسألونك عن الشهر الحرام﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; «يسألونك» is a verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يسألونك», and «الحرام» is an adjective (ṣifa).
﴿قتال﴾: a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl, substitute) from «الشهر».
﴿فيه﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective of «قتال».
﴿قل﴾: an imperative verb; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿قتال﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject); it is permissible to begin with it although it is indefinite, because it is qualified.
﴿فيه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of «قتال».
﴿كبير﴾: khabar (predicate).
﴿وصد﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «صد» is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿عن سبيل الله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «صد», and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وكفر به﴾: conjoined to «صد», and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «كفر».
﴿والمسجد الحرام﴾: conjoined to «سبيل الله», i.e.: "and barring from the Sacred Mosque."
﴿وإخراج أهله﴾: conjoined to «صد»; «أهله» is muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿أكبر﴾: the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «صدٌ» and what is conjoined to it.
﴿عند الله﴾: an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to «أكبر».
﴿والفتنة﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and «الفتنة» is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿أكبر﴾: khabar.
﴿من القتل﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «أكبر»; the clause «والفتنة أكبر...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. Or the wāw in His words «والفتنة» is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), in which case the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ولا يزالون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «لا يزالون» is a deficient (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, one of the sisters of «كان», and the wāw is its noun (ism).
﴿يقاتلونكم﴾: an imperfect verb, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar of «يزالون».
﴿حتى يردوكم﴾: «حتى» is a particle of limit (ghāya) and a preposition, or for causation (taʿlīl); «يردوكم» is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an «أن» concealed after «حتى»; the concealed «أن» and the imperfect verb after it are interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) in the genitive by «حتى», and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يقاتلونكم».
﴿عن دينكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يردوكم».
﴿إن﴾: conditional.
﴿استطاعوا﴾: a past verb in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the wāw is the fāʿil; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, what precedes it indicating it, i.e.: "they would turn you back" (يردوكم).
﴿ومن﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and «من» is a jussive conditional noun (ism sharṭ jāzim), mubtadaʾ.
﴿يرتدد﴾: the protasis.
﴿منكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿عن دينه﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يرتدد».
﴿فيمت﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «يمت» is an imperfect verb, jussive by conjunction with «يرتدد».
﴿وهو﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, and «هو» is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿كافر﴾: khabar; the nominal clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl.
﴿فأولئك﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and «أولئك» is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ.
﴿حبطت أعمالهم﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of «أولئك»; the demonstrative clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of «من».
﴿في الدنيا﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «حبطت».
﴿والآخرة﴾: conjoined to «الدنيا». The clause «ومن يرتدد منكم...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وأولئك﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «أولئك» is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿أصحاب النار﴾: khabar.
﴿هم﴾: a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ.
﴿فيها﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to His word «خالدون».
﴿خالدون﴾: khabar; the clause «هم فيها خالدون» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:218-218.t:
﴿إن الذين﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and «الذين» is its noun (ism).
﴿آمنوا﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين».
﴿والذين هاجروا وجاهدوا في سبيل الله﴾: conjoined to what preceded.
﴿أولئك﴾: the demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿يرجون﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of «أولئك».
﴿رحمت الله﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the demonstrative clause is a nominal clause in the position of the nominative as the khabar of «إن».
﴿والله﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and «الله» is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿غفور رحيم﴾: two khabars of the mubtadaʾ. The clause «والله غفور رحيم» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:219-219.t:
﴿يسألونك عن الخمر والميسر﴾: a verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يسألونك», and «الميسر» is conjoined to «الخمر»; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿قل﴾: an imperative verb; its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); the clause is also resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فيهما﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿إثم﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿كبير﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of «إثم»; the nominal clause is the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿ومنافع للناس﴾: conjoined to «إثم»; «للناس» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective.
﴿وإثمهما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «إثم» is a mubtadaʾ, the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the mīm and the alif are two letters indicating the dual.
﴿أكبر﴾: khabar.
﴿من نفعهما﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «أكبر».
﴿ويسألونك﴾: conjoined to «يسألونك».
﴿ماذا﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as the fronted mafʿūl bihi of «ينفقون»; or «ما» is an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, and «ذا» is a relative noun in the position of the nominative as khabar, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as the fronted object of «ينفقون»; the clause «يسألونك» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ينفقون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the accusative as the second object of «يسألونك».
﴿قل﴾: an imperative verb; its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "you" (أنت); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿العفو﴾: the mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being "spend" (أنفقوا); the clause is the speech reported by the verb of saying.
﴿كذلك يبين﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun) placed before its governor, i.e.: "with a clarifying like that Allah clarifies the signs for you"; «ذلك»: «ذا» is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address. «يبين» is an imperfect verb, nominative.
﴿الله﴾: the fāʿil of «يبين».
﴿لكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يبين».
﴿الآيات﴾: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿لعلكم﴾: «لعل» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the kāf is its noun (ism).
﴿تتفكرون﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of «لعل», the clause of hope (rajāʾ) is a ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause «كذلك يبين...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:73-73.t:
﴿فقلنا﴾: conjoined.
﴿اضربوه﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the nūn; the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿ببعضها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اضربوه».
﴿كذلك يحي الله الموتى﴾: «كذلك»: the kāf is a noun in the sense of «مثل» ("like"), indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb «يحيي», the implied form being: "Allah gives life to the dead with a giving of life like that giving of life" (يحيي الله الموتى إحياء مثل ذلك الإحياء).
﴿ويريكم﴾: conjoined to «يحيي»; the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi.
﴿آياته﴾: the second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿لعلكم﴾: «لعل» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the kāf is its noun.
﴿تعقلون﴾: the clause is in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), the khabar (predicate) of «لعل».

muyesser-irab:74-74.t:
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction for delay (tarākhī).
﴿قست﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif that was omitted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the tāʾ is the quiescent tāʾ of the feminine.
﴿قلوبكم﴾: fāʿil (agent).
﴿من بعد ذلك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قست»; «ذلك» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿فهي﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «هي» is a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿كالحجارة﴾: the kāf is a noun in the sense of «مثل» ("like"), indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; «الحجارة» is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿أو﴾: a conjunction for variety (tanwīʿ).
﴿أشد﴾: conjoined to the kāf, nominative.
﴿قسوة﴾: tamyīz (specification).
﴿وإن﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh).
﴿من الحجارة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted fronted khabar.
﴿لما﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and «ما» is a relative noun in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), its postponed noun.
﴿يتفجر﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of «ما», a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿منه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يتفجر».
﴿الأنهار﴾: the fāʿil of «يتفجر». The clause «إن من الحجارة...» is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿وإن﴾: conjoined to the first «أن».
﴿منها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar.
﴿لما﴾: the shifted lām, and «ما» is a relative noun, the postponed noun of «إن».
﴿يشقق﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative.
﴿فيخرج﴾: conjoined to «يشقق».
﴿منه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يخرج».
﴿الماء﴾: the fāʿil of «يخرج».
﴿وإن منها لما يهبط﴾: conjoined to what precedes.
﴿من خشية الله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يهبط», serving as its justification (taʿlīl).
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and «ما» is the Ḥijāzī negative that operates like «ليس».
﴿الله﴾: its noun, nominative.
﴿بغافل﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, a connective (ṣila); «غافل» is genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ in form and accusative in position as the khabar of «ما».
﴿عما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «غافل».
﴿تعملون﴾: the clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun; the clause «ما الله بغافل...» is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:75-75.t:
﴿أفتطمعون﴾: the hamza is for the interrogation of disavowal (istifhām istinkārī), and the fāʾ is a conjunction.
﴿أن يؤمنوا﴾: «أن» and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ).
﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يؤمنوا», on «يؤمنوا» being made to imply the meaning of submitting (inqiyād).
﴿وقد﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «قد» is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq).
﴿كان﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb [of kāna and its sisters].
﴿فريق﴾: its noun.
﴿منهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, a naʿt (adjective) of «فريق».
﴿يسمعون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause «يسمعون» is the khabar (predicate) of «كان».
﴿كلام الله﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction for delay (tarākhī).
﴿يحرفونه﴾: conjoined to «يسمعون».
﴿من بعد﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يحرفونه».
﴿ما﴾: maṣdariyya (infinitival), interpreted together with what follows it as a maṣdar, genitive (majrūr) by annexation.
﴿عقلوه﴾: a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وهم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, and «هم» is a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿يعلمون﴾: the clause is in the place of a nominative, the khabar of «هم»; the nominal clause is in the place of an accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "while they are aware of their disbelief, obstinacy and fabrication".

muyesser-irab:76-76.t:
﴿وإذا﴾: the wāw is resumptive or a conjunction; «إذا» is an adverb for future time, making its protasis (sharṭ) genitive [by annexation], attached to (mutaʿalliq) its apodosis (jawāb).
﴿لقوا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa [Translator's note: so in the source; at 2:14 the same form is parsed as indeclinable on ḍamma]; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the verbal clause «لقوا» has no grammatical position, because the adverb is annexed to it [Translator's note: so in the source; elsewhere such a clause is said to be in the position of a genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it].
﴿الذين﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿آمنوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿قالوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿آمنا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl). The clause «إذا لقوا الذين..» is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿وإذا﴾: conjoined to the first «وإذا».
﴿خلا بعضهم﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the annexation of the adverb to it.
﴿إلى بعض﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «خلا».
﴿قالوا﴾: the clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
﴿أتحدثونهم﴾: the hamza is for the interrogation of disapproval (istifhām inkārī); «تحدثونهم» is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of an accusative as the object of speech.
﴿بما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «تحدثونهم».
﴿فتح الله﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun.
﴿عليكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «فتح».
﴿ليحاجوكم﴾: the lām is the lām of consequence (ʿāqiba) or outcome (ṣayrūra); «يحاجوكم» is an imperfect verb, accusative by an «أن» optionally implied after the lām of consequence or outcome; the implied «أن» and the imperfect verb after it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive by the lām, and the lām and its genitive are attached to «تحدثونهم».
﴿به﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يحاجوكم».
﴿عند ربكم﴾: the adverb is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿أفلا﴾: the hamza is for the interrogation of disapproval, the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «لا» is prohibitive [Translator's note: so in the source, «لا ناهية»; since «تعقلون» is indicative, «لا» here is negative (nāfiya)].
﴿تعقلون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:77-77.t:
﴿أولا﴾: the hamza is for the interrogation of affirmation (istifhām taqrīrī); the wāw is a conjunction, and it is intended to precede the hamza, but was put after it only because of the strength of the hamza; and «لا» is negative.
﴿يعلمون﴾: conjoined to an omitted verb, the meaning being: "do they blame them for speaking of what was mentioned, and do they not know?" (أيلومونهم على التحدث بما ذكر ولا يعلمون).
﴿أن الله﴾: «أن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the Name of Majesty is its noun; it and what follows it stand in place of the two objects of «يعلمون».
﴿يعلم﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); the clause is in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), the khabar (predicate) of «أن».
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun or maṣdariyya (infinitival); together with what it governs it is the object of «يعلم».
﴿يسرون﴾: the clause is a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿وما يعلنون﴾: conjoined to it.

muyesser-irab:261-261.t:
﴿مثل الذين ينفقون أموالهم في سبيل الله﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position, with the muḍāf omitted, its implied form being "the likeness of their spending" (مثل نفقتهم). مَثَل is mubtadaʾ (subject); الذين is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ينفقون has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; أموالهم is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); في سبيل الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ينفقون.
﴿كمثل حبة أنبتت سبع سنابل﴾: ﴿كمثل﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مِثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; ﴿مَثَل﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿أنبتت﴾ is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) being "it" (هي); ﴿سبع﴾ is mafʿūl bihi; ﴿سنابل﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of its being genitive being the fatḥa, because it is on the pattern of the ultimate plurals (ṣīghat muntahā al-jumūʿ) and is a diptote; the clause ﴿أنبتت﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of حبة.
﴿في كل سنبلة مائة حبة﴾: في كل, the preposition and its genitive noun, is attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; سنبلة is muḍāf ilayhi; مائة حبة is a delayed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is a naʿt of سنابل, in the position of genitive, or a naʿt of سبع, in the position of accusative.
﴿والله يضاعف لمن يشاء﴾: the wāw is resumptive; الله is mubtadaʾ; يضاعف is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil being latent (mustatir), its implied form being "He" (هو), referring to Allah the Exalted; the clause يضاعف is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ﴿الله﴾; لمن, the preposition and its genitive noun, is attached to يضاعف; the clause ﴿يشاء﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿والله يضاعف...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿والله واسع عليم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; الله is mubtadaʾ; واسع is a first khabar, and عليم is a second khabar.

muyesser-irab:262-262.t:
﴿الذين ينفقون أموالهم في سبيل الله﴾: the clause follows the preceding clauses as a badal (substitute) of them; and it has been said: it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. الذين is mubtadaʾ (subject), or a badal of the first الذين; the clause ينفقون أموالهم has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين; في سبيل الله is attached to (mutaʿalliq) ينفقون.
﴿ثم لا يتبعون ما أنفقوا منا ولا أذى﴾: ثم is a conjunction for sequence and delay; لا is negative; يتبعون is an imperfect verb conjoined to ينفقون; ما is a relative noun, the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause أنفقوا is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; منًّا is the second mafʿūl bihi; ولا أذى is conjoined to ﴿منًّا﴾.
﴿لهم أجرهم عند ربهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are a fronted khabar (predicate); أجرهم is a delayed mubtadaʾ; the adverb is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ربهم is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The nominal clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of الذين if it is a mubtadaʾ; but if it is a badal, the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولا خوف﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is negative; خوف is mubtadaʾ, beginning with it being permissible although it is indefinite because the negation precedes it.
﴿عليهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ.
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿لا﴾ is negative.
﴿هم﴾: an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ.
﴿يحزنون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿يحزنون﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ﴿هم﴾.

muyesser-irab:263-263.t:
﴿قول معروف ومغفرة خير من صدقة يتبعها أذى﴾: قول is mubtadaʾ (subject), beginning with an indefinite being permissible because it is qualified; معروف is a naʿt (adjective) of قول; مغفرة is conjoined to قول; خير is khabar (predicate); من صدقة is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) خير; يتبعها is an imperfect verb, and ﴿ها﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is a naʿt of صدقة; أذى is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿والله غني حليم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ, and غني حليم are its two khabars. The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:264-264.t:
﴿يا أيها﴾: يا is a vocative particle; أي is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of accusative; ها is for drawing attention (tanbīh).
﴿الذين﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾.
﴿آمنوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿لا تبطلوا صدقاتكم بالمن والأذى﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; لا is prohibitive; تبطلوا is an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by لا; the wāw is the fāʿil; صدقاتكم is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative by the kasra in place of the fatḥa, because it is a sound feminine plural; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); بالمن is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) تبطلوا; الأذى is conjoined to المن.
﴿كالذي﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as the naʿt of an omitted maṣdar; there is an omitted muḍāf in the speech, the implied form being: "do not nullify your charities with a nullifying like the nullifying of the one who spends…"; or the kāf is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent of ﴿تبطلوا﴾. ﴿الذي﴾ is a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿ينفق ماله رئاء الناس﴾: the clause ﴿ينفق ماله﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; رئاء الناس is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).
﴿ولا يؤمن بالله واليوم الآخر﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is negative; يؤمن is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil being "he" (هو); بالله is attached to يؤمن; اليوم الآخر is conjoined to the Name of Majesty.
﴿فمثله كمثل صفوان﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; مثله is mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿كمثل﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مِثل), indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; ﴿مَثَل﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and ﴿صفوان﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿عليه تراب﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; تراب is a delayed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is in the position of genitive as a naʿt of صفوان. The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. [Translator's note: so in the source, although the clause has just been parsed as a naʿt in the position of genitive; the last remark presumably refers to the larger clause ﴿فمثله كمثل صفوان...﴾.]
﴿فأصابه وابل﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, conjoining أصابه to that to which عليه is attached, i.e. "[dust] settled on it, and then [a downpour] struck it"; the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi, and وابل is the fāʿil.
﴿فتركه صلدا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ترك is a past verb taking two objects in the accusative, the first of them being the hāʾ and the second صلدًا.
﴿لا يقدرون على شيء﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; لا is negative; يقدرون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its being nominative being the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; على شيء is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يقدرون.
﴿مما كسبوا﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt of شيء; the clause كسبوا has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun ما.
﴿والله لا يهدي القوم الكافرين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ; the clause لا يهدي is the khabar; القوم is mafʿūl bihi; الكافرين is a naʿt of القوم. The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:265-265.t:
﴿ومثل الذين ينفقون أموالهم﴾: the wāw conjoins [this] to ﴿فمثله﴾; مثل is mubtadaʾ (subject), and a muḍāf must be implied, its implied form being "spendings" (نفقات); الذين is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ينفقون أموالهم has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿ابتغاء مرضات الله﴾: a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); مرضاة الله is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿وتثبيتا من أنفسهم﴾: conjoined to ابتغاء; من أنفسهم is attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تثبيتًا﴾.
﴿كمثل جنة بربوة﴾: ﴿كمثل﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مِثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; ﴿مَثَل﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and ﴿جنة﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿بربوة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of جنة.
﴿أصابها وابل﴾: a verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a fāʿil (agent); the clause is also a naʿt of جنة.
﴿فآتت أكلها ضعفين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; آتت is a past verb, its fāʿil being latent (mustatir), its implied form being "it" (هي), referring to جنة; أكلها is mafʿūl bihi, and ﴿ها﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; ضعفين is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فإن لم يصبها وابل فطل﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إن is conditional; لم is a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and jussive; يصبها is an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʾ links the apodosis; طل is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "then what strikes it is a drizzle" (فالذي يصيبها طل), and the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). The clause ﴿فإن لم يصبها...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿والله بما تعملون بصير﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to بصير; the clause تعملون is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; بصير is khabar. The clause ﴿والله بما تعملون بصير﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:266-266.t:
﴿أيود أحدكم﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; the hamza is interrogative; يود is an imperfect verb; أحدكم is its fāʿil (agent), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿أن تكون له جنة﴾: أن is a maṣdar-forming particle governing the accusative; تكون is a past verb, accusative [Translator's note: so in the source; تكون is an imperfect verb (one of kāna and its sisters)]; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن﴾ and what follows it is the object of ﴿يود﴾; ﴿له﴾, the preposition and its genitive noun, is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿جنة﴾ is its delayed noun (ism).
﴿من نخيل وأعناب﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of جنة; أعناب is conjoined to نخيل.
﴿تجري من تحتها الأنهار﴾: تجري is an imperfect verb; من تحتها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تجري, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; الأنهار is the fāʿil; the clause is a second naʿt of جنة.
﴿له فيها من كل الثمرات﴾: له is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); من كل الثمرات, the preposition and its genitive noun, is attached to an omitted naʿt of the omitted, delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is a third naʿt of جنة.
﴿وأصابه الكبر﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); the clause أصابه الكبر is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, on the assumption of an implied ﴿قد﴾.
﴿وله ذرية ضعفاء﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; له is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; ذرية is a delayed mubtadaʾ; ضعفاء is a naʿt of ذرية; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the hāʾ in ﴿أصابه﴾.
﴿فأصابها إعصار﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; أصاب is a past verb; the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and إعصار is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to the naʿt of the garden.
﴿فيه نار﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; نار is a delayed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is a naʿt of إعصار.
﴿فاحترقت﴾: conjoined to أصابها.
﴿كذلك يبين الله لكم الآيات﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as the naʿt of an omitted maṣdar placed before its governing word, i.e. "with an explaining like that does Allah explain the signs to you." ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address. ﴿يبين﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil of يبين; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يبين﴾; ﴿الآيات﴾ is mafʿūl bihi, accusative by the kasra; the clause ﴿يبين﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿لعلكم تتفكرون﴾: لعل is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); the kāf is its noun, and the clause تتفكرون is its khabar; the clause of hope is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:267-267.t:
﴿يا أيها﴾: يا is a vocative particle; أي is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of accusative; ها is for drawing attention (tanbīh).
﴿الذين﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾.
﴿آمنوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿أنفقوا من طيبات ما كسبتم﴾: أنفقوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; من طيبات, the preposition and its genitive noun, is attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنفقوا; ما is a relative noun in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); the clause كسبتم is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿ومما أخرجنا لكم من الأرض﴾: مما is conjoined to من طيبات; the clause أخرجنا has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أخرجنا; من الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أخرجنا. You may also attach them to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "issuing from the earth."
﴿ولا تيمموا الخبيث منه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تيمموا is an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by لا; the wāw is the fāʿil; الخبيث is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); منه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl of الخبيث.
﴿تنفقون﴾: the clause is a ḥāl; the object of تنفقون is omitted, i.e. "you spend it" (تنفقونه).
﴿ولستم بآخذيه﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ليس is an abrogating past verb (one of kāna and its sisters), and the tāʾ is its noun (ism); the bāʾ is a preposition; آخذيه is genitive in form and accusative in position, as the khabar (predicate) of ليس; the nūn has been dropped because of the annexation, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is a ḥāl of the agent of تنفقون, i.e. the wāw.
﴿إلا أن تغمضوا فيه﴾: [إلا is] a particle of restriction; أن and what falls within its scope are a maṣdar, accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e. "by your closing your eyes" (بأن تغمضوا); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl, so that it is an exception from the most general of states; or they are attached to آخذيه.
﴿واعلموا أن الله غني حميد﴾: the wāw is resumptive; اعلموا is an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; أن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); the Name of Majesty is its noun, and غني حميد are its two khabars; [أن and what it governs] stand in place of the two objects of اعلموا. The clause ﴿واعلموا أن...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:268-268.t:
﴿الشيطان يعدكم الفقر﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; الشيطان is mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause يعدكم is the khabar (predicate); الفقر is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), or is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ).
﴿ويأمركم بالفحشاء﴾: conjoined to ﴿يعدكم الفقر﴾. The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) يأمركم.
﴿والله يعدكم مغفرة منه وفضلا﴾: conjoined to the resumptive clause; مغفرة is the second mafʿūl bihi; منه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of مغفرة; فضلًا is conjoined to مغفرة.
﴿والله واسع عليم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ, and واسع عليم are two khabars. The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:269-269.t:
﴿يؤتي الحكمة من يشاء﴾: the clause is a third khabar (predicate), or a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; يؤتي is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "He" (هو); الحكمة is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); من is a relative noun in the position of accusative as the second object; the clause يشاء is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿ومن يؤت الحكمة﴾: the wāw is resumptive; من is a conditional noun governing the jussive, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); يؤت is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), passive (whose agent is not named), the sign of its being jussive (majzūm) being the dropping of the weak letter; the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو); الحكمة is the second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فقد أوتي خيرا كثيرا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq); أوتي is a past verb in the passive; the nāʾib fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو); خيرًا is the second mafʿūl bihi, and كثيرًا is a naʿt (adjective); the clause joined with the fāʾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis with its apodosis is the khabar of من. The clause ﴿ومن يؤت...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وما يذكر إلا أولو الالباب﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is negative; يذكر is an imperfect verb, nominative; إلا is a particle of restriction; أولو is the fāʿil, nominative, the sign of its being nominative being the wāw, because it is treated like the sound masculine plural; الألباب is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:270-270.t:
﴿وما أنفقتم من نفقة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is a conditional noun governing the jussive, in the position of accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of أنفقتم; ﴿من نفقة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and it has been said: من is a particle of connection (ḥarf ṣila, i.e. redundant).
﴿أو نذرتم من نذر﴾: conjoined to what precedes.
﴿فإن الله يعلمه﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); إن is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism), and the clause يعلمه is its khabar (predicate); the clause joined with the fāʾ is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis.
﴿وما للظالمين من أنصار﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ما is negative; للظالمين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; من is a particle of connection (redundant); أنصار is a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause ﴿وما للظالمين...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
